details_full_description:
Slugterra: Slug it Out 2
Slugterra: Slug It Out 2 is a battle puzzle RPG where monster collecting meets fast-paced match-3 combat. Build a team of powerful slugs, combine elements, and outthink enemies in tactical battles with real strategy depth.
Collect over 100+ unique slugs, each with distinct abilities and elements like Fire, Water, Earth, Air, Energy, and Psychic. Level them up, evolve favorites, and create teams that match your play style, whether you prefer aggressive openers, defensive control, or combo-based damage.
Match-3 Battles with Real Strategy:
Solve match-3 puzzles to charge your team, then unleash powerful attacks. Chain tiles for bonus energy, time abilities carefully, and counter enemy mechanics. Easy to learn, hard to master, and far deeper than a typical puzzle game.
Monster Collecting with Team Building Depth:
Discover rare slugs, unlock legendary skills, and experiment with team compositions. Swap slugs between modes, tune your loadout, and adapt your strategy for story missions, events, or PvP.
Story, PvE, and Competitive PvP:
Explore the world of Slugterra through story missions in the 99 Caverns. Face iconic villains, earn resources, and push deeper into challenging zones. Test your builds in competitive PvP and climb the ranks to prove your mastery.
Live Events and Ongoing Progression:
Play daily challenges and limited-time events to earn exclusive rewards, rare slugs, and upgrade materials. New content, events, and balance updates keep gameplay fresh and rewarding.
Why Players Stick With Slug It Out 2:
- Monster collecting with meaningful progression
- Tactical match-3 combat with RPG depth
- Team building that rewards experimentation
- PvE, PvP, and live events in one game
- Regular updates and new content
Whether you’re looking for a strategy-driven match-3 game, a monster collecting RPG, or a battle game with real depth, Slugterra: Slug It Out 2 delivers a complete experience.
Download now and build the ultimate slug team.

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/Slugterra/
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/slugterra_slugitout2/

My Singing Monsters
Dive into the Musical World of My Singing Monsters🎵Breed them, feed them, listen to them sing!
Breed and collect a musical menagerie of Monsters, each acting as a living, breathing instrument! Discover a vast world of fantastical locations, filled to the brim with endless weird and wacky Monster combinations, and songs to be sung.

Baby Girl Daily Caring
Spend a lovely time with our beautiful baby girl and spoil her while you are completing the daily activities. Play this baby game and prove that you have what it takes when it comes to fulfilling the required tasks. This little girl really needs a bath before you can start the nursing activities. So, fill a bubble bath and get her in. Make sure you wash her body with suitable products and then continue with cleaning her hair. Now you can go to the playroom where her toys await. details_full_description:
Coloring & Learn
"Coloring and Learn" is an realistic coloring game with more than 250 pages with educational content and many more activities for all ages!.
"Free mode": now you can freely draw, doodle, color and unleash your imagination.
"Glow coloring mode": Create magic doodle artwork with neon paint!
Explore the wonderful world of color!
The whole family, parents and children will have hours of fun together!
Can draw and coloring in the same way they do on paper using different tools.
You can have fun coloring with your kids or do coloring contests with them. The possibilities are endless.
They learn to write the alphabet and numbers. Count, Distinguish geometric figures, know the animals, transportation and more!
Decorate your artworks with over 100 beautiful stickers.
Promotes the development of imagination, the arts, and increases the ability of concentration and fine motor skills of children.
Save your creations in the album and edit them at any time!
Share your doodles with your family and friends via Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, WhatsApp, email, and more...
The game is very fun, simple and educational for all ages.
In addition, it contains other fun activities:
• Drum: become a musician playing drums and creating beautiful songs. It's a fun way to learn music with this wonderful instrument.
• Pop Balloons: have fun blowing balloons with your fingers and listening to the sounds of animals.
• Magic Lines: create your own fireworks show.
• Learn Colors: a nice didactic game to learn the colors.
• Aviator: develop your imagination and creativity with this fascinating minigame to launch airplanes.
• Sea: create a beautiful marine world with this wonderful game of fish.
• Pixel Art : develop spatial recognition by drawing pixel by pixel and recreating fun characters.
• Halloween Puzzles
It works perfectly in all smartphones and tablets
*** COLLECTIONS ***
★ ANIMALS (to learn the Name of Animals)
★ VEHICLES (to learn the most common means of transport)
★ ALPHABET (to learn Alphabets from A to Z)
★ NUMBERS (to learn Numbers from 0 to 10)
★ CAPYBARAS (color these cute and fun little animals)
★ GEOMETRIC FIGURES (to learn basic Geometric Figures and Space)
★ CONNECT POINTS (to learn to count,and improve motor skills)
★ CHRISTMAS (Beautiful funny coloring drawings)
★ HALLOWEEN (Funny characters that do not scare anyone)
★ DINOSAURS (know our friends from prehistory)
★ FREE MODE (unleash your imagination)
*** FEATURES ***
★ All content is 100% FREE
★ Simple design and very intuitive for children.
★ Different strokes of pencil and colors
★ Colors with flash effect (dynamic random color for endless bright colors)
★ Over 100 adorable stickers to decorate your paintings.
★ Eraser function.
★ “Undo” function and “Clear All” function.
★ Save drawings in the album to then share or edit them.

details_full_description:
Kahoot! Play & Create Quizzes
Play engaging quiz-based games (kahoots) at school, at home and at work, create your own kahoots and learn something new! Kahoot! brings the magic of learning for students, teachers, office superheroes, trivia fans and lifelong learners.
Here’s what you can do with the Kahoot! app, now available in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese and Norwegian:
Students
- Study with unlimited free flashcards and other smart study modes
- Join kahoots hosted live - in class or virtually - and use the app to submit answers
- Complete self-paced challenges
- Study at home or on the go with flashcards and other study modes
- Compete with friends in study leagues
- Challenge your friends with kahoots you found or created
- Create your own kahoots and add images or videos
- Host kahoots live for family and friends directly from your mobile device
Families and friends
- Find a kahoot on any topic, fit for any age
- Host a kahoot live by casting your screen to a big screen or screen share via video conferencing apps
- Engage your kids with studying at home
- Send a Kahoot! challenge to family members or friends
- Create your own kahoots and add different question types and image effects
Teachers
- Search among millions of ready-to-play kahoots on any topic
- Create or edit your own kahoots in minutes
- Combine different question types to increase engagement
- Host kahoots live in class or virtually for distance learning
- Assign student-paced challenges for content review
- Assess learning outcomes with reports
Company employees
- Create kahoots for e-learning, presentations, events and other occasions
- Encourage audience participation with polls and word cloud questions
- Host Kahoot! live in person or in a virtual meeting
- Assign self-paced challenges, for example, for e-learning
- Assess progress and results with reports
Premium features:
Kahoot! is free for teachers and their students, and it’s our commitment to keep it that way as part of our mission to make learning awesome. We offer optional upgrades that unlock advanced features, such as an image library with millions of images and advanced question types, such as puzzles, polls, open-ended questions and slides. To take advantage of these features, users will need a paid subscription.
To create and host kahoots in a work context, as well as get access to additional features, business users will need a paid subscription.

details_full_description:
Stop Motion Studio
Get Stop Motion Studio, the world’s easiest app to get you into stop motion moviemaking today!
With its easy-to-use interface, Stop Motion Studio lets you create beautiful movies like Wallace and Gromit or those groovy Lego shorts on YouTube. It's simple to use, deceptively powerful, and insanely fun to play with.
Stop Motion Studio is a powerful, full-featured movie editor with a whole host of features:
• A simplistic, easy-to-use interface
• Overlay mode showing the differences between frames
• Animation guides to position animated objects more easily
• Copy, paste, cut, and insert frames at any position
• Interactive timeline so you never get lost, even if you have hundreds of frames
Create beautiful movies:
• Choose from a whole lot of unique titles, credits, and text cards, or create your very own with the built-in editor
• Give your movie the perfect look with different video filters
• Enhance your movie with different foregrounds, backgrounds, aspect ratios, and fade effects
• Create a soundtrack using built-in music, sound effects, songs from your music library, or your narration
• Rotoscoping: Import video clips and create stunning animations by drawing over them.
• Green Screen: Change the background of your scene to make the figures you capture fly or appear anywhere you can imagine.
• Animation Guides: Use the animation guides editor to add gridlines, draw a marker or set up a movement path.
• Import Media: Import photos from your photo library into your movie.
• Connect a keyboard and use simple shortcuts to edit movies quickly
Capture like a pro:
• Capture with an adjustable time interval feature
• Full camera control with automatic or manual white balance, focus and exposure, ISO, and shutter speed
• Use a second device as a remote camera
Powerful, built-in layer-based image editor:
• Add text and speech bubbles or create titles
• Add facial expressions to figures
• Touch up and enhance images, sketch, and paint
• Wipe away unwanted objects with the eraser tool
• Merge frames to simulate fast movement
Share with friends and family:
• Save to your photo library or share to YouTube in 4K or 1080p
• Save as animated GIF
• Save all images for further processing
• Easily transfer projects between devices using Dropbox or Google Drive
• Start creating on your mobile device and continue right where you left off on your desktop computer
Learn to animate:
• Watch the included tutorial videos
• Read the comprehensive manual
• Use the animation tips and tricks provided
* Some features require in-app purchases. All features are included in the Pro version.

Drawing Apps is a professional drawing and canvas painting 🎨 game, it focuses on realistic drawings. You can start doodling, painting, draw on photo, paint on canvas, make picture art, photo sketch, doodle, scribble, writing, and coloring book on your phone, tab or pad.
Features:
Drawing Desk app features 5 pro digital art drawing pads: 1) Sketch Pad, 2) Kids Pad, 3) Coloring Pad (Color by Number Pad), 4) Photo Pad, and 5) Doodle Pad.
- Sketch Pad: It supports multiple layers. Pro artist sketching tools like pencil, crayons, pen, watercolor brush, fill bucket, roller, etc.
- Kids Pad: Let your kids fun with Color Fill, Fun Paint, Kids Drawing, Glow Pen, and Number Paint.
- Coloring Pad: It supports fully featured Colour Palette to draw art. Including 500+ Colouring pages of animals, alphabet, numbers, fruits for kids & adults.
- Photo Pad: Allows you to draw on any photo, with a group of brushes
- Doodle Pad: It provides you a simple pad to draw and allows you to fill color with different brush sizes and strokes.
- App works offline & online!
- Share your directly with your friends and family directly from the app.
- Additionally: The Drawing Apps provides you a simple canvas pad to draw on and allows you to fill in color.🎨 Multiple colors are provided to make your better experience. 40+ Brushes 🖌️ allow you to make various sketches. Take notes in your handwriting and save it for later reference.
Why Drawing Apps is different from other apps?
Canvas Sizes 🖼️ : You can choose from the different canvas sizes like 7 inch tablet, landscape, Portrait, iPad size, iPad PRO, Square, Large Postcard etc. you can have various options to choose from different canvas sizes.
40+ Brushes🖌️: Our unique collection of pro tools such as Pencils, Pen, Fountain Pen, Chalk, Tattoo Ink, Marker, Water Color, Pattern Brushes, Glow Brushes and many more to help kids & adults to create amazing artworks.
Ruler📏: This tool is used to make straight lines on the canvas and also you can draw line art. An extremely free and liberating technique that relies of areas of repeated lines to create light and darker areas. Ruler is great for fast sketching and is easy to create and great light to dark gradient.
Shapes⭕: Shape tool to create perfect shape without taking help of drawing tools. You can draw a straight line, a perfect circle, a square/rectangle, an oval. You can have all the tools with filled and without filled effects.
Draw on Photos📷: You can import a photo and trace the image and draw above it. That makes it a good way to draw on photos and also a decent way to learn for kids, newbies, and artists.
Text on Photos💬: Text is the all-in-one tool for text on photos creation. Texts can be added to a photo, gradient, solid color or transparent background. Text tool makes it easy to insert text to photos, be it a quote, a three-statement or wishes you want to send to someone through a photo text editor.

If you have any questions or queries, you can get in touch with our development team and will get back to you within 24 hours. Write your ideas about more drawing features and share your feedback to us at : support@drawingpad.me

Pixel Brush: Pixel Art Drawing
Pixel Brush is a pixel art creator, helping you to learn a new hobby and create merch! Unlike color by number apps, you create your own 8 bit art and use it to create merch.
This drawing app for kids and adults helps you learn to draw art! You can draw 8 and 16 bit graphics, share to the community, and gain feedback.
Import your pixel art from Aseprite into Pixel Brush, and export it back to Aseprite.
Intuitive for beginners
• Pinch to zoom and tap to draw
• Pick from professional built-in color palettes, or import one from Lospec
• Zooming in reveals a mini-preview (try dragging it around)
Animate like a pro
• Create beautiful animations with onion-skinning, then share your pixel animation as a GIF/MP4
• Speed up or slow down individual frames
• Layers let you separate elements of your art, handy for organization
Grow as an artist
• Share your pixel art with the friendly community, we'd love to see your creations!
• Create art on canvases up to 1024x1024
• Save unlimited color palettes (including 8 bit palettes)
Other features:
• Export and import Aseprite files
• No ads
• Saving happens automatically, so you can focus on your creations
• Sharp exports with no blurring
• Create Isometric lines
• You can use a mouse if you'd prefer!
Designed for easy drawing, Pixel Brush is a pixel art creator app which can help you learn how to draw and start your new hobby!
Plenty more features are coming soon, so follow on social media (links in app) and stay tuned!

details_full_description:
Beecarbonize
Do you have what it takes to save the planet? Beecarbonize is an environmental card strategy game with climate change as your opponent. Research cutting-edge technologies, enact policies, protect ecosystems, and modernize industry to cut down carbon emissions. Manage your resources well and you might survive.
ACCESSIBLE, BUT COMPLEX SIMULATION
Will you favor industrial reforms, nature conservation or people initiatives? There are many ways to solve climate change and reduce pollution. But saving the planet is not an easy task. The more carbon emissions you produce the more extreme events you will have to deal with.
STEER SOCIETY & INDUSTRY
You have to balance the power-generating industry, social reforms, ecological policies and scientific endeavors. Will you transition from fossil fuels as fast as possible? Or will you focus on carbon capture technologies first? Experiment with new strategies and don’t be afraid to start again.
235 UNIQUE CARDS
Game cards represent inventions, laws, social advancements, or industries - each designed on the basis of real-world climate science. In addition, partially randomized world events occur, forcing you to adapt your strategy. Gradually unlock new cards in the game encyclopedia and chart your path towards a new future.
IMPACTFUL EVENTS, HIGH REPLAYABILITY
The world of Beecarbonize reacts to your actions. More emissions mean more floods or heatwaves, investing in nuclear power raises the risk of a nuclear incident, and so on. Learn more with each run and you might overcome environmental catastrophes, social unrest, and even avert the end of life on earth.
Beecarbonize is a strategic challenge that lets you experience phenomena shaping our everyday lives hands-on. Just how many seasons can you last?
NEW HARDCORE MODE
We are introducing Hardcore mode, the ultimate challenge in Beecarbonize for experienced players. In Hardcore mode you will face the harsh reality of climate change. Can you defy the odds and save the planet even in this extreme scenario?
ABOUT
The game was developed in cooperation with leading climate experts from NGO People in Need as a part of the 1Planet4All project financed by the European Union.

details_full_description:
neolexon Artikulationsstörung
neolexon articulation app
The neolexon app offers kindergarten and elementary school children with pronunciation disorders a varied opportunity to practice correct pronunciation.
The motivating digital training can be used as a supplement to regular speech therapy at home or can be used directly in speech therapy sessions. With the playfully designed app, practicing is now a lot of fun!
✅ Highest quality standards: The app is registered as a medical product, meets data protection requirements in accordance with the GDPR and was developed by academic speech therapists.
✅ Free for most insured people: Over 75 health insurance companies reimburse the costs of the articulation app. Further information: neolexon.de/kostenvergleich
✅ Can be individually configured by therapists: This means that every phonological process and every phonetic disorder can be treated precisely.
✅ Extensive content: With 26 phonetic symbol cards and over 860 child-friendly words as well as 1,500 syllables/nonsense words, the app covers the entire phonetic inventory of German.
✅ 7 training modules include exercises from perception to production; Auditory identification of sounds and their position in the word as well as sound production at the word, sentence and text level (see below for details).
✅ Adventure Book: The words and stories produced are saved in the app's Adventure Book so that feedback can be provided in the next therapy session.
✅ Animated games: The exercises are designed to be appealing and entertaining for children.
✅ Motivation system: Children receive positive visual and auditory feedback when they answer correctly. With coins won, children can redesign the app's main character with new hairstyles and costumes.
7 different modules:
1. Library module: A magical library urgently needs to be cleaned up. Lots of sheets with different things on them are flying around and need to be sorted. The magic book only likes sounds, syllables or words that contain a certain sound (e.g. /s/ in cup).
2. Volcano module (with integrated sound symbol cards): In a landscape with magical volcanoes, stones must be thrown into the correct volcano to make the volcanoes glow. Only stones with sounds, syllables or words that contain a certain sound (e.g. /s/ in cup) are allowed into the volcanoes.
3. Cable car module: Lino has to clear the cable car correctly so that it can deliver to the hut on the mountain. To do this, sounds in the syllable/word must be heard correctly and the packages then sorted.
4. Parrot module: The parrot Kiki can learn to speak by having the child say many sounds/syllables/words to him and he parroting them back. The speech therapist can then check whether the child has spoken and recorded everything correctly.
5. Airport module (with integrated sound symbol cards): The child should help Lino at the airport to sort things back into the correct suitcase and say what he has packed. Only then can the plane take off. All recordings are saved in the adventure book and can then be listened to and evaluated by the speech therapist.
6. Camera module: The child should use their device camera to photograph things in their everyday life that contain a certain sound, then speak and record them. All recordings are saved in the adventure book and can then be evaluated by the speech therapist.
7. Grandfather module: On his travels, Lino took a lot of photos and tells his grandpa little nonsense stories about them, which are saved in the adventure book. Between 1-5 images can be displayed, all containing the target sound.
Does your child like the app? Then we would be happy about 5 stars :)
Please feel free to send your requests and feedback to info@neolexon.de!

Critters Club, they are dedicated to the task of discovering new

My Child HelpLine
Welcome to the MyChild HelpLine App - a mobile application which provides direct access to mental health and psychosocial support. It provides children with an array of child-friendly resources conveniently available in the palm of their hands. Available in En/Es/Fr/Du, the app connects its users to child protection support services, including direct access to national toll-free hotlines, developmentally appropriate resources and interactive activities.
UNICEF Office for the Eastern Caribbean Area (ECA) scaled up the MyChildLine app, now called “MyChild Helpline app” to cover four (4) additional countries out of the twelve (12) countries and overseas territories covered under the office’s Multi-Country Programme. The app is now available in St. Vincent and the Grenadines, Antigua and Barbuda, Barbados and Grenada.
App Features -
- National toll-free helpline numbers in their specific country
- Access live chat features and tele-counselling services
- Child-friendly avatars for selection by users
- Use location aware search for child related services in country
- Mood tracker
- Password protected diary
- Access information in English, Spanish, Dutch and French
- View information of children’s rights
- Interactive games
For more information download this app.

details_full_description:
Moonzy. Kids Mini-Games
New educational mini-games with Moonzy (Luntik) and his friends!
This game contains 9 educational mini-games for kids:
1 - Connect the Dots
On the screen shows one of the funny heroes of cartoon Moonzy and his friends and disappears, a child needs to cut around the image, connect all stars. When the task is done - you will see a new picture with Luntik and his friends.
2 - Coloring
For some time, appears a coloring cartoon hero and then he disappeared all colors. You need to coloring the Luntik cartoon hero as he was coloring before. If in the course of the game you have any difficulty, use the hint, for this click the button "?"
3 - Mixing colors
Moonzy have bucket of paint, help him to create the exact same color. You must mixing colors. Add additional paint in an empty bucket, mixing colors and see what color you get. Fascinating educational mini-game for kids in which the child learns by mixing different colors to create the desired color.
4 - Pairs
The classic game of "Pairs". Game rules are very simple: on the screen shows all pictures for a while and then the pictures appear flipped, your task is to look for a pair of images, when they opened two identical pictures - they disappear. And so it is necessary to find all pairs. With each level of complexity increases. Try our pairs with funny Luntik.
5 - Mosaic
The screen shows image and disappears. The kids must repeat the pattern, put it out of colored mosaics. For tips, click on the button "?"
6 - Picture scratch
Game for the youngest - picture scratch. On the hidden image, to see what is shown in the picture - it is necessary to scratch the layer that hides it.
7 - Puzzles "Association"
Logic game for children from 2 years. In this game the child must be properly decomposed images into place using associative intuition. Available 3 types of games: decomposed images by color, by patterns or figures. The game is very interesting, although it is more difficult than others.
8 - 3D Puzzles.
Collect exciting 3D puzzles that consist of 3D blocks. Rotate the blocks in different directions so as to obtain the desired picture.
9 - Merry tunes.
Musical games for kids. In this mini game you need to collect the classic tunes from the smaller segments. On the playing field of the tunes are arranged. Listen to each part separately and assemble the famous tune.
At the beginning of the game is available 3 mini-games, for each completed assignment you get 10 coins. To open the 4 game should gather up 100 coins, 5 - 150 Coins, 6 - 200 coins, 7 - 300 coins etc.
All mini-games contain a lot of funny heroes of cartoon Moonzy and his friends. Cheerful atmosphere and good mood you and your child are provided.
Enjoy the new game "Moonzy. Kids mini-games"

Chess Tactics for Beginners
This course is based on a bestseller by the experienced coach Sergey Ivashchenko which became a sort of chess publishing sensation and sold over 200,000 copies. details_full_description:
BABY born® Doll & Playtime Fun
Explore the little ones’ home and enjoy a wonderful day together. Take good care of your BABY born, dress them in cute outfits, and play with them. Lots of fun for all doll parents!
DISCOVER BABY BORN’S WORLD
• Choose a doll and go on a journey of discovery—BABY born’s house has many exciting rooms for you to explore.
• Check out all the cute clothes in the closet. Use the weather duck on top of the closet to choose what the weather will be for your doll today, and pick a matching outfit!
• Feel like seeing the great outdoors? There’s lots to discover outside the house too!
TAKE GOOD CARE OF YOUR BABY BORN
• Take care of your BABY born just like a real baby and give them everything they need.
• Is your baby hungry? Then go to the kitchen and feed them baby food or give them a bottle.
• Change your doll’s diaper or sit them on the potty.
• Brush your little one’s teeth: brushing baby’s teeth is even more exciting with the fun toothbrushing song!
• Bubbles everywhere during bath time!Put your doll in the bathtub in the evening, lather them up well, and carefully rinse them down with the showerhead.
• Watch a picture story together with your baby when it’s time to go to sleep. Then it’s nighty-night after a fun-packed day!
PLAY WITH YOUR BABY BORN
• Discover puzzles and painting in the playroom.
• Tricky jigsaw puzzles with cute BABY born designs await you.
• No matter if you’re coloring pictures or drawing freehand, things never get boring here!
• And when you’re done playing, it’s time to tidy up. Can you find BABY born’s five animal friends?
If you like the app, we’d love to hear your review in the comments!
The Blue Ocean team wishes you lots of fun playing!
THINGS FOR PARENTS TO KNOW
• The app contains the original products from Zapf.
• Children care for their BABY born in fun minigames. There are also cute picture stories, a toothbrushing song, puzzles, and coloring games to keep your little ones entertained.
• The games support, inspire, and encourage children in a playful manner.
• The parental controls allow you to limit your children’s playtime to a certain number of actions.
• The app does not require any reading skills to be played.
• The toothbrushing song and picture stories can be enjoyed in 13 different languages.
• We value quality and product safety.
• The app is free; it is ad-supported. However, the ads can be removed via in-app purchase.

EVERYTHING KIDS LOVE!
Lingokids is the ultimate destination for kids fun without compromise. The platform offers more than 4000 interactive games, songs, and shows loved by kids and trusted by grown-ups around the world. Designed to be ad-free and age-appropriate, Lingokids delivers a premium, handcrafted experience that’s KidSAFE certified, with learning by default.
LINGOKIDS NOW HAS DISNEY ACTIVITIES!
Your kid can now play brand-new Disney Mickey & Friends, Disney Zootopia, Marvel Spider-man, Disney Pixar Cars, Disney Lilo & Stitch, Disney Pixar Toy Story, Disney Marvel Avengers, Disney Moana and Disney Frozen-themed activities. All fun, all edutaining—and all on the Playlearning™ app kids love!
From math to literacy to creativity, help your kid practice at their own pace with activities featuring beloved characters. Because when activities are this edutaining, they become something your kid truly loves!
5 REASONS LINGOKIDS IS GUILT-FREE FOR FAMILIES
Made by parents & educators
Loved by toddlers, preschoolers, and elementary school kids
kidSAFE® certified & 100% ad-free
More than 30 global awards
Over 4000 fun kids games and activities to play!
INTERACTIVE ACTIVITIES
Your kids can explore over 4000 interactive games, coloring games, and toddler-friendly challenges covering 650+ learning objectives—all through play! Subjects include math, literacy, science, engineering, art, music, and more. Kids can move at their own pace through a curated curriculum using fun toddler games, books, videos, and songs. Perfect games for your 2,3,4,5,6,7,8 year olds!
PLAYLEARNING™ METHOD
At Lingokids, we believe learning sticks when it’s wrapped in fun. Our Playlearning™ method inspires toddlers and kids to discover the world naturally—through play, repetition, and curiosity. From coloring and games to movement, stories, and songs, every interaction builds real skills.
FEATURED BRANDS & CHARACTERS
Your kids can play with familiar favorites like Blippi and Pocoyo. Plus, brand-new activities featuring beloved Disney characters all available inside the Lingokids app. And discover activities created with trusted names like NASA and Oxford University Press.
Many families may already know Lingokids from our videos on YouTube and YouTube Kids, where over 3 million subscribers enjoy our playful, edutaining content. Now, those same kids can keep learning through fun toddler games and interactive activities.
SUBJECTS, THEMES & LEVELS THAT GROW WITH YOUR CHILD
Reading & Literacy: Build phonics, writing, and reading confidence.
Math & Engineering: Strengthen number sense, addition, subtraction, and logical thinking.
Science & Tech: Introduce biology, chemistry, coding, robotics and NASA-powered activities.
Music & Art: Play with rhythm, sound, and creativity in music + coloring games.
Social-Emotional Learning: Practice empathy, expression, and mindfulness.
History & Geography: Spark curiosity about the world and its stories.
Physical Activity: Fun stretches, yoga, and movement songs keep toddlers engaged!
WHY UPGRADE TO LINGOKIDS PLUS?
Unlimited access to 4000+ toddler games, coloring games, and activities
Covers 650+ learning goals across subjects and life skills
Expert-designed lessons for boys and girls aged 2–8
Lingokids activities featuring Disney, Blippi, Pocoyo, NASA and Oxford University Press content

100% ad-free, with no in-app purchases

Lost in Play is a journey through childhood imagination with thoughtfully crafted puzzles and colorful characters. Play as a brother and sister duo on an adventure to find their way back home. details_full_description:
Happy Kids Timer Chores
Make the back to school transition smooth and encourage children to be independent
Happy Kids Timer is a simple to use visual timer app for children which helps them complete their morning or bedtime chores easily and on schedule.
This chore app is totally operated by your child, who carries the mobile device to each area/room where the daily task needs to be carried out/completed. You should give this game a try, if your child or teenager deals with ADHD/autism or needs to improve time management or following your busy daily schedule.
Why kids will love chores
The app offers a totally new approach that guides your kids with animated chores through their morning or bedtime turning chores into a funny educational game. It utilizes a smart incentive daily program with awards and a printable certificate. You don’t need old-fashioned chore chart anymore!
Smooth back to school transition
Do you struggle every morning to have your children get ready to face a long day at school? With Happy Kids Visual Timer app bedtime doesn't have to be challenging either.
If the visual timer just helps get you through a few mornings, makes putting kids to bed an enjoyable experience, or make back to school transition easier our mission will have been accomplished, but our experience indicates children love it and will use it for months.
On Demand activity
Select just one chore from the list anytime without a need to go through the entire routine, e. g. brush your teeth after lunch, or go to the toilet to use the app as a potty training timer.
Morning routine
Contains 8 animated chores for kids that will learn them to: Make your bed, Brush your teeth and wash your hands, Get dressed, Brush you hair, Eat your breakfast, Pack your lunch box, Pack your bag, Put your shoes on
Bedtime routine
Contains 7 animated chores for kids that will learn them to: Tidy your room, Go to the toilet, Take a shower or bath, Put on your pajamas, Brush your teeth, Prepare your clothes for tomorrow, Read a book, turn the lights off and go to sleep
The app includes common morning and bedtime activities and great motivation features and help kids learn new habits.
Premium version
The basic version guides your child through the whole morning or bedtime routines with predefined settings. Please consider a premium version to unlock all the feature and make this motivational chore app more flexible. Children will have fun and get through their routines on time.
With the single in-app purchase you willbe able to:
– add 4 custom chores with your own activity picture for each routine or change chores order to better fit your home habits,
– change duration or minimal activity duration time to better motivate kid,
– remove countdown timer to reveal stress from kids with autism or ADHD,
– name the reward you want your child to receive,
– define target stars amount for kid to deserve an reward,
– email/print a certificate after kids collected a defined amount of stars,
– and more.
Visit us
We are an open parents' community, making sure our children use smart devices not just to play games. This visual timer app was made by parents and tested on our own preschool kids and toddlers.
Visit us on Twitter, Facebook or Instagram. Tell us your story, suggest improvements or learn new parenting tips.

🎓 Academic Readiness for Middle School (Grades 6-8)
Prepare students for advanced education with rigorous study tools designed for higher-level independent thinking.
🔬 Advanced STEM Content: Comprehensive modules in biology, physics, algebraic thinking, and geometric equations.
💬 Language & Writing Proficiency: Vocabulary training, foreign language modules, and complex reading comprehension tasks to prepare pre-teens for high school.

Deepens knowledge in core subjects like ELA and Math through interactive exercises, customized vocabulary lists, and immediate feedback loops.
🥇 Middle School Excellence

Dinosaur Farm Games for kids
Embark on a prehistoric adventure with Dinosaur Farm – an enthralling and educational game specially crafted for preschoolers and toddlers. This unique game merges the fascinating world of dinosaurs with traditional farm activities, providing a distinctive and engaging preschool education experience through interactive learning games.
Key Features of Dinosaur Farm:
• Educational Games: Dinosaur Farm combines fun with educational content, allowing children to explore a world where dinosaurs and farming coexist.
• Preschool Education Reinvented: Designed for children aged 2-5, this game introduces basic concepts of farming and dinosaur knowledge in an interactive environment.
• Animal Games for Kids with a Dinosaur Twist: Unlike traditional farm games, kids will interact with dinosaurs, learning about these magnificent creatures while understanding the importance of care for animals.
• Unique Farm Games: Children get to participate in farming activities alongside dinosaurs, offering a blend of learning and excitement.
• Innovative Tractor Games: Drive a tractor in a prehistoric setting, engaging in construction games that are both educational and immensely fun.
• Tailored Games for Toddlers: Dinosaur Farm is perfectly suited for toddlers, introducing them to the basics of farming and paleontology in a captivating way.
• Learning Games: The game encourages learning through play, making complex concepts like paleontology and agriculture accessible and enjoyable for young minds.
• Child-Friendly Gameplay: With an intuitive interface, Dinosaur Farm is easy and safe for children to play.
• Offline Games for Access Anywhere: Playable without an internet connection, this game is great for entertainment on the go.
• Brain Games for Cognitive Development: Over 30 interactive animations stimulate young brains, making learning about dinosaurs and farming engaging and effective.
• Ad-Free for Uninterrupted Learning: Enjoy a safe, focused environment with no third-party ads.
• A New Angle on Learning Through Play: Dinosaur Farm offers a unique approach to learning, combining the intrigue of dinosaurs with the practicality of farming.
Parents, use Dinosaur Farm as a tool to discuss topics like environmental stewardship, the history of life on Earth, and the basics of agriculture. It's more than just a game; it's a comprehensive educational journey into a world where prehistoric creatures and modern farming techniques coexist. Let your children's imagination and knowledge grow with Dinosaur Farm!

4 In A Row Board Game Connect
Four in a row - Board game for two people.
The goal of this tactical game is to connect at least 4 tokens of the same color in a row (horizontal, vertical or diagonal).
You can play, without wifi (offline), against the computer or with another person on the same device.
You can also play this game online and challenge your family, friends or connected people around the world with the multiplayer mode. You'll need internet connection (wifi) for this.
How to play this board game ?
You can play this game in 3 modes :
1 Player mode allows you to play against the computer. The difficulty increase with the level.
2 Players mode allows you to play with another player on the same device.
Online multiplayer mode allows you to play with an other player connected. The winner is the player who wins 2 rounds.
1 point is awarded for each rounds gained.
If your opponent quit the game or if he is offline before the end of the game then you'll gain 1 additional point.
This is a free board game that contains advertisements that you can remove with an in-app purchase.
Be strategic and above all have fun !!

details_full_description:
BabyTV - Kids Videos & Songs
Join millions of families and discover BabyTV’s award-winning kids videos and nursery rhymes app, designed for little ones and 100% ad-free! BabyTV is the world’s leading TV channel for babies, toddlers and their parents, created to support preschool children in their early years. Our app offers quality kids’ videos in a safe, child-friendly environment, introducing your little one to the world around them with BabyTV’s beloved characters and educational content.
Age Rating
Perfect for toddlers and kids aged 5 & under, and BabyTV fans of all ages.
Kids Videos
Our app features hundreds of kids videos, including nursery rhymes, baby songs, and baby cartoon videos. Enjoy full episodes of BabyTV shows like "Charlie and the Numbers," "Billy Bam Bam," "The BabyTV Jungle Book," "Oliver," and more!
All-time Favorite Kids Songs & Nursery Rhymes
Enjoy all your favorite nursery rhymes and kids songs, such as "Morning Song," "Brother John," "Down by the Bay," and "Little Green Frog." Sing along with BabyTV’s top songs like "The Tiny Bunch," "ABC’s and 123’s," "Shapes Song with Charlie," and more.
Relaxing & Bedtime Content
Our bedtime series includes relaxing baby videos and songs to help your little ones sleep peacefully. Explore popular content such as "BabyTV Relaxing Videos," "BabyTV Songs for Sleep," and calming shows with soothing episodes your child will love.
Toddler Games & Fun Activities
Our app includes toddler games that introduce early concepts in a fun way. Help your child discover colors with Oliver, explore different animals with Lola, and recognize shapes and numbers with Charlie. Our games ensure your child is entertained while discovering new things.
Watch Offline
Download videos and watch offline at home or on the go!
Create Your Own Playlist
Quickly and easily create a playlist with your child's favorite episodes and songs for quick access. Use shuffle mode to enjoy a variety of content.
Why BabyTV is Great for Kids Ages 5 & Under:
100% ad-free, kid-safe environment
Created with experts for quality kids videos and content
Download videos to watch offline
Hours of fun episodes, baby songs, and relaxing bedtime content
Trusted characters and cartoons suitable for all ages
New content added weekly
Available in 15 languages (English, Spanish, Mandarin, Dutch, Polish, French & more)
Subscription
This service is offered as a renewed paid subscription over these plans:
Monthly Subscription - $5.99
6 Month Subscription - $29.99 (Save 1 Month!)
12 Month Subscription - $59.99 (Save 2 Months!)
Privacy & Safety
Your child’s privacy and safety is our top priority. That’s why there are no ads in our toddler & preschool kids’ TV app or on our channel. We will never share your personal information with 3rd parties or sell it. For more information, visit https://www.babytv.com/privacy-policy.

details_full_description:
Big Questions Quiz Game
Big Questions is a quiz game with content from Oxford University Press. Play on your own or against your friends in an exciting multiplayer contest that tests your knowledge. Choose your favourite topics and prove you're the best at answering questions!
FEATURES
• Designed by language learning specialists
• Interactive quiz game that tests your skills using text, images, audio and speech
• Hundreds of questions across 16 topics: numbers, colours, time, school, people, home, food & drink, animals, things, free time, health, travel, technology, environment, science and lucky dip (a variety of topics)
• Choice of three ability levels to suit the language level of the learner: Easy, Medium, Hard
• Suitable for use in the classroom, at home or on-the-go
• Single-player or Multiplayer mode using one device
• Unique voice recognition technology for pronunciation practice
• Safe environment
• No third-party advertisements
• Buy once and get access on all devices
BENEFITS FOR YOUR CHILD
• Frequent and flexible English practice when it suits the learner
• Playful learning with fun and challenging activities
• Development of listening and reading skills, as well as opportunities for improving pronunciation and spelling
SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
• Big Questions has a subscription service that offers full, unlimited access to the app's questions, topics, levels and updates!
• New selected questions added each 3 months
• Without a subscription or an expired subscription, users have access to a few selected topics and questions only
• Subscriptions are renewed once a month
• Your subscription is valid on any device registered to your Big Questions account
• Payment is charged from your Google account when your purchase is confirmed
• Your subscription is renewed automatically unless you disable automatic renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period
• Next month's payment will be charged 24 hours before the end of the current billing period
• To manage your subscription or disable automatic renewal, open your user settings page after your purchase
• The cost of the current month's subscription cannot be refunded, and service cannot be stopped in the middle of a billing period
• Any free trial, as applicable, will be interrupted when a paid subscription is purchased

Pepi City: Hospital Life
Welcome to Pepi City, the ultimate city life game where imagination never ends. Explore a colorful world, design your own avatars, and dive into locations packed with surprises. In this avatar life world, you decide how every story unfolds—no limits, only freedom to create and play! This is the perfect kids game for anyone who loves role-play, creativity, and endless stories in a vibrant city life adventure.
🏥 HOSPITAL
Step into the hospital and explore a buzzing city center of doctors, nurses, and patients in this interactive city life game. From x-rays to playful treatments, every tool and room is interactive. Kids can role-play as a doctor, nurse, or avatar patient, turning every visit to the Hospital into new stories across the Pepi City world.
👶 BABY HOSPITAL
The Baby Hospital is full of newborns, caring parents, and sweet adventures, making it one of the most loved places in the Pepi City world. Feed, weigh, and comfort every baby while inventing heartwarming city life stories. Dress baby avatars in blankets, use real tools, and discover what it means to be a caring doctor in Pepi’s world. It’s the coziest spot in Pepi City, perfect for kids to explore empathy, joy, and create their own stories in this fun kids game. Every baby avatar becomes part of the city life adventures!
🛒 BABY SHOP
Visit the Baby Shop, a playful area of the city filled with clothes, toys, and surprises. Mix and match to create fresh outfits for your avatars or turn shopping into a fashion show. Try new accessories, style your baby avatars, and make every shopping trip an unforgettable city life moment. In this kids game, every choice sparks creativity and adds fun twists to your avatar life stories.
🏠 HOUSE
Everyday life becomes extraordinary in the House. Cook delicious meals, throw parties, decorate rooms, or just chill with friends, pets, and babies. Each corner is fully interactive and perfect for kids to reimagine routines or invent completely new stories. In Pepi City, even simple family tasks—like feeding a baby or calling a doctor—turn into exciting city role-play that makes this city life game unforgettable.
🎭 CREATE AVATARS
Your world, your rules, your avatars! Use the avatar editor to create families, neighbors, squads, or even baby characters. With endless outfits and styles, every avatar is ready to shine in your unique avatar life story. Build a cast of doctors, parents, and friends who bring Pepi City to life with personality and humor. This is where kids can freely create stories and experiment in a safe, colorful world.
✨ YOUR CITY, YOUR STORY
Pepi City is more than just a game—it’s a living world where imagination drives every moment. Maybe today you’re running the hospital as a busy doctor, tomorrow you’re shopping for baby clothes, and the next day you’re hosting the wildest house party. With colorful avatars, hundreds of items, and limitless freedom to create, every play session in this city life adventure feels brand new. For every kids game fan, it’s the perfect way to explore, play, and invent endless stories. Pepi City is your world—create city life adventures with avatars any way you imagine.
Jump in, explore, and start your journey—your Pepi City avatar life begins now!

details_full_description:
ABC Kids - Tracing & Phonics
Looking for a fun, free, and simple educational app to help your toddler learn phonics and trace letters of the alphabet? Look no further than ABC Kids.
ABC Kids is a free phonics and alphabet teaching app that makes learning fun for children, from toddlers all the way to preschoolers and kindergartners. It features a series of tracing games to help kids recognize letter shapes, associate them with phonic sounds, and put their alphabet knowledge to use in fun matching exercises. Any toddler, kindergartener or preschool age child can learn English and the English alphabet simply by following the arrows with their finger. They can even collect stickers and toys as they complete tracing games!
ABC Kids is more than just a kid-friendly educational app, it was designed with adult participation in mind, too. The interface keeps toddlers focused on alphabet reading and writing, tucking menu commands away from moving fingers. Adults can easily access settings to engage Teacher Mode, look at report cards, or toggle tracing and phonics games to better facilitate learning.
Best of all, ABC Kids is full-featured and free from in-app purchases and third party advertisements. Toddlers and adults can enjoy learning together without interruption.
Features:
- A colorful early education app that helps children learn the English alphabet.
- Includes ABC tracing games, phonics pairing, letter matching, and more.
- Uppercase and lowercase letters to trace, listen to, and match.
- Smart interface helps kids focus on phonics and letters without accidentally exiting the game.
- No third party ads, no in-app purchases, no tricks. Just pure educational fun!
Note to Parents:
When creating ABC Kids, we wanted to build the best experience possible for both adults and for children. We're parents ourselves, and we know how paywalls, in-app purchases, and intrusive third party advertisements can detract from the learning experience. With ABC Kids, we put the features of a paid app into a preschool friendly package, leaving out frustrating pop-ups and microtransactions. The end result is exactly the educational experience we want for our children. We think you and your family will enjoy it!
- Best wishes from the parents at RV AppStudios

📊🏅 Want to discover and improve your strengths? Then download MentalUP and improve your skills with educational games, IQ tests, and live events while tracking your progress daily.
EDUCATIONAL GAMES APP RECOMMENDED BY TEACHERS👨‍🏫👩‍🏫
MentalUP has brain training games, an IQ test, and fun activities for kids you have never seen!
LEARNING GAMES FOR AGES 4-13 YEARS OLD, BRAIN TEASERS, IQ TESTS, MENTAL HEALTH, ADHD GAMES, TODDLERS, KINDERGARTNERS, AND PRESCHOOLERS!
MentalUP offers learning games for all ages in a fun way to support academic success at school. It also has a fantastic GYM inside to encourage kids to get fit and improve their bodies.
With MentalUP, strengthen your mind with 20 minutes of online brain training and give your body a 7-minute workout. Then take an IQ test, join live events, or track your progress.
BRAIN GAMES, ACTIVITIES, EVENTS, AND COMPETITIONS FOR KIDS
Embark on an exciting journey! Play brain games for 4-13-year-olds, participate in events to compete, challenge yourself with competitions, and become the next champion.
ALL THE GOOD STUFF THAT COMES FROM BRAIN GAMES FOR KIDS
Regularly solving MentalUP Riddles & Brain Teasers will:
🧐 Improve attention
🎯 Strengthen focus and concentration
🌄 Improve memory and learning ability
📚 Build up visual and linguistic skills
🧮 Improve arithmetic skills with math games
🗯️ Develop problem-solving and logic skills
SUPPORT YOUR KIDS’ LEARNING JOURNEY
MentalUP provides a reliable, age-appropriate learning program that complements any lesson plan. Kids can learn independently with brain training exercises, logic puzzles, logic problems, mind games, memory games, and maths games. 🧩
PRACTICE, PLAY, AND PREPARE
MentalUP makes it easy to practice and prepare for the next grades. Because all the brain training and attention exercises are designed as games, MentalUP can also help you test and improve your child's IQ score! 🧠
FREE MATHS GAMES FOR KIDS AGED 4-12
Give your child a head start with MentalUP Maths Games made by Teachers. Our fun maths game collections cover topics from addition, fractions, and multiplication to measurement. You'll have everything you need for maths practice in grades 1-6. 🎉
ONE ACCOUNT FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
MentalUP support family plan lets you and two kids train, track, and grow together! 🥳 It doesn't matter their grade; one account will be okay for the whole family!
Learning has never been so fun and educational for 1st to 6th-grade kids! 🎒 1st-grade, 2nd-grade, 3rd-grade, 4th-grade, 5th-grade, and 6th-grade learning games are waiting for you at MentalUP. 🕹️
Are you looking for brain teasers for adults? They, too, can benefit from these fantastic games and exercises!
TRAIN YOUR MIND WITH YOUR BODY
Discover the world's first fitness app designed for kids! 🏃‍♂️🏃‍♀️ MentalUP has a great collection of GYM fitness exercises for kids. Any child, and even adults, can do our fun fitness workouts in just seven minutes. Plus, you won't need any equipment.
KEY FEATURES OF MENTALUP KID GAMES
🎮 Educational games for 1st grade, 2nd grade, 3rd grade, and 4th grade: Brain test for your child with over 150 brain teasers designed by scientists.
🎂 Age appropriate: There are educational games for 2-year-olds, 3-year-olds, 4-year-olds, 5-year-olds, 6-year-olds, and even adults!

📊 Performance reports: Track your children's progress and compare their performance with their peers.

Dreamscape, powered by Shoelace Learning, combines the strategy and engagement of popular base-building games with imaginative reading passages and interactive questions to create a fun skill comprehension game! details_full_description:
Baby Dino Piano:Kids Piano Fun
Introducing casual games Baby Dino Piano, a kids piano browser game paradise 🎹 that artistically weaves music 🎵 and kids’ deep-root fascination for dinosaurs 🦕! Our kids piano games translate the charm of childhood browser games into a unique musical journey of piano, making it a perfect kids piano browser game for children exploring their musical talents. Featuring an adorably designed dinosaur, Baby Dino Piano cultivates a child’s interest in music and instruments 🎷.
Baby Dino Piano’s gameplay is intriguing, yet simple, making this kids piano browser game perfect for kids who enjoy casual browser games. Unleash your inner maestro, swipe the screen 🖐 to flatten music notes, and play rhythmically across the colorful dino piano 🎹 in this browser game. Immerse yourself in the magic of dino piano sounds that blend various instruments beautifully. Experience joy through the creation of music by producing different sounds and melodies.🎼
This kids piano browser game introduces four interest-provoking modes- Instruments🎷, Songs🎵, Sound Playback, and Creative Play. Each browser game mode in the Baby Dino Piano is an avenue to stimulate your memory, listening, and focus, and ignite vivid creativity 🎨. Instruments mode is an invitation to explore a wide range of exhilarating dino instrument sounds. In Songs mode, players can jam to nursery rhymes and tunes on their dino piano. Sound Playback allows you to record and replay the unique music you produce. Creative Play aids your journey into the composition of original, inventive music.
Each level in Baby Dino Piano browser games is a journey through the dinosaur world, unlocking exciting features. The kids piano browser games employ high distinction sounds of real instruments, enhancing the authenticity of the casual games experience. Clear instructions take you through all phases, making Baby Dino Piano user-friendly across all ages.
Step into the shiny shoes of a dinosaur roaring with rhythm and charisma. It’s an enchanted journey through the world of dinosaur music, where kids piano comes to life in Baby Dino Piano browser games! It lets kids tap, swipe, and engage interactively with musical dinosaurs, aiding in the development of fine motor skills. This perfect blend of a dino piano and creative browser games is set to win hearts. From kids to adults, Baby Dino Piano’s offer a musical escape. So get ready for a spectacularly musical journey with Baby Dino Piano! This browser game aims to sow the seeds of music love and inspire a lifelong passion for it.
Baby Dino Piano fully understands the importance of protecting children. We strictly abide by relevant privacy regulations and strive to create a safe and comfortable gaming space for kids. If you would like to learn about our privacy policy, please feel free to browse our official website:

details_full_description:
Monster Maker
Create amazing and funny characters, your own mascot, a movie Monster , or maybe minions of heroes or your favorite villains.
Or if you prefer to take a selfie and turn yourself into funny monsters by applying eyes, mouth and fun accessories! And why not do it with your friends or pets?
Use your creativity and imagination to build characters part by part. And choose the background you want. Create as many monsters as you want, there are thousands of possible combinations!
Imagine them, create them, save them and share them with your friends and family through WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook and all your favorite social networks.
PROMOTES CREATIVITY
This is a fun game for the whole family, where children can share time with their parents or family and play at being creative.
The different combinations of bodies, eyes, noses and mouths, complementing them with fun accessories such as hats, mustaches, glasses and many other things, allow to create infinite facial expressions, such as happy, angry and surprised, among others.
HOW TO USE
- Select a background.
- Select a body or take a picture of a landscape or object or take a selfie.
- add eyes, mouth and place accessories (glasses, hats, horns, wigs, bows, among many options).
- If you want to delete an object, drag it to the garbage basket and Ready !. You can also press the basket to remove all objects.
- You can enlarge or shrink each object by touching it repeatedly.
- Save your creations in the album to see them or share them at any time.
- Share your monsters on Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, Instagram, email or share it through the most popular social networks.
CHARACTERISTICS
- Beautiful colorful designs that will delight big and small.
- Intuitive and easy to use for all ages.
- Content totally free!

details_full_description:
Word Search for Kids
🧩 Word Search for Kids – Fun & Educational Word Puzzles for Young Learners!
Looking for a word search game that’s both fun and educational? Word Search for Kids is designed specifically for children aged 4 and up, offering a playful way to improve vocabulary, spelling, and reading skills while keeping them fully engaged.
With a colorful interface, clear navigation, and a wide variety of modes, this app adapts to different reading levels and learning styles. Whether your child is just starting to recognize letters or already comfortable with words, this app offers a supportive and exciting learning experience that grows with them.
🎮 Game Modes for Every Learning Style:
The app offers multiple game modes tailored to diverse abilities:
• Quick Game – Jump into a random word puzzle instantly.
• Custom Game – Choose vocabulary categories, grid size, visibility, and difficulty.
• One Word Mode – Focus on one word at a time; ideal for young learners.
• Repeat Word Mode – Reinforce word recognition through repetition.
• Image Mode – Match the word to a picture; great for visual learners.
• Audio Mode – Hear the word and find it; perfect for auditory learners.
• Hidden Words Mode – Hide the word list for added difficulty.
• Movie Mode – Complete themed puzzles and guess which movie they reference.
These varied options help children develop cognitive and language skills in ways that suit their preferred style of learning.
📚 Vocabulary Categories Included:
Help your child learn useful vocabulary with word lists across popular themes:
• Animals
• Food
• Body Parts
• Professions
• Musical Instruments
• Transportation
• House
• School
• Sports
All categories include age-appropriate words, carefully selected to support early literacy and language development.
🧠 Why Kids (and Parents) Love This App:
• Boosts reading comprehension and spelling
• Builds vocabulary with context and repetition
• Strengthens concentration, focus, and memory
• Encourages independent learning and exploration
• Appeals to visual, auditory, and kinesthetic learners
• Ideal for ESL students to practice word recognition
• Great for classrooms, road trips, or at-home play
👪 Kid-Friendly Design
Designed with children in mind, the app features bright visuals, big letters, intuitive buttons, and joyful animations. Kids can easily navigate through the app on their own, and modes like Image and Audio make it accessible even for pre-readers.
🔧 Adaptable Difficulty & Customization
Choose from small or large grids, hide or show the word list, and adjust the difficulty level to match your child’s needs. You can also combine categories and control word visibility for a more dynamic experience.
The Custom Game option allows full control over each session—whether you're looking for a quick challenge or a focused learning tool.
🎬 Bonus: Movie Puzzle Mode!
Let your child dive into puzzles inspired by family-friendly movies. After all the words are found, they get to guess which movie the puzzle is based on. It's a clever way to encourage storytelling, recall, and deduction—all while having fun.
🔒 Safe and Secure for Kids
• No hidden fees
• No ads
• No external links or chat features
• Works offline—no internet required
📥 Download Word Search for Kids today and turn screen time into learning time! Whether your child is just beginning to read or is already a word search enthusiast, this app will keep them learning, thinking, and smiling.

details_full_description:
Frritt-Flacc, by Jules Verne
• Frritt-Flacc was the only digital book among the top 10 books of 2016, according to the Unesco Lecture Chair
• Frrit-Flacc is an interactive book that shows how biology can solve the great challenges of the planet!
Download "Frrit-Flacc" to find a universal short story by Jules Verne (translated to English, Spanish, and Portuguese), information on the Sustainable Development Goals - the sustainability goals from United Nations -, science experimentation activities, and reflection and social action activities suggested by experienced teachers and scientists.
"Frrit-Flacc" is an scary short story that proposes a reflection on social difference and poverty by presenting the selfish Dr. Trifulgas - a doctor who only serves the rich - and show what destiny reserved for him.
The engaging narrative, full of interactivity and sound effects that completes the story, invites the youths to reflect on ODS 1 (no poverty) and how biology can collaborate to reduce poverty in the world.
Scientists from Novozymes Latin America created step-by-step instructions for you to make a mini biogas station and turn organic waste into gas or electric energy and SESI PR school teachers (Paraná, Brazil) have created exercises to encourage reflection and social engagement.
Download now to experience this engaging reading, to discover current sustainability information, to do a scientific experiment and to take action in transforming the world!
• 47 youth literary content screens with interactivities
• 14 current sustainability information content screens
• Educational activities created by experienced teachers
• Scientific experiment proposed by experienced scientists
"Frrit-Flacc" is the first app book in the Novozymes New Perspective Collection - a partnership between Novozymes, StoryMax, and SESI PR (Paraná, Brazil), with additional support from the CRBio (Regional Biological Council, Paraná).

Dive into a world of simplicity, vibrancy, and relaxation with Falling Stuff. This delightful game offers an experience that is both visually appealing and satisfyingly smooth. With its attractive UI and vibrant colors, Falling Stuff promises to brighten your day and provide hours of entertainment.
Features:
Simple and Clean Gameplay: Catch various objects as they gracefully fall from the sky and stack them neatly in your bucket. The gameplay is easy to understand yet challenging to master, making it suitable for players of all ages.
Relaxing Atmosphere: Immerse yourself in a calming atmosphere as you enjoy the smooth and relaxing gameplay. Let go of your stress and worries as you focus on catching falling objects amidst beautiful scenery.
Afrobeat Music: Groove to the beat of infectious afrobeat music while
playing. The upbeat tunes will keep you engaged and energized throughout your gameplay session.
Unlockable Environments: Explore different environments as you progress through the game. Start with the default environment and unlock new ones by collecting in-game coins. Each environment offers its own unique backdrop and challenges, adding variety and excitement to your gameplay.

Supermarket
Welcome to the supermarket. It's time to go shopping and fill the basket with delicious food and various interesting things. Such store games is a great way to have fun. Do you like animal games? Then you will become an assistant for animals and accompany them during all purchases.

details_full_description:
Dinosaur Garbage Truck Games
Welcome to the most exciting adventure in the world of garbage trucks! Our game is not just one of the average truck games for kids or car games for kids. It's much more - a fun-filled, educational journey that lets you become an environmental guardian and a responsible garbage truck driver!
Hop onto one of the coolest garbage trucks you've ever seen and prepare to clean up the city! But wait, there's more to it than just garbage. Our game even lets you drive a street sweeper, making it an integral part of our lineup of construction games.
Is snow causing trouble in the city traffic? No worries! In our game, you can take charge of a snow plow, clearing the roads and guiding vehicles to safety. Or perhaps you'd prefer to demolish ruins with your powerful hammer truck in our engaging garbage truck driving simulator.
There's a lot of garbage to be dealt with, and you're just the one to handle it. In this unique blend of car games and garbage truck games, you'll transport all kinds of waste, large and small, even old car parts, to the recycling center. Once there, you get to see the impressive disposal machine in action and enjoy the fun interactions that follow!
We've made education engaging in our learning games. You're in control of up to 30 different machines - sorting machines, car crushers, magnet devices, steamers, and more. These will help you learn about sorting and recycling mixed waste in the most entertaining way possible.
Our game teaches kids about waste management and the best practices to sort and eliminate it. They learn about various methods of waste recycling and energy production, all within this child-friendly, interactive environment. And it's all packaged with enjoyable animations and sound effects, making learning fun!
Choose your favorite garbage truck and start your adventure! Drive around as a little environmental guardian and develop good habits while cultivating an environmental consciousness. Remember, no adventure is too big when you're driving a mighty garbage truck.
Features:
• Five unique garbage trucks to choose from, including a snowblower, a sweeper truck, and a forklift
• Control up to 30 giant sorting machines
• Learn about waste management and the best ways to sort and eliminate it
• Develop environmental consciousness and good habits
• Fun animations and sound effects
• No third-party advertising

Yateland designs apps with educational value, inspiring preschoolers worldwide to learn through play. Every app we create is guided by our motto: "Apps children love and parents trust." For more information about Yateland and our apps, visit our website at https://yateland.com.
Privacy Policy
Yateland is dedicated to protecting users' privacy. If you want to learn more about how we handle these matters, please read our full privacy policy at https://yateland.com/privacy.

details_full_description:
TapTap Word
Dive tap first into the electrifying world of TapTap Word, where speed and smarts collide! Can you outsmart the countdown? Your word mastery and quick thinking will be your greatest allies!
The idea of the game is to go through levels finding valid scrabble words. The levels are defined by the amount of letters that you have available. Start creating a word with 1 letter, move to level 2 and create a word with 2 letters, and so on ...
The rules are:
+ The goal is create a valid scrabble word with the amount of tiles available in the screen
+ The first letter when you tap a tile is always random and after that it goes in alphabetical order. (Ex: you tap the tile a first time and you get letter R and if you tap the same tile again the letter changes to S)
+ Every time you create a valid word you move to the next level and win one more tile (and depending of the game mode, 10 more seconds or 10 more taps)
+ When you move to the next level the tiles are reset so you have to tap them all over again to create a new valid word
There are 4 different game modes:
* Easy Mode: you just go through the levels creating words without limitations (taps or time)
* Time Mode: you start with 10 seconds to create a valid word in level 1 and every time that you jump to a new level you get 10 extra seconds
* Tap Mode: you start with 10 taps to find a valid word in level 1 and every time that you jump to a new level you get 10 extra taps
* Elite Mode: you play only seeing the first random letter when you tap in a blue tile after that you need to count the order mentally because the screen wont show it
Check more here:
https://www.youtube.com/@WordHunterWorld/shorts

details_full_description:
프로클리너 (Frocleaner)
In 23820, as garbage overflowed on Earth, creatures on Earth evolved to eat recycled garbage as food.
Recyclable waste, such as glass, plastic, cans, and paper, which can be collected separately, has been eaten and used as an energy source.
Help 'Poco' the frog to eat lots of recycling so he can survive for a long time.
- HP is recharged by eating recyclable canned food cans, cider bottles, and plastic PET bottles,
- Eating non-recyclable banana peels, chicken bones, and general garbage reduces HP.
- Operation: Move direction with the left joystick, launch the tongue by touching other areas
- Even if you stay still to maintain body temperature, basic HP is consumed per hour.
- Scores are added in proportion to the time you hold out.
- Eating items that reduce HP or poisonous snakes will give you extra points.
- When a frog touches a poisonous snake, there is a cooldown period in which it cannot eat anything else to digest.
- Poisonous snakes eat frogs' food because they have a good appetite, and they interfere with frogs' meals. Fortunately, however, they do not catch and eat frogs.
- If you eat a special item, you can wear a special costume and become cuter.

details_full_description:
Math Kids: Math Games For Kids
It's never too early to start your child's education. Preschoolers, kindergarteners, toddlers, and older kids are eager to learn their ABCs, counting, addition, subtraction, and more! The best way to encourage that is to share smart, well-made educational apps and games with them on a daily basis.
Math Kids is a free learning game designed to teach young children numbers and mathematics. It features several mini-games that toddlers and pre-K kids will love to play, and the more they do the better their math skills will become! Math Kids will help preschoolers, kindergarteners, 1st graders to learn to identify numbers and start training with addition and subtraction puzzles. They'll have a great time completing games and earning stickers, and you‘ll have a great time watching them grow and learn.
Math Kids features a number of puzzles that teach while your child plays, including:
• Counting - Learn to count objects in this simple game of addition.
• Compare - Children can build their counting and comparing skills to see which group of items is bigger or smaller.
• Adding Puzzle - A fun mini-game where kids create math problems by dragging numbers on the screen.
• Adding Fun - Count the objects and tap on the missing number.
• Adding Quiz - Put your child's math and addition skills to the test.
• Subtracting Puzzle - Fill in the missing symbols in the math problem.
• Subtracting Fun - Count the items to solve the puzzle!
• Subtracting Quiz - See how much your child has improved in their mathematics skills for subtraction.
When kids can play while they're learning, they're much more likely to recall information. It also makes them want to learn more frequently, which will give them a huge boost when they start kindergarten.
Math Kids also comes with a number of features that help adults monitor and manage their child's progress. Customize game modes to increase or decrease the difficulty, or check report cards to see scores for previous rounds.
Math Kids is the perfect introduction to the basics of counting, addition, and subtraction. It will teach your toddler, kindergartener, 1st grader sorting, and logical skills along with early mathematics, giving them the perfect foundation for a lifetime of learning.
Note to Parents:
When creating Math Kids, we focused on building the best possible learning experience for children of all ages. We're parents ourselves, so we know exactly what makes a good educational game, as well as what doesn't. We released Kids Math as a completely free game with no in-app purchases or third party ads. Math Kids is full featured, frustration free, and ready to go. It’s exactly the kind of educational app we want for our children, and we think your family will enjoy it, too!
- Best wishes from the parents at RV AppStudios

Kids Dinosaur Adventure Game
FIVE fun and exciting games with lots of dinosaurs for all the dino lovers out there!
Dino Adventure
This is a simple game for toddlers. You dig for dinosaur bones by rubbing the screen on the marked spots. While digging, you find dinosaur bones and random items, and when you have found all the bones, the dinosaur comes alive!
Coloring Book
This is a simple yet fun drawing app for kids. Color lots of cute dinosaurs, have fun creating your own doodles in free draw mode, and laugh at the wacky color combinations created by the random button!
Jigsaw Puzzle
In this intuitive puzzle game for kids and adults you can choose whether to use 6, 9, 12, 16, 30 or 56 pieces, adjusting the difficulty to the appropriate skill level. Great for relaxation and hand-eye coordination. If you or your kids like dinosaur games and jigsaw puzzles, they will LOVE this puzzle filled with cool dino pictures!
Matching
This dinosaur matching game is the classic board game which helps develop memory skills of children. It contains cute images of dinos such as T-Rex, pterodactyl, stegosaurus and more. Five different difficulties (6, 8, 12, 16 and 20 cards) means you can push your memorization to the limits!
Scratch and Color
A scratch and color game with amazing dinosaurs! In this game children will discover a hidden image in scratch mode or paint in the coloring mode, and also learn the name of each dinosaur as you play.

Racing Cars for kids
Participate in the funniest car race with your custom cars!
This car racing game is aimed at children aged between 3 and 6 years old to enhance their creativity and stimulate fine motor skills.
Children can select their favorite character and create amazing cars from the garage. Oscar, Lila, Coco and Pepper are the characters that will accompany them during the game while they paint and color the cars and avoid obstacles in the race.
DESIGN YOUR FAVORITE CAR IN THE GARAGE
- Choose your favorite character and a car model you want to play with

CHOOSE THE RACE TYPE

- Special cars: Cadillac, beetle, carriage, hippie van...

details_full_description:
Guardians Legacy
The kingdom has been invaded, and now the king needs your help to recover it. In each level, you'll get a village back for the kingdom. You can build different kinds of defensive towers to slay your enemies and upgrade your defenses to become more powerful. Moreover, you can deploy your guardians to fight the enemies face to face and make use of special powers which will be crucial to win each battle!
Build towers up and generate gold coins
Plan when and where to build your towers up to slow down your enemies' progress. There are four kinds of towers available, which can be upgraded during the battle. But be careful, enemies can knock them down if you don't defend them well.
Deploy your guardians
There are two kinds of guardians, the one specialised in hand-to-hand attacks, which will delay the enemies' progress, and the one which attacks from a distance, but whose attack is more harmful. Deploy your troops in the right moment.
Invoke powers during battle
Use the special powers strategically to tilt the balance in your favour. You will be able to severely damage your enemies, paralyze them for a short time period or heal your guardians, but take into account the cool down of these powers.
Analyze different kinds of enemies
Take into account each enemy's weakness when deploying your towers and troops. Depending on its nature, they may be immune to some kind of attack or power, so you will need different strategies for each battle.
Check and use upgrades panel
Exchange ability points earned in each battle to upgrade your towers, guardians and special powers. A good distribution of upgrades will be totally necessary to defeat the most powerful enemies in the hardest battles.
