details_full_description:
Q-Less Crossword Solitaire
Looking for a fun and challenging brain game? Look no further than Q-Less Crossword Solitaire, the ultimate word puzzle game!
Invented by 80-year-old game inventor Tom Sturdevant from Nashville, Tennessee, Q-Less Crossword Solitaire challenges you to test your vocabulary and word-finding skills as you connect letters and solve anagrams.
With addictive gameplay, a strategic focus, and stunning dice animation, Q-Less Crossword Solitaire offers hours of entertainment and brain-teasing fun. The soothing sounds and immersive graphics create a relaxing and engaging daily gaming experience.
Q-Less Crossword Solitaire is not just a word game, it also challenges your pattern recognition skills as you roll the dice and strategize your next move. Check out Tom on Tik-Tok to see examples and learn from Tom Sturdevant himself, who posts video solutions every day.
The rules of the game are simple: there are 12 dice, and you must make words that connect like in a crossword. You will always get at least 2 vowels and at most 3. To win, you simply have to use all the letters. No proper nouns are allowed, and words must be longer than 2 letters. The game is called Q-Less because there is no Q in the dice.
Q-Less Crossword Solitaire offers the following features:
1. Endless word-finding possibilities
12 Dice offer endless word-finding solutions.
2. Simple and intuitive gameplay
Simple rules and addictive gameplay that challenges your pattern recognition and strategic skills
3. Stunning Graphics
Stunning dice animation and immersive graphics help you feel like you’re playing the real dice game every morning on your coffee table.
4. Relaxing and Engaging
Soothing dice roll and placement sounds make for a truly engaging experience.
5. Suitable for Everyone
Suitable for both casual gamers and hardcore puzzle enthusiasts ages 8 and above.
6. Share Your Solution With Friends
The easy screenshot feature allows you to quickly share your solutions with your friends.
7. Play For Free
You can play once per day for free.
8. Track Your Progress
Q-Less will keep track of your games played and games solved to give you an overall score. Reset your score whenever you like.
With an intuitive interface and easy-to-learn gameplay, Q-Less Crossword Solitaire is suitable for both casual gamers and hardcore puzzle enthusiasts. Challenge yourself and improve your vocabulary with each game you play. Download Q-Less Crossword Solitaire now and discover why it's the most addicting and fun word game available!

details_full_description:
Robocar POLI: Official Video
Robocar POLI: Video is an app that can be used to enjoy the Robocar POLI series which is being broadcasted in 143 countries with 35 languages over 10 years after being premiered in February, 2011.
Robocar POLI is an animation with a story of a police car, a fire truck, an ambulance, a helicopter, and etc. transforming to robots to save their friends in danger. In addition to the 4 original series broadcasted up to now, it has various stories full of messages that are educational and non-violent like the Safety series that guides children’s daily safety and Robocar POLI SongSong Museum which was released in 2020.
This app can be used to enjoy every series released up to now, has minimized the use of the internet considering the usage patterns of children, and the episodes can be searched by the names of characters and themes. Other than the opening episode, 14 free videos are currently provided and this app includes in-app purchases that parents’ guidance is needed when children are using it. The purchased videos belong to the logged in account and the videos can be enjoyed with other devices with no extra charge when logged in with the same account.
- Services in English, Japanese, Chinese, Russian(Videos only) and Korean are available now.

details_full_description:
Dungeons and Honor - RPG
Welcome to Dungeons and Honor, a real-time strategy RPG game that combines elements of both genres to create a unique player experience. Join Blaze on his journey to reunite with his father, one of the world's best explorers, located in one of the most profound camps in the dungeons.
As the leader of a guild of heroes, you are in charge of their progress. Fight against monsters and epic bosses to collect equipment and new abilities, both alone and with friends. Enjoy online multiplayer battles against other players to raise your guild's ranking and gain access to more powerful weapons and accessories. You can also play offline, both single player and cooperative, and even participate in local multiplayer matches (LAN).
Features:
✦Real-time strategy RPG gameplay
✦Playable offline and online
✦Single player and cooperative campaign mode
✦Online and local multiplayer (LAN)
✦Observer mode to watch online matches
✦15 unique heroes to choose from
✦ Ranking system to compete with other players
✦Intense boss fights and unique enemies
✦Excellent controls and responsive gameplay
✦Variety of weapons, equipment, and items
✦7 different biomes to explore
✦And more
If you're a fan of strategy games and RPGs, don't miss out on Dungeons and Honor. Download now and see if you have what it takes to reunite Blaze with his father and become the most powerful guild in the land.

It's filled with pre-K activities, mini educational games for toddlers, brain games for kids, and so much more!

• Free learning activities for kids, toddlers, and adults

EverRun: The Horse Guardians
Budge Studios™ presents: EverRun™! Assemble the ten legendary Horse Guardians of Everbloom and join them on the most magical adventure to save their forest! Brush, feed, take care of your horses and decorate each of their stables with divine decorations! Run far and fast across magnificent lands to recover and return to the Everbloom Tree all of its lost magical petals!
EPIC HORSE RUNNING ADVENTURES
• EXPLORE the world’s breathtaking landscapes, from radiant rainforests to dusty deserts!
• GATHER all lost petals to bring the Everbloom Tree back to life
• USE the Guardians’ super powers to dash past obstacles, blast through them or even take flight!
• COLLECT Embers to awaken the full power of your Horse Guardians
• DRESS UP your Guardians from head to hoof with mythical armor sets!
• GROOM your horses with magical brushes and feed them to replenish their energy!
• ENHANCE your runs with epic trails made of furious flames, sweet snowflakes and more!
• DECORATE your stable with divine decorations for glorious rooms worthy of the horse heros
• RACE through all of nature’s challenges, blizzards or sandstorms, day or night!
• ENDLESS RUNNER MODE: Gallop without limit, gather as many petals as you can and set your own record!

Play Word Ladder - the classic word ladder puzzle game! Solve puzzling word sequences in Word Ladder, the head-scratchingly fun new word game! To unlock each new level, you’ll need to figure out how to get from one word to another, simply by replacing a single letter at a time.
KEY FEATURES
• Classic word ladder puzzle: each level features a sequence of words that each differ from the previous word by just one letter
• Example: cat → cot → dot → dog
• Suitable for all ages and skill levels
• Play the word ladder puzzles you enjoy anywhere, any time, with this free app version

Strawberry Shortcake Bake Shop
Budge presents STRAWBERRY SHORTCAKE BAKE SHOP! Strawberry Shortcake is so excited to bake with you! Make the dessert of your dreams with yummy ingredients, food coloring, icing, toppings, and decorations! You can even create your berry own recipes to make at home!

ALL DESSERTS

Educational Games for Kids!
Educational games for girls and boys that make learning fun! 🎓 Our kids games combine learning games and kindergarden games to prepare your child for school success. 👨‍🏫 Join our educational adventure now! 😻
Our educational games for kids 2 4 transform screen time into valuable learning moments! 🌟 These preschool games 2 4 year old feature colorful characters who guide children through math games for kids, alphabet practice, and creative activities. Fun games for toddlers are designed specifically for little learners, ensuring age-appropriate challenges that build confidence and skills.
Our kindergarten learning games cover essential preschool skills through interactive play. 🎨 From ABC kids activities to number recognition, educational games for children age 2 4 develop critical thinking, fine motor skills, and problem-solving abilities. Each educational game is crafted by early education experts to make preschool games both effective and entertaining.
Key features:
🎮 30+ fun learning games
🔢 Math fundamentals – counting, number recognition
🔷 Shapes recognition and sorting activities
🧩 Logic puzzles and pattern matching
👧👦 Exciting education for girls and boys
🎨 Colorful animations and engaging characters
🧠 Memory and attention development activities
📚 Vocabulary building exercises
🌈 Colors learning and matching
🔤 ABC learning and letter recognition
📱 Offline play available – no WiFi needed
Parents love how our app supports toddler learning independently. These preschool learning games keep children entertained while building school-readiness skills. The intuitive interface allows even the youngest learners to navigate confidently, giving you peace of mind while your child plays and learns.🌱
Meet our cheerful animated friends who make learning an adventure! Each character has a unique personality and helps children discover new concepts. The app includes kids puzzles, 123 toddler counting activities, and number games for kids. ✨ Fine motor skills develop through tracing and tapping exercises. Download our educational game now and watch your child thrive!

Draw a Stickman: EPIC 3
Played over 100 Million Times around the Globe and a winner of 5 Webby Awards, DRAW A STICKMAN is back and more EPIC than ever before!
Your creativity will be maximized in the all-new Draw a Stickman: EPIC 3! Embark upon an exhilarating new adventure to defeat the Corruption: solve fun puzzles, outsmart crafty monsters, and discover an all-new world! So grab your freshly penciled Hero—it’s time to be EPIC!
**Try the demo for free before buying the full experience.**
DRAW YOUR OWN HERO!
Use the new, intricate drawing tools to design the perfect Hero! Be as creative as you want—your Hero can be anything you can draw!
LIMITLESS SKETCHBOOK!
Store unlimited drawings of Heroes and Tools in your new Sketchbook! Swap between these at any time to spice up your gameplay with all your favorite characters!
NEW HUB WORLD!
Venture around the new Hub World and meet other characters in the Stickman universe! See what they have to say and what they need you to do!
EXPLORE LEVELS!
Adventure through new levels packed with secrets, collectibles, and hidden pathways!
FEISTY MONSTERS!
Lots of new monsters to outwit! Be on the lookout for Oozes, Trolls, Bully Goats, and—perhaps the most fearsome of them all—an Evil Hamster!
FIND LOST COLOR BUDDIES!
Find the lost Color Buddies to add rich, new colors to your drawings!
MASTER NEW PENCILS!
Use your nifty new pencils to bamboozle bosses and bring to life the world around you!
UNLOCK EVERYTHING!
Unlock new hidden areas as you find coloring guides, tool blueprints, and pencils! Can you earn 3 Stars on every level?
You’ll see plenty of new characters and some surprisingly familiar faces on this new adventure! Who are they? It’s a secret! Are you ready for an EPIC new adventure?

details_full_description:
Playhouse Learning games Kids
"Moonzy: Playhouse". Fun and educational games for kids and toddlers to help teach letters, numbers, colors, shapes, motor skills, memory, creativity and more! Learning is easy and fun with this collection of free family games for boys & girls.
Mini games include brushing teeth, cooking food, doing household chores, soaking in a tub & much more.
LEARNING GAMES FOR GRADE SCHOOL EDUCATION
Educational mini games for kids aged 3+:
Numbers — treat Moonzy to some gummy bears and memorize the numbers and their names.
Children's Coloring book , creativity — bake and decorate some cookies, set up a Christmas tree.
Letters — a jigsaw puzzle where kids learn and repeat letterforms and sounds.
Colors and geometric shapes; reasoning tasks: arrange the geometric shapes in a jigsaw puzzle (kids aged 3+ learn how to focus their attention and develop reasoning skills).
Steam train with friends: kids focus their attention and memorize the color sequence of railcars.
3D Boat — fun and colorful races, a fun adventure for fine motor skills and spatial navigation.
More / Less — pick the required number of mushrooms through calibration weights.
Flowers, game — water the plants. Plants need to be taken care of.
Toddler's hygiene — a series of mini challenges: Wash Moonzy, Brush the Teeth, Remove the Toys. The kid repeats and learns (use a washcloth, a bar of soap & a towel).
Cooking — Cook Soup in the kitchen: pick soup ingredients, cook cakes, Bake Bread to complete the meal.
Teach your toddler, kindergarten, or preschool-age child things like number recognition, logic, shape identification, counting, the alphabet (ABC). Kids learn better when there's play involved, and this collection of free family games for kids is the perfect place to start. It's filled with pre-K activities, mini educational games for toddlers, brain games for kids, and so much more!
Create your story in the Playhouse (Doll house)
Learning games for kindergarten toddlers and preschool kids in the Moonzy: Treehouse app are about educational tasks in a playhouse in a world full of exciting new opportunities. Three floors and six rooms to learn about daily routines and household chores: Moonzy's kids' bedroom, a bathroom, a cozy dining room, a kitchen for cooking games, Granny Annie & General Stinger's room, a broom closet.
Hundreds of play items
Come on! Figure out how they interact and what comes out of it! Find educational tasks & multiple mini games in a single app. Learning games for kids aged 3–5: comparing the size and weight of items; geometric shapes and colors; coloring book; set up the Christmas tree, bake bread, cooking, and much more. Grade school prep will come easier!
Games by 1C-Publishing LLC
We design family-friendly learning and education games for kids (boys and girls). Free games for kids. The app's free version offers limited content. Make an in-app purchase to access the full-featured version. Important! In-app purchases don't include the family library. Our games for toddlers can be played offline. Your kids are 100% safe.
Amazing learning and educational games for children of all ages. Learn about science, math & reading. Educational games, stories, and fun lessons.
Your child will learn and play in a safe, kid friendly interface, making preschool and early elementary education fun and easy. Start your child’s learning adventure today!

details_full_description:
Bunny Pancake Kitty Milkshake
Bunny Pancake Kitty Milkshake. Hello everyone and welcome to one of the best arcade games of furry cute animals and kawaii food! Give the pancakes to the bunny and the milkshakes to the kitten to make them chubby until they explode of adorable cuteness! Try it out!
Gameplay
Bunny Pancake is a very simple kawaii food game but yet challenging. You can play with furry cute animals and make them all nice and chubby! There are multiple animals to make chubby, that are: Bunny, Bear, Lion, Kitty, Horse (check out this chubby one haha), Pig and much more. There are also many kinds of different desserts, so you must be aware of which kawaii food each of the cute animals likes best.
Kawaii Cute Games, are very simple to play: move your finger left/right to serve the correct kawaii food to your furry cute animals, that way they will get more chubby. Discard the food they don’t like by moving your finger up/down. Grab power ups give you a boost! Make the highest score so you can be in world’s top 5!! We have very competitive players so far!! Will you be able to surpass them?
But be careful, power ups sometimes look like cute food you would discard if you don’t pay attention: power ups have an orange glow around them, so whenever your furry cute animals get this food, think fast and don’t hesitate, feed them the power up! These special kawaii food are: Muffin, Red velvet and Doughnut!
Each game you play you will earn gold coins!!
Customize
Use your gold coins!
● Dress all your furry cute animals with adorable clothes! You have hats, glasses, hairs, capes and much more!!
● Unlock new animals to give them the breakfast food they love!
● Unlock new backgrounds to customize your restaurant anyway you want! You have a lot of themes: japanes, medieval, spring, summer, snowy, christmas and a lot more!
We’ve had so much fun making Bunny Pancake Game because first, we love furry cute animals when they get chubby, second, we love kawaii food (who doesn’t like a warm delicious pancake??) Third, we decided all the desserts would be cute and sugar free. Why? Because we wanted to haha! We hope you love one of ours best kawaii games!
Follow us in our social media for insight on future releases!

Our children games pack is designed to be used by teachers, therapists and educators with the aim of improving the baby, toddler and children educational process. To be a good hairdresser you need to diversify your work space and that's why in this kids game you will be taking care of the hairstyles for two cool babies. Photomath
Photomath is known worldwide for helping millions of learners to learn, practice, and understand math – one step at a time.
Scan any math problem with the Photomath app to get step-by-step explanations with accurate solutions and a variety of teacher-approved methods. Math is about the process, so Photomath breaks your problem into bite-sized steps to help you understand the “what” and “why” along with the “how.” Whether you’re learning basic arithmetic or advanced geometry, we’ll tackle it together, step by step.
Why Photomath?
Billions of math problems: From elementary arithmetic to advanced calculus and everything in between, Photomath can solve billions of math problems—including word problems! Whether handwritten, in a textbook, or on a screen, Photomath is here to help you untangle your trickiest problem.
Step-by-step explanations: Math isn’t just about an answer. It’s about every step along the way. That’s why Photomath breaks down each step, so you can *really* learn. Less guesswork = less stress, especially with our new Animated Steps, which show you the exact progression of a particular step. Get basic step-by-step explanations at no charge when you download Photomath.
Expert-developed methods: Photomath’s educational content is centered around the learner’s experience, driven by the expertise of our own team of mathematicians and former math teachers.
Self-paced learning: Photomath’s instant support is like having a 24/7 virtual tutor. Checking your homework before dinner? Stuck on a problem at 2am? We can help. Follow our detailed steps, taking whatever time you need to review definitions, rationale, and more – all within the explanation.
Want to dive deeper and explore more ways to learn? Photomath Plus can get you there with custom Animated Tutorials, detailed Textbook Solutions, and more!

House Flipper: Home Design
Have you ever dreamed about running your own renovation company? Now you can do it wherever you are with the mobile edition of the PC hit - the House Flipper simulation game - on your mobile device. House Flipper is the best free one-man makeover crew on the market. Become an interior & house designer and start your very own business. Carry out orders, renovate, decorate houses, and sell them with profit afterwards! Get new skins for your tools.
House Flipper: Home Design, Simulator Games features:
✔️ Awesome, realistic 3D graphics
✔️ Smooth intuitive and addictive gameplay (60 FPS gameplay)
✔️ Different interesting tasks
✔️ Buying, renovating, and selling 🏠 houses as well as interior decoration
✔️ Leveling up and upgrading tools
✔️ Over 500 adorable decoration and furniture (bed, nightstand, night table, chair, TV cabinet, commode, armchair, sofa and many more items to unlock)
And all of that is waiting for you in the mobile adaptation of the most liked simulation flipping game: House Flipper simulator. Fix & Flip. Become the most famous house flipper and interior house designer.
COMPLETE ORDERS
A great adventure awaits you in the House Flipper simulator - the world of renovations! Perform interesting orders that will make you feel like a real house flipper. Meet colorful characters such as Eleanor Moore and her artistically gifted animals (whose activities will be followed by cleaning). Renovate the art connoisseur's museum, Giuseppe Clavier, and help the squat residents renovate their ruined house. House Flipper, home design simulator offers you various locations equipped with characteristic items.
DECORATE INTERIORS
Become an interior & house designer and arrange interiors according to your own ideas, using available items and a wide range of paints. Most of the items available in the game have from several to over a dozen variants, which you will unlock as you progress in the game. Learn not only their purpose but also the story behind them (background). What does a cat have to do with haiku writing? Why are the Babylonian invaders buying souvenirs there? You will find answers to more strange questions in the descriptions of over 500 items available in the game. All this in realistic 3D graphics!
GAIN EXPERIENCE
As you progress in House Flipper simulator you'll level up and improve your tools. Advance to the next levels to complete the tasks (quests) faster. Why hurt your hands when you can have gloves made of hardened smurf leather? Using unlocked items, you can arrange the interior of your office according to your own design. It can be stylish, but also ... A cat tree in the middle of the room? Why not? It's your idea after all! If you love playing simulation, house renovation, and home design games, you will fall in love with House Flipper renovation & decor game.
🏡 BUY, RENEW, DECOR, SELL

details_full_description:
Horse Riding Tales - Wild Pony
THE MULTIPLAYER ONLINE HORSE RACING GAME OF YOUR DREAMS.
Begin your journey from lowly stable hand to dressage & horse racing super star! Join our horse loving online world where you can customise your character, tame & race beautiful wild horses, bring them to your stable and train so you can become an equestrian show jumping champion.
WELCOME TO MEADOWCROFT
A small, centuries old equestrian town surrounded by rolling fields and vast, open plains. Sleepy. Rustic. Idyllic. Full of cute animals big and small. A paradise of peace and tranquillity. A town with a passion for horses that’s as old as the foundations it was built on. Home to Layla, lowly stable hand. A horse girl who, though surrounded by horses each and every day, has never yet sat astride one, but all that is about to change!
RIDE & RACE WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Ride your horse with all your girl friends & fellow cowgirls as you set out on adventures to explore the outskirts of your farm and beyond in glorious 3D!
The multiplayer horse racing game mode also lets you compete in online races galloping at full speed around the ranch against your rivals!
ENGLISH & WESTERN ATTIRE - ENDLESS CUSTOMISATION
Create an amazing look for you and your horse as you compete for glory in the Meadowcroft Show Jumping Competitions. Dress up like a champion in the coolest cowgirl gear ever! From helmets and jodhpurs for you - and saddles, leg wraps and masks for your horse, there are thousands of looks you can create.
TAME BEAUTIFUL HORSES
Catch the perfect horse! Create a magical bond with wild horse breeds such as the Mustang, Dapple Grey, Appaloosa and other paint horses as you tame and care for them, preparing your stallion to be ridden as you set out on your quest.
A MYSTERY TO SOLVE
Uncover the mystery of the fabled fantasy sky riders - mystical Pegasus and Unicorn horses who once roamed free in the haven above the clouds.
JOIN THE SHOW JUMPING & DRESSAGE ACADEMY
You may be invited to join the prestigious Meadowcroft riding academy, a school that’s seen countless thousands of equestrians pass through its gates and over its grasslands. Compete against other students in equestrian competitions as you uncover the mystery of the sky riders.
COLLECT PETS
Collect the cutest wild animal pets, from foxes, wolf pups to mystical tigers & more. Show off your pets to all your fellow cowgirls! They will even run alongside you as you complete horse racing quests around the ranch.
JOIN A CLUB
Get all your friends together and compete against other clubs for amazing prizes in weekly challenges. Ride out like a champion with your fellow club members!
CRAFT ITEMS
Explore the world and mine resources to create beautiful western riding accessories for your horse such as saddles, bridles, blankets and more!
CARE FOR YOUR HORSE
Complete horse care quests in your stable by crafting hay, horseshoes and other items for your animal to keep her in high spirits. The happier your animal, the better it will jump in equestrian events. Train the best championship horse and win the ultimate equestrian trophy.
More than just a simulator, this game takes mobile equestrian games to a new level! Foxie Ventures would like to welcome you to the Horse Riding Tales family! We will be adding lots of new content, from a Shetland pony to more fantasy pegasus & unicorn horses to challenging breeding quests. Kick off your interactive adventure and download free today!

https://www.foxieventures.com/privacy
In-App Purchases
This app offers optional in-app purchases that cost real money. You can disable the in-app purchasing functionality by adjusting your device settings.
A network connection is required to play. Data fees may apply if WiFi isn’t connected.

- Around The World : explore countries.
- Unblock : Find the way home for the Flower,
and more.
Setting

details_full_description:
Learn Chess with Dr. Wolf
Looking to learn how to play chess? Meet Dr. Wolf, the ideal chess coach and companion. Dr. Wolf explains everything to you step-by-step, points out strategic ideas, and alerts you to your mistakes. Whether you are a chess beginner eager to learn the basics or an intermediate player looking to refine your strategy, Dr. Wolf tailors the learning experience to your individual needs, offering over 50 comprehensive chess lessons and interactive guidance at every step.
**Why Choose Learn Chess with Dr. Wolf?**
- **Personalized Coaching:** Experience the unique teaching method of Dr. Wolf, who not only instructs but also plays alongside you, providing insights into every move. He will introduce topics to you as you play chess, ensuring you grasp the “why” behind each move.
- **Audible Coaching**: Dr. Wolf speaks out-loud. Actual audio! Experience the unique advantage of having Dr. Wolf speak to you while you look at the board, offering clear, spoken explanations for every move.
- **A Comprehensive Chess Curriculum:** Engage with an extensive suite of over 50 interactive chess lessons. Starting from foundational concepts, you'll progress through to advanced strategies and tactics, all structured to enhance your understanding and performance in chess.
- **Mistake Correction and Practice:** Learn from your mistakes in a constructive environment. Dr. Wolf remembers all your moves and goes over them again with you so you don’t make the same mistakes again.
- **Diverse Coaching Personalities:** Choose from four distinct coach profiles, each with a unique voice, teaching style and personality. You’ll be sure to find the right chess coach for you.
- **Gradual Learning of Chess Vocabulary:** Expand your vocabulary and understanding of key terms and concepts at a comfortable pace.
- **Adaptive Difficulty Level:** Choose from a variety of skill levels, ensuring you're always challenged but never overwhelmed.
- **Multilingual Support**: Available in English, Spanish, French, and German (Voice mode in languages other english is coming soon!).
**Learn the game and how to win.**
"Learn Chess with Dr. Wolf" blends comprehensive lessons, personalized feedback, and interactive learning, offering a standout experience for those new to chess or aiming to enhance their skills. Whether your goal is to understand chess better, win more games, or simply enjoy this timeless strategy game more deeply, Dr. Wolf is here to guide you every step of the way.
---------------------------------------------
Dr. Wolf will coach you for free for 3 games of chess so that you can appreciate his style of in-game teaching. Then, to continue learning, you can subscribe to Coaching. With Coaching, Dr. Wolf teaches while you play chess, pointing out good moves and bad –both yours and his — and the reasoning behind them. At times, he'll gently suggest you reconsider a move, or ask a question at a critical moment. Plus, you get unlimited hints, unlimited undos, and unlimited access to our Lesson Library, with over thirty lessons in
Dr. Wolf's unique style. Whether or not you choose to subscribe, Dr. Wolf will always play with you. He loves chess too much to turn down a good game.
** TERMS & DETAILS **
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged the same amount for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a Free Trial, if offered, is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Prices may vary by location.

details_full_description:
GeoGuessr
Welcome to the world of GeoGuessr! Embark on an epic journey that takes you from the most desolate roads in Australia to the busy, bustling streets of New York City. Search for signs, language, flags, nature, internet top domains, or just about any clue that helps you to find where you are.
EMBARK ON YOUR OWN JOURNEY
How far can you go in GeoCrusher? Want to explore your favorite map? Start a Country Streak and see how long it can get? Take on the explorer hat and challenge yourself in our different single player modes.
COMPETE AGAINST OTHERS
Put your skill to the test against players all around the world. Duel against other players on your skill level or compete in our Battle Royale modes and see who will make it to the end. How far can you climb on the leaderboard?
PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Host your own party and invite your friends to join. Choose to play against each other in different game modes. Who will come out on top?
CROSS-PLATFORM
Play both with and against players on mobile and on the website.
BECOME ANYTHING YOU CAN DESIRE
Embrace boundless creativity and express your individuality like never before! Personalize your virtual alter ego with a vast assortment of hats, shirts, faces, gear, and a treasure trove of other options.

details_full_description:
BOM Weather
Australia's official weather app from the Bureau of Meteorology (BOM).
Download the BOM Weather app for access to hourly and 7-day forecasts, radar, rain notifications and warnings – wherever you are.
BOM Weather is free and ad free on mobile and tablet devices. It features:
- widgets so you can see the weather at a glance
- offline mode for moments when you don't have internet
The BOM Weather app includes:
Current weather
- Temperature and icon
- 'Feels like' temperature
- Rain
- Wind speed, direction and gust (in knots and km/h)
- Humidity
- Rainfall since 9 am
- Local text forecast
Forecasts
- Hourly forecast temperature, UV, humidity, dew point, wind, gust and rain for the next 72 hours
- 7-day forecast
- Total wave height and direction (for relevant locations)
- Sunrise and sunset times, moon phases
- Fire danger rating
- Waters forecast and summary for the coming days, including tides (for relevant locations)
Map
- See rain 90 minutes into the past and future
- View active warnings and access warning details
- Pan and zoom to anywhere in Australia
- Your location is marked on the map
- See optimal radar coverage areas while viewing rain
Rain and warning notifications
- Rain and warning notifications for up to 3 locations around Australia
- Warning notifications include coastal hazards, fire weather, flood warnings and watches, heatwave, marine wind, severe thunderstorm, severe weather, tropical cyclone, and tsunami
Past weather
- Latest highs and lows, including highest and lowest temperature, highest wind gust and total rain
- 72 hours of temperature, wind and rain
Locations
- Use your current location
- Save your favourite locations
- Search for any location in Australia
- View your recent location
Widgets
- See weather details for your current or selected location
- Provides current, minimum and maximum temperature and more
- Add one or many widgets for locations around Australia

Little Panda’s Jewel Adventure
Little Panda's fantasy adventure is about to begin. This time the adventure will be full of unknown challenges and puzzles. Only those with enough courage and intelligent minds can complete this adventure. Are you ready to go?
START AN ENDLESS ADVENTURE
Leave your adventurous footsteps in the Magic Kingdom, Fantasy Forest, City Quay and Mechanic City. What are you hesitating for? Let's go now!
COMPLETE DIFFERENT TASKS
Become a little adventurer, collect ingredients and prepare a birthday dinner. Be a little hero, beat the devil and get back the energy chips. Play as a police officer, solve cases and catch the bad guy. There are lots more. Try them all!
SOLVE VARIOUS PUZZLES
Over 900 logic levels for you to challenge! Drag and drop pieces to complete a puzzle! Move and place geometric blocks to build a safe path! There are more interesting logic problems waiting for you to solve!
Join us on the adventure!

details_full_description:
Secure Camera
This is a modern camera app focused on privacy and security. It includes modes for capturing images, videos and QR / barcode scanning along with additional modes based on CameraX vendor extensions (Portrait, HDR, Night, Face Retouch and Auto) on devices where they're available.
Modes are displayed as tabs at the bottom of the screen. You can switch between modes using the tab interface or by swiping left/right anywhere on the screen. The arrow button at the top opens the settings panel and you can close it by pressing anywhere outside the settings panel. You can also swipe down to open the settings and swipe up to close it. Outside of the QR scanning mode, there's a row of large buttons above the tab bar for switching between the cameras (left), capturing images and starting/stopping video recording (middle) and opening the gallery (right). The volume keys can also be used as an equivalent to pressing the capture button. While recording a video, the gallery button becomes an image capture button for capturing images.
The app has an in-app gallery and video player for images/videos taken with it. It currently opens an external editor activity for the edit action.
Zooming via pinch to zoom or the zoom slider will automatically make use of the wide angle and telephoto cameras on Pixels and other devices supporting it. It will become more broadly supported over time.
By default, continuous auto focus, auto exposure and auto white balance are used across the whole scene. Tapping to focus will switch to auto focus, auto exposure and auto white balance based on that location. The focus timeout setting determines the timeout before it switches back the default mode. The exposure compensation slider on the left allows manually tuning exposure and will automatically adjust shutter speed, aperture and ISO. Further configuration / tuning will be provided in the future.
The QR scanning mode only scans within the scanning square marked on the screen. The QR code should be aligned with the edges of the square but can have any 90 degree orientation. Non-standard inverted QR codes are fully supported. It's a very quick and high quality QR scanner able to easily scan very high density QR codes from Pixels. Every 2 seconds, it will refresh auto focus, auto exposure and auto white balance on the scanning square. It has full support for zooming in and out. The torch can be toggled with the button at the bottom center. The auto toggle at the bottom left can be used to toggle scanning for all supported barcode types. Alternatively, you can select which barcode types it should scan via the menu at the top. It only scans QR codes by default since that provides quick and reliable scanning. Most other types of barcodes can result in false positives. Each enabled type will slow down the scanning and will make it more prone to false positives especially with difficult to scan barcodes such as a dense QR code.
Camera permission is the only one that's required. Images and videos are stored via the Media Store API so media/storage permissions aren't required. The Microphone permission is needed for video recording by default but not when including audio is disabled. Location permission is only needed if you explicitly enabling location tagging, which is an experimental feature.
By default, EXIF metadata is stripped for captured images and only includes the orientation. Stripping metadata for videos is planned but not supported yet. Orientation metadata isn't stripped since it's fully visible from how the image is displayed so it doesn't count as hidden metadata and is needed for proper display. You can toggle off stripping EXIF metadata in the More Settings menu opened from the settings dialog. Disabling metadata stripping will leave timestamp, phone model, exposure configuration and other metadata. Location tagging is disabled by default and won't be stripped if you enable it.

details_full_description:
Wi-Fiスポット設定
【Service contents】
This is an application that automatically connects to SoftBank Wi-Fi spots.
(Depending on your data plan, you may need to apply for the SoftBank Wi-Fi Spot service separately.)
【please note】
-This app requires permission to "make and manage calls" and "access to this device's location information." (We do not make calls or identify location information from the app)
・If you are using Android 10 or higher, select "Yes (permit)" in the notification from the Android system "Do you want to connect to a Wi-Fi network?" under the SoftBank Wi-Fi Spot Area. You can use SoftBank Wi-Fi Spot.
・If you are using Android 11 or higher, please set "Settings app" → [Location information] > [App permissions] > [Wi-Fi spot settings] to [Always allow].
- If it does not connect automatically, please tap the app icon. Even if you select a Wi-Fi access point from the settings app, you will not be able to use it.
・If you connect to the Internet via Wi-Fi, the Web Anshin Service will not apply.
[About app notifications]
- When using 0000softbank with this app, Wi-Fi is detected in the background and user authentication is performed. Therefore, when 0000softbank is set to ON, a notification indicating that the application is running will continue to be displayed.
・For devices that support Wi-Fi frequency 5GHz, app notifications can be reduced by turning on only "SoftBank Wi-Fi Spot (High Security)" from the Wi-Fi spot settings in the app.
・For apps other than "SoftBank Wi-Fi Spot (High Security)", app notifications can be reduced by turning off the settings after use.
【others】
・SoftBank Wi-Fi Spot cannot be used with X06HT.

details_full_description:
ÖBB Tickets
How can you buy your tickets even faster and get updates on your journey on top of that? You get it with the ÖBB App, round the clock, wherever you are. Take the train and take it easy.
The ÖBB App comes with the following features:
• Tickets for trains, buses, the metro and trams: book your ÖBB tickets & get exclusive online specials such as the Sparschiene Österreich discount fares. You can also book the city tickets and weekly or monthly tickets of Austrian regional transport operators
• Pay your fares on the go with SimplyGo! The handy add-on for the ÖBB App automatically identifies the routes you travelled and calculates the matching public transport fare for your complete journey
• Secure your favourite seat on the Railjet: use the graphic seat reservation
• Find the best fare: see the ÖBB train services sorted by lowest fare first
• ÖBB Account: conveniently and securely store your personal data and means of payment, save your favourite routes, and receive additional exclusive offers (e.g. the Vorteilscard 66 discount card)
We are continuously working on the app to enrich it with new features and improve the usability.
Further information: oebb.at/app

details_full_description:
Chaldal: Online Grocery
The core mission of Chaldal is to save money and save time as we focus on the fact that people don’t have to spend too much of their precious money and time to buy their necessities on a daily basis. We want to make people’s lives easier so that they can do their daily activities without running to the supermarket or vegetable market.
We understand a little assistance with daily grocery needs goes a long way in making lives easier. Chaldal is now the largest online grocery platform in Bangladesh. Since 2013, we have been working relentlessly to improve our delivery mechanism. We have warehouses situated across the major cities of the country such as Dhaka, Chattogram, Rajshahi, Khulna, and Sylhet. Having these warehouses has enabled us to successfully operate a 30 minutes delivery service.
We assure the quality of the products for our customers by sourcing straight from farmers, manufacturers, and importers. With the integration of our automated warehouse management, the processing time has decreased significantly. Our well-designed system architecture enables us to track each and every order from the moment of its placement to delivery.

Micro Battles are BACK on popular request!
Gather your friends for another series of HEAD TO HEAD mini-games, inspired by the fun simplicity of classic 8-BIT VIDEO GAMES.

Produced by China Railway, People's Railway is for the people, buy train tickets with Railway 12306! Our features:
Ticketing without markup: No acceleration package fees, no bundled insurance sales, and no membership fees are charged, allowing you to purchase tickets with peace of mind.
[More accurate information] Delay and suspension information, train departure and arrival information, carriage and vehicle information are available in a timely manner, allowing you to travel with peace of mind.
【 More comprehensive 】 With nearly a hundred functions, including train tickets, air tickets, car tickets, online ordering, hotel accommodation, and travel, you can travel worry free.

Train ticket booking

2. Choose seats and shops. Do you like to see the scenery by the window? Do you prefer the convenience of using the aisle? Do you like a clean upper bunk? Would you like the lower bunk to be convenient? Select a seat or bed with one click to specify the desired seat/bed.
3. Intelligent transfer. No direct delivery plan? Transfer service intelligence recommends transfer plans for you.
4. Station screen. Check the departure and arrival information of the train, allowing you to easily grasp the itinerary and making it more convenient to pick up and drop off passengers at the station.
[Ticket Booking]
The airline's official direct operated store has settled in, providing official ticket services, making ticket purchases more reassuring and ensuring travel security.
[Car Ticket Booking]
Cover the whole country and depart at any time! Provide domestic highway passenger transportation information, bus stations, route schedules, and bus ticket booking services.
Intermodal transportation services
Provide one-stop ticketing and information inquiry services for air, rail, public, and water transportation modes, saving time and effort, and offering more travel options.
[Travel Services]
We provide services such as high-speed rail meal booking, hotel booking, car pick-up and drop off stations, railway tours, scenic spot ticket booking, railway mall, travel insurance, etc. We offer food, accommodation, transportation, travel, shopping, and entertainment, and an app to meet your travel needs.
Warm service
Provide convenient service functions such as temporary boarding certificate, key passenger reservation, and lost item search, so that you can travel without worries.
Member Services
Provide membership benefits and support the use of points to redeem tickets and other related services.
For more information, please follow
WeChat official account: Railway 12306

My Vodafone UA Mobile operator
Manage your number easily and quickly with My Vodafone app.
Keep track of your internet and calls remaining, check your balance, pay bills, control your expenses, top up your mobile number, manage tariffs and services and much more - all in one app.
FEATURES OF MY VODAFONE UA APP:
PERSONAL ACCOUNT
All essential information about your number is always at your fingertips: balance, remaining GB, minutes, and SMS, all displayed in a convenient format on the main screen.
SERVICES AND TARIFFS
Check your plan details, compare and upgrade your tariffs and services.
EXPENSES AND TOP-UP
Control your expenses and top up your account without fee.
STAY IN TOUCH
Add numbers of your loved ones, top up their accounts and stay in touch with family and friends. Money transfer is possible to Vodafone network numbers only.
GET BONUSES
Exchange bonuses for internet traffic and other great offers.
ACTIVATE ESIM
Discover eSIM - a virtual SIM card that expands the capabilities of your mono SIM smartphone and allows you to use it with two numbers.
SECURITY
Register your number using Diia and My Vodafone apps to ensure the protection and security of your personal data.
NOTIFICATIONS
Let us help you - we will inform you about important information with timely notifications.
DIGITAL ASSISTANT
Can't find what you’re looking for? Ask and get instant answers from TOBi - your personal online assistant, available 24/7.
QUESTIONS
Find the nearest customer service centres and Vodafone support line contact details - we are always happy to help you with any questions.
WHY VODAFONE?
• Vodafone Ukraine is a leading Ukrainian telecom company providing services such as mobile communication and internet. The company also collaborates on and develops new technological solutions for Kyiv Smart City.
• Vodafone is one of the largest mobile network operators in the world and among the first to offer 5G networks.
• High-speed mobile internet 3G and 4G, quality communication, and wide coverage across the entire country. Kyiv, Lviv, Odesa, or any other location in Ukraine - connect with people anywhere!
Want to learn more about the Vodafone Ukraine mobile network operator? Visit our official website - vodafone.ua

details_full_description:
Sleep Number
5.4, April 9th, 2026
Only available with Sleep Number smart beds
WHAT’S NEW
We’ve made a few improvements to the Sleep Number app:
What’s new for your sleep – when it matters
A new way to stay up to date with personalized sleep insights, rewards, and other relevant updates - delivered as they change.
Improved Sleeper Name Management
Updating sleeper names is now easier than ever – edit them directly from Bed Settings & Support with fewer steps
Under-the-Hood Enhancements
We’ve resolved some bugs and fine-tuned performance to keep things running smoothly.
OVERVIEW
The Sleep Number app delivers a one-of-a-kind experience, seamlessly blending smart bed capabilities, personalized sleep and health insights, and rewards.
Only the Sleep Number smart bed uses the science of your personal sleep data to understand your needs for continuously better sleep quality. Our exclusive sense-and-do technology accurately measures your biosignals - your average heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV) and average breath rate - throughout the night, then automatically adjusts to your individual needs, designed to continuously improve your sleep over time. See a daily snapshot of factors that measure your sleep quality – duration, efficiency and timing. Developed by sleep science experts with insights into how each of us sleeps, it connects you with your best possible sleep, night after night and through every phase of life.
SLEEP
- Personalized sleep insights help improve your sleep and wellbeing to get the most from your smart bed every night and every day.
- Wake up to your SleepIQ score every morning and compare to your average to see if your sleep is improving.
- See your average heart rate, heart rate variability (HRV) and breath rate.
- Circadian rhythm helps you get the most from every day. Your smart bed learns your sleep schedule over 7 days and shows you your ideal bedtime, wake time and more.
HEALTH
- Research-grade sensors measure duration, efficiency, and timing for improved sleep health.
- See your personal sleep trends over time by day, week, month and year, plus personalized insights to help you achieve your best possible sleep.
- See a 30-day summary of your sleep health with actionable insights, and if you choose, share with your physicians to help provide a more holistic picture of your health.
SMART BED
- Take control of your sleep with smart bed control, including your Sleep Number setting, Responsive Air technology and FlexFit adjustable base to ensure you’re getting the best quality sleep.
- Senses your movement and adjusts your firmness for each of you for the highest quality sleep.
- Choose a SmartTemp program, scientifically shown to improve sleep quality, for effortless and individualized temperature to help you get more restful sleep. SmartTemp programs allow you to easily schedule different temperature settings throughout the night, as your needs change. Available on select models only.
PROFILE
- Personalized to you with access to rewards, partners, and sleep science research.
- Access your Sleep Number Rewards account to learn about sleep, refer friends, access exclusive benefits, earn free bedding and even shop Sleep Number products.
- Marketplace lets you sync with health and fitness apps and future partnerships to come.
- Participate in research studies to advance the science of sleep and health.
SUPPORT
- Connect with us, track orders and manage deliveries.
- Check your smart bed connectivity and more plus troubleshooting if needed.
- Learn more about your smart bed and smart sleep.
- Chat or talk with Sleep Number support

Renegade Racing
The hit online game with over 190 MILLION PLAYS has made its way to mobile, bigger and crazier than ever before -- and now with multiplayer!
Renegade Racing is an adrenaline-filled, wacky multiplayer racing game. Perform epic stunts to gain turbo and race your way to victory!

details_full_description:
JusTalk Kids - Safe Messenger
JusTalk Kids is a FREE voice and video calling and instant messaging app specially designed for children. It provides a safe space for kids to stay connected with family, friends, and schoolmates, without exposure to inappropriate content or strangers. All communication is encrypted to ensure privacy. The app also includes fun educational videos, a drawing board, and a text editor to encourage creativity and learning. We are committed to enhancing JusTalk Kids to offer a secure, rich, and engaging experience for children.
Key Features:
Kids Friends Management
To ensure safety, parents receive instant notifications when their child tries to add a friend. Parents can approve or deny requests, keeping the friend list safe and limited to trusted contacts.
Block Strangers
Both users must approve each other to become friends. A parental password allows parents full control over app usage.
Sensitive Content Warning
The system blocks and alerts parents when sensitive images or videos are detected. Parents can decide what is appropriate, guiding kids in handling complex content.
JusTalk Parent Account
The Parent Account connects with the child’s account, making it easier for parents to communicate and manage activity.
High-Definition Voice and Video Calls
Kids can enjoy 1-on-1 or group video and voice calls in high quality. Calls support real-time games, doodling, and call recording—making conversations more interactive and fun.
KidsBooks
KidsBooks offers fun picture books with audio narration, helping children enjoy stories, build vocabulary, and spark imagination. Parents and kids can read or listen together, making story time more engaging, educational, and family-friendly.
Sticker Store and Custom Stickers
Kids can explore fun sticker packs in the Sticker Store or add custom stickers to make chats more expressive and personal.
Group Polls
When kids, family, or friends need to choose a time, activity, or plan together, polls help everyone share opinions and decide quickly in group chats.
Walkie Talkie Mode
Walkie Talkie lets kids send real-time voice messages by simply tapping—no need to make a call. Great for quick chats with family and friends, with auto-play and safe contact switching.
Interactive Games
Play built-in games while on calls. These puzzles and challenges help kids build logic, creativity, and social skills while staying entertained.
Feature-Rich IM Chat
Chat safely using text, images, videos, files, emojis, stickers, voice messages, and GIFs. Kids improve writing and communication while staying connected.
Share Moments
Children can post drawings, music, or thoughts—capturing and sharing special moments with family and friends.
Kidstube Educational Videos
Kidstube offers fun, safe educational content, from science to art, helping children explore and learn.
Comprehensive Safety and Privacy Protection
Kids’ privacy is protected with parent-controlled settings, private profiles, no ads, and no exposure to strangers.
Terms: https://kids.justalk.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://kids.justalk.com/privacy.html
We're always excited to hear from you! Please feel free to contact us via email: kids@justalk.com

- Important information for entry to the Grounds

🌱 A Championships companion

Download now to experience every moment of Wimbledon.

Wingo
WINGO is a multiplayer entertainment game that allows multiple participants to play in a live draw simultaneously. Players can register or play without signing up through the app's homepage.
The game features periodic updates to playing modes, offering new and exciting experiences throughout the year. Any changes or updates are announced directly through the app.
* How to Play
Players register a card containing a number grid (5×5 or 7×7, depending on the event).
A live draw is conducted on the "Nessma El Jadida" channel, where players follow the drawn numbers and match them with their registered grids.
A card is considered a winner when a specific winning pattern is completed according to the game rules.
* Card Types
Players can choose classic cards (5×5) or special cards (7×7 or other sizes for special occasions).
The draw consists of 75 or 90 balls, depending on the rules of each round.
* App Features
-> Live & exciting gameplay – Follow the live draw on TV and interact with the drawn numbers.

-> Continuous updates – Various playing modes and special events throughout the year.

Chess King - Learn to Play
Don't just play chess. Train like a master. Chess King teaches the game the way strong players are actually built — with a rigorous, structured curriculum, not a random feed of puzzles.
Want to master chess or take your game to the next level? Chess King is a comprehensive learning platform for players of all levels: from beginners making their first moves to experienced chess players looking to hone their tactics and strategy.
The app acts like an experienced mentor: it offers structured courses, provides hints when you make mistakes, explains correct solutions and shows rebuttals to incorrect moves. You don’t just solve puzzles — you understand the logic behind every decision.
Program advantages:
♔ More than 100 courses to choose from: pick the one that suits you best!
♔ University mode: master the material step by step and watch your skills improve. This mode is perfect for those who want to learn systematically using a ready‑made curriculum.
♔ High‑quality puzzles: each puzzle has been verified for accuracy. You need to find all the key moves intended by the author, taking into account possible alternatives in response to your opponent’s moves.
♔ Smart assistant: the app will show you why a move was unsuccessful and how your opponent could have responded. If you get stuck, you can play out the move against the computer.
♔ Interactive theoretical lessons: you can not only read the lesson texts but also make moves on the board and independently analyse unclear points with the computer’s help.
♔ Position analysis: any position from practical puzzles and theoretical lessons can be analysed using the built‑in chess engine.
♔ Tactics development: special exercises and courses on chess tactics, including versions adapted for children.
♔ Opening study: train with the opening trainer, explore the opening tree and consolidate your understanding of the early stages of the game.
♔ Level assessment: take a short test and the app will determine your current level for any of the University programs — so you can start learning from the right place right away.
♔ Play anywhere: train offline — you only need an internet connection to sync data and download new courses.
♔ Progress tracking: monitor your performance in the statistics section — the app saves your rating history and daily task load.
♔ Daily goal reminder: choose a comfortable daily number of puzzles and get a reminder to train at a convenient time.
♔ Unified account: link your free Chess King account and continue learning on other devices (Android, iOS, macOS, Web) without losing progress or access to purchased courses.
♔ Tablet support: the interface is optimised for large screens.

details_full_description:
LastQuake
LastQuake is a free, mobile application dedicated to alerting populations and gathering testimonies in real-time when an earthquake occurs. Designed by seismologists, LastQuake is the official app of the Euro-Mediterranean Seismological Center (EMSC). Thanks to the participative action of its users, only a few minutes are needed for the EMSC to estimate earthquake effects and notify the population.
[LastQuake is an ad-free app!]
╍ NEW VERSION ╍
We're excited to introduce you to this new version of LastQuake, designed to provide an improved user experience and more advanced features for tracking earthquakes in your area and around the world.
What's new in this version:
- A dynamic home page with an interactive map showing the distribution of earthquakes around the world. This feature provides a better understanding of seismic activity in your region and around the world.
- A search function now allows you to quickly find earthquakes by specifying date, magnitude, and geographic region. You can then filter earthquakes based on your personal criteria.
- You can now save earthquakes for quick and easy access to information. This feature allows you to keep track of important earthquakes and their progress.
- You can now customize your notifications to receive alerts according to your preferences: voice alert, earthquakes near you, minimum magnitude, maximum distance, etc.
- Following feedback from users who complained that the home page didn't provide enough information about earthquakes at a glance and that they preferred the earthquake list, we've added the ability to choose which page you land on directly when you open the application (the classic home page or the earthquake list).
- Automatic translation of comments when you click on them.
╍ AN INNOVATIVE EARTHQUAKE DETECTION METHOD ╍
EMSC detects earthquakes using:
∘ Earthquake witnesses, who are the first to feel an earthquake, hence the first informed that an event is happening.
∘ Internet and mobile technologies, which allow rapid information collection of the effects observed by witnesses, who are asked to fill in a questionnaire and share photos and videos.
Want to learn more about our detection system? Watch this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sNCaHFxhZ5E
╍ YOUR INVOLVEMENT MATTERS ╍
LastQuake is a citizen science project. Your contribution helps refine our understanding of earthquake effects while fostering our support in disaster preparation and response.
╍ WHAT IS EMSC? ╍
EMSC is an international non-profit scientific NGO founded in 1975. Based in France, EMSC federates data from the seismological observatories of 86 institutes from 57 countries. While operating a real-time earthquake information service, EMSC advocates for public participation in scientific research. Its core product, LastQuake, paves the way for innovative approaches to building more disaster-resilient communities, making EMSC among the pioneers of disaster apps dedicated to earthquakes and tsunamis.

The ultimate music reading training app. Designed like a video game and with strong pedagogical concepts in mind, Complete Music Reading Trainer is the fastest way to learn to read sheet music and improve your sight-reading skills. Whichever clef you want to learn and whatever your instrument is, the app will make you master any chosen clef or clef combination while rendering the learning process enjoyable.
Features
• 270 progressive drills covering all seven clefs (treble, bass, alto, tenor, soprano, mezzo-soprano and baritone clefs) over 3 levels / 26 chapters
• Content is organized in such a way that you can choose which levels or chapters are relevant to your instrument and focus on these, whether you play the guitar and only need treble clef, piano and need treble and bass clef, cello and need a mix of bass and tenor clefs, etc.: all instruments are covered
• Practice key signatures up to 6 sharps/flats in progressive key signature drills
• Practice common clef combinations in mixed clef drills
• Play a selection of 19 drills in arcade mode
• 5 octaves of actual recorded grand piano sounds
• 6 additional sound banks are available, all with actual recorded sounds: vintage piano, Rhodes piano, electric guitar, harpsichord, concert harp and pizzicato strings
• 4 ways to input notes: note circle, virtual piano keyboard, by connecting a MIDI controller, or by playing an instrument near your device's microphone
• 4 sheet music display styles: modern, classic, handwritten and jazz
• Designed like a video game: earn 3 stars in each drill of a chapter to complete it. Or will you be able to obtain perfect 5-star scores?
• Don't want to follow the preestablished path of progression? Create and save your own custom drills and rehearse them at your own convenience
• Create full custom training programs and invite friends or students to join them. If for example you're a teacher you can create custom programs for your students, add drills every week and view their scores on private leaderboards
• Never lose any progress: cloud sync across your various devices
• Google Play Games: 35 achievements to unlock
• Google Play Games: leaderboards to compare arcade mode scores with other players worldwide
• Global statistics to track your progress
• Nice and clean material design user interface with 2 display themes: light and dark
• Designed by a musician and music teacher with a Royal Conservatory master's degree
Full Version
• Download the app and try out the first chapter of each clef for free
• One-time in-app purchase of $4.99 to unlock the full version on all your Android devices
Having a problem? Got a suggestion? You can reach us at hello@completemusicreadingtrainer.com

details_full_description:
ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド
Yana Toboso was in charge of the draft, main scenario, and character design.
[Synopsis]
This story depicts the true appearance of "villains".
Guided by a magic mirror, the protagonist is summoned to another world, "Twisted Wonderland."
The destination is the prestigious magician training school "Night Raven College".
With nowhere to go, the main character begins to look for a way to return to the original world under the protection of the masked principal.
However, the students who were waiting there were all talented but problem children with no cooperation.
Can the hero cooperate with them and return to the original world?
And what is the secret of the students who have the soul of the villains?
■Enjoy easy-to-use command battles and rhythm games!
[Game contents]
Along with the students of Nightraven College, I will take classes such as the history of magic, alchemy, and aviation every day.
By taking classes, the story is released, and while reading the story in the adventure part,
We will play the battle part where the character fights using magic and the rhythm part where the notes are tapped according to the music.
As you progress through the story, let's grow together with the characters who live the school life together.
■ Seven dormitories and characters inspired by the world of Disney movies
There are seven dormitories in "Night Raven College", and you will interact with the characters in each dormitory.
Heartslabyul Dormitory twisted from "Alice in Wonderland"
Savana Claw Dormitory twisted from "The Lion King"
Octavinel dormitory twisted from "The Little Mermaid"
Scarabia dormitory twisted from "Aladdin"
Pomfiore Dormitory twisted from "Snow White"

Diasomnia Dormitory twisted from "Sleeping Beauty"

details_full_description:
Kinzoo: Fun All-Ages Messenger
Kinzoo is more than a messenger—it's where memories are made. Kids, parents and extended family come together on this single private platform—sharing experiences that wouldn't otherwise exist. This is a trusted introduction to technology that eases the screen time struggle by giving kids a constructive, skill-building outlet to connect, create and cultivate passions. And, it's a way for kids to deepen social relationships with friends, preparing them to respect others, think critically and be good digital citizens when they grow up.
This all-in-one chat app is designed for ages 6+ and enables you to safely make video calls, exchange pictures, text messages and videos with chosen family and friends—all without the need for a phone number.
SCREEN TIME WELL SPENT
Every feature in Kinzoo is designed to promote our Three C's: connection, creativity and cultivation. This ensures that screen time is engaging, productive and enriching for kids and families. Check out the latest interactive stories and activities in the Paths Center and buy in-chat mini games, photo and video filters and sticker packs in the Marketplace to make messaging even more engaging and fun.
BUILT FOR SAFETY
We believe kids should be able to experience the best of technology—without exposure to the worst of it. That's why we built Kinzoo from the ground up for kids and their parents, prioritizing safety, privacy and peace of mind.
HEALTHY TECHNOLOGY
Kinzoo is free from manipulative features and persuasive design. There are no "likes," no followers, and no targeted ads. It’s a safer space online that puts you—and your whole family—back in control of your digital identities.
CREATING BETTER CONNECTIONS
We’ve built Kinzoo for you and your family. Every day we’re working to build experiences that bring you closer together, spur your creativity and inspire you to cultivate new passions. Connect with us on social media and help us to grow Kinzoo into the world’s most trusted platform for family communication.

TBM mobilités
The TBM app, your go-to for daily and occasional trips within Bordeaux Métropole and its surroundings!
With the TBM app, experience innovative, sustainable, multimodal, and accessible mobility.
CHECK YOUR LINES' TIMETABLES AT ANY TIME
Find the complete schedules of the various TBM network lines (tram, bus, boat), as well as those for trains, TER, and regional coaches, and view the real-time position of your transport on the map before it arrives.
For users of the Le Vélo service or park-and-ride facilities, you can also check the number of bikes or available places in real-time before heading there.
SAVE TIME THANKS TO YOUR FAVORITES
Tram stops, bus or coach stops, TER stations, Le Vélo stations, or park-and-ride facilities, add them to your favorites to access the next departures more quickly or check the number of available places from the home page. Plus, you can sort them to display them in the order of your choice!
FIND THE RIGHT ROUTE FOR YOU AND LET US GUIDE YOU
For an immediate or delayed trip, search for your routes and compare the proposed results based on your preferences to find the best route. Once the route is selected, we guide you to your destination.
BE THE FIRST TO KNOW ABOUT DISRUPTIONS ON YOUR LINES
For more peace of mind during your journeys, network traffic information is accessible in just a few clicks. Activate alerts on your usual lines to be notified of any disruptions affecting your route!
BUY AND VALIDATE TICKETS AND SUBSCRIPTIONS FOR YOU AND YOUR TRAVELERS
Make your life easier by purchasing your transport tickets (single or new subscription) directly from the app and validating them in just a few seconds.
UNLOCK A BIKE AT A STATION WITH YOUR PHONE
With or without a subscription, save time by unlocking a bike directly from your smartphone without using the terminal.
OPEN A PARK-AND-RIDE OR BIKE SHELTER WITH YOUR PHONE
No need for a ticket or card anymore! If you have a compatible ticket, you can open any park-and-ride or bike shelter directly with your smartphone.
ENJOY ALL THE SERVICES OFFERED BY TBM
With your unique mobility account, you can use the different TBM services both on mobile and the web without needing multiple accounts.

details_full_description:
Dexcom G6
Only use this app if you have the Dexcom G6 or G6 Pro CGM Systems.
Always know your glucose number and where it’s heading with the Dexcom G6 and G6 Pro Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) Systems –indicated for diabetes treatment decisions with zero fingersticks and no calibration.* A core feature of the Dexcom G6 and G6 Pro Systems is providing users with alarm/alerts based on their glucose level.
*Fingersticks required for diabetes management decisions if symptoms do not match readings.
Dexcom G6 and G6 Pro provide real-time glucose readings for patients with type 1 or type 2 diabetes every five minutes. Dexcom G6 and G6 Pro are indicated for children age 2 years and older.
The Dexcom G6 and G6 Pro Systems provide personalized trend alerts right on your smart device and lets you see when your glucose levels are going too low, or too high, so you can better manage your diabetes. The Alert Schedule** feature lets you schedule and customize a second set of alerts. For example, you can set the schedule to match your work hours and have different alert settings during the rest of the day. Custom alert sounds are available, including a Vibrate-Only option on the phone for glucose alerts. The only exception is the Urgent Low Alarm, which you can’t turn off.
The Always Sound** setting, which is on by default, allows you to receive certain Dexcom CGM Alerts even if your phone sound is off, set to vibrate, or in Do Not Disturb mode. This will allow you to silence calls or texts but still receive audible CGM Alarm and Alerts, including the Urgent Low Alarm, Low and High Glucose alerts, Urgent Low Soon Alert**, and Rise and Fall Rate alerts**. A Home screen icon shows you if your Alerts will sound or not. For safety, the Urgent Low Alarm and three alerts cannot be silenced: Transmitter Failed, Sensor Failed, and App Stopped.
Other features:
Share** your glucose data with up to ten followers in real time. Followers can monitor your glucose data and trends in real time on their compatible smart device with the Dexcom Follow** app. Share and Follow functions require an internet connection.
Health Connect access so you can share retrospective glucose data with third party apps
Quick Glance allows you to view your glucose data on the lock screen of your smart device
**Not available on Dexcom G6 Pro System
Wear OS Integration allows you to view glucose alerts and alarms from your Wear OS watch.

Google Classroom
Classroom makes it easy for learners and instructors to connect—inside and outside of schools. Classroom saves time and paper, and makes it easy to create classes, distribute assignments, communicate, and stay organized.
There are many benefits to using Classroom:
• Easy to set up – Teachers can add students directly or share a code with their class to join. It takes just minutes to set up.
• Saves time – The simple, paperless assignment workflow allows teachers to create, review and mark assignments quickly, all in one place.
• Improves organization – Students can see all of their assignments on an assignments page, and all class materials (e.g., documents, photos, and videos) are automatically filed into folders in Google Drive.
• Enhances communication – Classroom allows teachers to send announcements and start class discussions instantly. Students can share resources with each other or provide answers to questions on the stream.
• Secure – Like the rest of Google Workspace for Education services, Classroom contains no ads, never uses your content or student data for advertising purposes.

details_full_description:
Okoo - dessins animés & vidéos
Find all the cartoons and videos from France Télévisions for children, in a 100% free application, without advertising, secure and specially designed for 3-12 year olds and their parents!
With Okoo there is something for everyone
More than 8000 videos, cartoons, series, shows, nursery rhymes, exclusives and all your children's favorite heroes, young and old alike!
Downloadable videos to take anywhere
Download videos of your favorite heroes via wifi or 4G/5G then watch them when you are out of network, in the car, on the train, on vacation, wherever you are and whenever you want!
Podcasts to listen to
Original audio content for every age to listen to at any time for free. Songs, original series and new stories from Okoo heroes, for quiet time without screens. You can lock the phone while still listening to audio.
A customizable application depending on the age of the children
Our priority is that children watch suitable videos and cartoons. Indicate your child's age to display an interface and content that meets their needs and uses.
A secure application
The application is equipped with a timer which allows you to limit the time spent in front of screens. Parental controls prevent young people from accessing the settings, a part reserved for adults.
The settings also allow them to authorize or not the change of age, if for example the application is shared between several children.
Free and without advertising
Okoo is a free video and cartoon application for children offered by the public service. It guarantees content without advertising, without subscription and without any in-app purchases to be accessible to all and without constraints.
Easy to use
Depending on the age selected, the application interface will be different to adapt to the maturity of each child. So, it is simple and with sound for the little ones and more elaborate for the adults.
Viewing comfort thanks to the cast
It is possible to stream a video or cartoon from your mobile phone or tablet to your TV (depending on the compatibility of your equipment). Simply click on the cast icon and your device becomes your remote control. Your child can watch their favorite videos quietly on the TV.
The merger between Ludo and Zouzous
The Okoo app was born from the merger between Ludo and Zouzous (formerly Midi les Zouzous)!
Among all the programs available
Peppa Pig, Ninjago, Simon, Masha and Michka, It's still not rocket science, The Pyjamasques, Askip, Scooby-doo!, Lolirock, Angelo the resourcefulness, Oscar and Malika, Bluey, Okoo-koo, Wakfu, Les As de la jungle, T'Choupi, Foot2Rue, Léna dreams of a star... and many other free videos and cartoons.
Do you like Okoo?
Please let us know by leaving a rating and comment.
A question about Okoo? Write to us at okoo@francetv.fr for any comments or suggestions.
For rights reasons, the programs are only accessible on French territory and overseas territories.
This application is free excluding the cost of subscription to the operator and excluding any additional costs charged by the operator for loading and sending data. As the use of this application may result in significant data consumption, particularly when viewing videos, France Télévisions recommends that you check with your mobile operator that you have a subscription suitable for this use.
Okoo collects anonymous data in order to improve the experience and notify you of new developments (subject to consent).
This application requires at least Android 7 Nougat as well as a 3G or wifi connection.
