Qureka: Play Quizzes & Learn
Qureka lets you test your knowledge and earn coins by doing some real fun brain led activities:
1. Playing daily live quiz shows (15+ shows daily)
2. Playing hourly quiz every hour across categories like GK, Sports and more
3. Playing cricket quiz & exam prep quizzes
*Qureka Live Quiz:*
You can play live quizzes on Qureka starting from 9AM to 9PM. The live quizzes are available in English & Hindi as of now. The live quiz show has 10 questions (might vary) and you get 10 seconds to answer each question. Our daily prize gets split amongst all the winners equally, and in case there is no winner the prize gets added to the prize for the next show. Qureka also gives you opportunity to earn coins that help you from elimination in live quiz. In any live quiz show, 30 coins get applied automatically on your 1st wrong answer (not applicable on last question). You can earn coins in multiple ways. There are multiple mini quizzes running few times a day, where you can play & earn coins.
*Hourly Quizzes:*
Apart from live quizzes, you can also come and play hourly quizzes on Qureka to test your knowledge across categories & also win coins. These quizzes are live throughout the day and you can come and play them anytime. You get 90 seconds to play each hourly quiz, tr & answer as many questions as you can in these 90 seconds to get a good score. You get 20 points for every right answer, (-)10 points for every wrong answer and you also get a bonus 10 points every time you answer 3 questions correctly in a row. Your score at the end of 90 seconds determines your rank and your rank determines how much coins you win from the quiz. Hourly quizzes on Qureka are available in many categories, some of them are:
- GK Quiz
- Sports Quiz
- Math Quiz
- Flim & Celeb Quiz
- World Quiz
- Business Quiz
- History Quiz
- Geography Quiz
- Literature Quiz
- Politics Quiz
*Cricket Quiz:*
Qureka offers a seperate section to play quizzes around cricket. Cricket quizzes can be played across categories and you can win coins by playing these quizzes as well. Categories available under cricket quiz are:
1. IPL Quiz
2. Cricket World Cup Quiz
3. Indian Cricketers Quiz
4. Quizzes Around Cricketing Records
5. Cricket Knowledge Quiz
All these quizzes let you test your cricketing knowledge. There are multiple quizzes running throughout the day in this section, you can come and play them anytime of your choice.
*Exam Prep Quiz:*
You can also come and play quizzes to prepare for a competitive exam. Qureka offers the 'Exam Prep' section where you can come and answer questions that appeared in the last few years in multiple competitive exams in India, and you can also win coins in this section, categories of quzzies in this section are:
- UPSC Exam Quiz
- SSC Exam Quiz
- Bank PO Exam Quiz
- 10+2 Entrance Exam Quiz
- Management Exam Quiz
Qureka is completely free and at no point do we ask users to pay us for playing a game, there is no gambling involved when you play games on Qureka. Generally, all the quizzes will be free to join, but there will be special quiz games which will require coins to join the game. So keeping sufficient coins in your wallet is recommended at all times.

details_full_description:
BabySleep: Whitenoise lullaby
Puts your baby to sleep.
This app is intended especially for parents of newborns. It helps them put their babies to sleep instantly. The app uses classic white noise sounds (lullabies) proven to be more effective than music, tones or sung by generations of parents! They resemble the natural sounds of the womb and thus create a calming environment for the babies they are used to.
Why is my baby crying?
Your baby is fed, has a clean nappy, no issues with colic, you were playing with your baby but still it is crying? The baby is probably too tired, but at the same time unable to fall asleep by itself. This is a common situation of newborns and a situation when Baby Sleep can help the most.
Baby Sleep helps you to put your baby to sleep using classic monotonous low frequency sounds proven to be effective by generations of parents.
Available lullabies:
• Shower
• Washing machine
• Car
• Hairdryer
• Vacuum cleaner
• Shush
• Fan
• Train
• Musicbox
• Heartbeats
• Sea
• White/Brown/Pink noise
From practical experience, we have learned that such sounds are more effective as a lullaby than tones, music or sing which on the contrary makes the baby rather pay attention.
Even for older babies Baby Sleep helps to increase the overall noise level in the room, so that sudden urban sounds like traffic would not disturb your baby from sleeping.
Baby Sleep is easy to use. Every lullaby has a specific color and a symbol. A timer will automatically stop the lullaby when times run out. All sounds are available offline so you do not need the internet.
We do highly recommend not putting the phone closer to the baby than necessary and turning on airplane mode as well as muting alerts during the entire use of this app.

📢📝 Posting ads for rent and sale of real estate
Post ads for the sale or rent of any type of real estate. The personal account has tools for communicating with buyers and tenants. We also offer support from our agents who will help resolve any issues related to the real estate market, ensuring a smooth process of buying, selling or renting an apartment and other real estate.
🏢💼Search for commercial real estate for your business
Look for commercial real estate to buy or rent that suits all your business needs, including offices, warehouses, and retail spaces. Convenient filters will help you quickly find a suitable option based on the required parameters. The service provides a wide selection of real estate for different purposes and budgets.
💰📊Fast and free real estate appraisal
Find out the market price of an apartment, house or other real estate quickly and for free. Get data on the cadastral value, current rental rates and price history for the property you are interested in. This will help you accurately assess the cost, invest profitably and make an informed decision when selling, buying, renting real estate and applying for a mortgage.

ABHA
The National Health Authority (NHA) under its flagship scheme of Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) has revamped the Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) mobile application of the Government of India (GoI) with a new User Interface (UI) and new functionalities. This will enable the Indian citizens to do easy registration of ABHA address (username@abdm). ABHA Mobile application provides the individuals with a longitudinal view of health records with an option to link and share post user consent through ABDM network of different health facilities and providers. . Create an easy to remember ABHA Address (username@abdm) with mobile number, email ID or ABHA number.
. Link ABHA address with 14digit ABHA number to become KYC verified and
utilize benefits of government health programs.
. Discover health facilities to link, view and manage health records by citizens.
. Access health records such as lab reports, prescriptions, CoWIN vaccination certificates
etc.
. Share health records with registered doctors, health facilities or health programs.
. Own and Control access of your health records in terms of who can access, what type of health information can be accessed and for what duration.
. Option to revoke consent to stop sharing of your health records after granting consent.
. Option to Edit Profile details including address and update the mobile no or email with respective OTP validation.
. Scan QR code at the counter of the ABDM compliant facility for express registration. ABHA Mobile application is currently available in Hindi and English and would soon be available in other languages. For better user experience, you are requested to kindly update all new “ABHA App” with new
features and enhancements. You may now create ABHA Address using multiple options via Mobile Number, Email ID or 14-digit ABHA Number. You may also link and share your records post your consent.

• Group tabs by topic with one click to keep browsing organized and clutter free.
• Customize your experience with extensions for shopping, blocking distractions, and more.
• View webpages your way with page translation as you browse.

details_full_description:
RailOne
RailOne: Your All-in-One App by Indian Railways
RailOne is a comprehensive app developed by Indian Railways, designed to consolidate all public-facing services into a single, user-friendly platform. By integrating multiple functionalities into one app, RailOne simplifies the travel experience with a seamless single sign-on (SSO) system. Whether you’re planning a trip, booking tickets, or seeking additional services during your journey, RailOne is your ultimate travel companion.
Key Features:
Plan and Book Tickets: Effortlessly plan journeys, search for trains, and book reserved or unreserved tickets through the app. This consolidation reduces the need for multiple platforms, streamlining the booking process.
- My- Bookings: This functionality enables the users to check the details and history information of both booked and canceled tickets (unreserved and reserved) at the same platform. User interface presents the filtering functionality as per user’s preference based on duration and transaction type.
-You: This functionality enables users to view profile details and edit if needed. Also shows status of profile completion. Gives access for changing password, enabling/disabling biometric. Users can also verify email, edit their name (can be done only once) and delete account. These options are available under My Account Tab. User can also Add money to his R-wallet.
Real-time Train Tracking: Track your train in real-time with live updates on delays, expected arrival times, and other critical information, keeping you informed and helping you adjust your plans.
Coach Position Finder: Locate your coach’s position on the platform easily, making the boarding process smoother and more convenient.
Order Food on the Go: Place food orders from partner vendors while on board, ensuring fresh and timely meals during your journey.
Rail Madad: Use the Rail Madad feature to raise and track complaints or feedback directly with Indian Railways for quick resolution.
Refund Requests: Simplify the process of requesting refunds for canceled or missed journeys through the app.
Multilingual Support: Access the app in multiple languages, catering to India’s diverse population and enhancing accessibility.
R-Wallet Integration: Utilize R-Wallet, a digital wallet integrated into the app, for secure and convenient payments for various services.
RailOne is available for download on both the Google Play Store and Apple App Store, ensuring accessibility for both Android and iOS users.
The app is developed by CRIS (Centre for Railway Information Systems), an organization under the Ministry of Railways. CRIS combines skilled IT professionals with experienced railway personnel to design, develop, and maintain critical software systems for Indian Railways. Key systems developed by CRIS include:
Reserved Ticketing System: Efficiently manages millions of long-distance seat bookings.
Unreserved Ticketing System: Facilitates easy ticketing for short-distance journeys.
Train Search and Tracking: Offers real-time train search and tracking features.
Coach Position Finder: Enhances the boarding process by helping passengers find their coach.
Rail Madad: Manages grievances and feedback effectively.
Food Ordering System: Allows passengers to order food from partner vendors.
Refund Systems: Processes refunds smoothly for booking errors and cancellations.
CRIS continues to lead in innovation, developing integrated solutions that make travel more efficient. The partnership between CRIS and Indian Railways has been instrumental in modernizing railway infrastructure and enhancing passenger services through advanced technology. RailOne embodies this digital evolution, making train travel smarter, more comfortable, and more accessible. With ongoing developments in RailOne and CRIS’s IT systems, Indian Railways aims to provide an exceptional travel experience, leveraging technology to simplify every aspect of your journey.

Duo Mobile
Duo Mobile works with Duo Security's two-factor authentication service to make logins more secure. The application generates passcodes for login and can receive push notifications for easy, one-tap authentication.
Additionally, you can use Duo Mobile to manage two-factor authentication for other application and web services that make use of passcodes.
Duo Mobile also has a companion app for Wear OS, Duo Wear, making secure authentication even more convenient on your smartwatch.
Note: For Duo accounts, Duo Mobile needs to be activated and linked to your account before it will work. You will receive an activation link as part of Duo's enrollment process. You may add third-party accounts at any time.
Additionally, we will request access to use your camera for the sole purpose of scanning QR codes when activating accounts. Accounts can be activated by other methods if you choose not to do so.
License agreements for third-party Open Source libraries used in Duo Mobile can be found at https://www.duosecurity.com/legal/open-source-licenses.

Trainline: Train travel Europe
Welcome, future Trainliner. Get on board with millions of world-wide users, today, to travel confidently with us – Europe’s leading train and bus app.
Why?
Whether heading to an international city or from an international terminal, in a matter of clicks you’ll be booking the best seats in advance or saving money on-the-day with our Best Price Guarantee. And for those who like to stay looped, you can turn on real-time notifications and keep an eye on live timetable tracking – you can even use Crowd Alerts to find out how busy your train is. Plus, forgetting, misplacing, or totally destroying your paper tickets becomes a thing of the past when you purchase digital versions through our app!
With so much to see and do, getting there should be the easy part – and when you book through our app, it is! Find cheap tickets for Eurostar, Avanti West Coast, GWR, LNER, National Express, Renfe, Iryo, Trenitalia, Italo, and many other European rail lines. Or if you want to buy bus tickets, simply search and book directly in the app. Need some travel inspo first? We got that covered, too, with travel blogs and suggested “popular journeys”.
So, whether you want to book bus seats, get cheap train tickets, or stay updated during your journey, you can always rely on our app to deliver the goods.

- Buy all your tickets in one place – plan your dream country-hopping journey on our app.

- Add Cancel for Any Reason to your booking for cover up to 15 minutes before departure.
- Save plans for later and lock in tickets for up to 7 days.
- Find the best value train tickets using our price calendar.

So, download our FREE Trainline app and get access to everything you need to train across the UK and Europe like a pro.

Tabla: India's mystical drum
Tabla: Indian Percussion, Drums & Mystical Beats.
The Tabla app provides all the tools you need to master the art of traditional Indian percussion on your smartphone or tablet. Experience the authentic sound of the Orient and play any music, anywhere! Perfect for music lovers, meditators, and aspiring percussionists.
What is a Tabla? The Tabla is a legendary Hindu percussion instrument, essential in devotional, meditative, and classical Indian music. It features a pair of drums: the high-pitched Daya and the deep, resonant Baya. Now, you can carry this rich musical heritage in your pocket!
Why Choose Our Tabla Simulator? Whether you are a beginner or a pro, our app offers step-by-step video lessons and interactive loops to help you play. With high-fidelity audio, you’ll feel like you’re playing a real instrument in a professional studio.
No Access to a Real Tabla? No Problem! Our app faithfully simulates a real tabla set alongside a wide range of world percussion instruments. Learn, practice, and perform without needing a bulky physical setup. It’s the ultimate choice for practicing quietly without disturbing others.
Boost Your Musical Talent Ideal for both kids and adults, the Tabla app enhances coordination, rhythm, and cognitive skills. More than just a drum game, it’s a gateway to learning complex beats and spiritual melodies like Mantras and Kirtans.
Explore the Amazing Features:
- 100+ Step-by-Step Lessons: Learn to play from scratch.
- Pro Studio Audio: High-quality, crystal-clear sound samples.
- Diverse Percussion: Includes cymbals and other world instruments.
- Interactive Loops: Play along with authentic rhythmic patterns.
- Recording & Export: Save your sessions and export to MP3.
- Social Sharing: Show your talent to friends and on social media.
- Weekly Updates: Fresh lessons and loops added every week.
- Advanced Support: MIDI support and HD visuals for Tablets & Phones.
- 100% Free: Experience the best tabla game on Google Play.
Stop waiting to become a master percussionist. Download Tabla now and unleash your rhythm!
From the creators of the Real Drum app!
Download the Tabla app and turn your fingers into drumsticks right now!
Follow us on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube for tips on using the app: @kolbapps

Scout: Family Location 360
Stay effortlessly connected to your loved ones with Scout: Family Location 360, the trusted GPS family tracker and location sharing app designed for real-time visibility, peace of mind, and safety on the road.
Whether you’re checking if your kids made it to school, coordinating with a spouse, or monitoring your teen’s driving habits, Scout makes it simple to track, share, and stay informed.
🔹 Live Location Sharing 360 & Real-Time GPS Tracker
Track your family’s live location on a real-time map using our advanced GPS tracker. Scout provides accurate, up-to-date positioning so you always know where your loved ones are -no more guessing or constant texting. Scout doubles as a family location tracker, ensuring the safety of your loved ones. Stay connected and worry-free with improved accuracy for all your Location Sharing needs.
🔹 Family Location & Place Alerts
Get instant notifications when family members arrive at or leave key locations like home, school, or work. Set up custom location alerts and receive real-time updates to help keep everyone in sync.
🔹 Find Family & Friends Location Instantly
Use our enhanced 360 Locator to quickly see everyone’s location at a glance. Need to see someone in person? Our new feature lets you instantly start navigation to any family member's location - right within the Scout app. Just tap and go!
🔹 Driving Safety Insights & Child Safety Reports
Scout Family Location 360 acts as a powerful child safety app, helping parents monitor teen drivers. Track speeding, hard braking, acceleration, and phone use behind the wheel. Get alerted to critical safety events.
🔹 Weekly Driving Reports
Stay informed with automatic weekly driving reports that show trip history, behavior trends, and safety scores. Use this data to coach safer driving and recognize improvement.
🔹 Visual Status Indicators
Quickly check who’s at home, at work, or driving with status icons displayed next to each family member’s avatar, making it easier than ever to stay in the loop.
🔹 Location History and Safety Tracking
Review past trips or verify locations anytime. Scout: Family Location Sharing keeps secure location history for each family member, giving you peace of mind and visibility over time.
Why Families Choose Scout
• Built for modern families who want reliable GPS location sharing
• Combines live tracking, place alerts, and driving safety in one app
• Helps parents stay connected to kids and teens on the move
• Easy to use, beautifully designed, and privacy-first
• Navigate directly to family members when needed
Have feedback or questions? Email us at scout@telenav.com — we’d love to hear from you.
Thank you for being with Scout: Family Location 360!
Please keep in mind:
Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.
Scout’s map and search coverage are currently for the USA only.

details_full_description:
Driefcase ABHA, Health Records
We always organize our important documents, but our medical records are generally all over the place. Driefcase helps you manage all your health records by digitally storing and organizing them so that you can quickly and easily access and share them anytime, anywhere, in under 10 seconds!
Driefcase is India’s 1st smart health locker and PHR (Personal Health Records) app approved by ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission) that supports quick retrieval and sharing of digital health records.
With the Driefcase PHR app you can:
1. Retrieve medical records anytime, anywhere: Ensure that the next time the doctor asks you something about your medical history, you are able to empower him with that information in a timely manner. With Driefcase, you will never have to worry about damaging, losing, forgetting, or finding your medical records when required.
2. Organize medical records: Automatically arrange, index, and tag all your medical records on the basis of categories such as doctor’s name, type of health record, date, hospital/clinic name, etc. to retrieve any medical record in less than 10 seconds.
3. Manage your family’s health documents: Create profiles of all family members within a single account to manage and keep track of family’s health documents and health history using Driefcase App.
4. Conveniently upload medical documents via Whatsapp or email: Directly upload your health records in your account by sending them on Driefcase’s WhatsApp number +91-8080802509 or by mailing them on the dedicated email address given to each user.
5. Share medical documents: Easily share your digital health documents with doctors, hospitals/clinics, diagnostic labs, TPAs, and health insurers anytime, and anywhere, and avoid carrying them around with you.
6. Build medical history: Upload any type of medical documents, including prescriptions, test reports, and even X-Ray files to build a consistent and complete medical history.
7. Add reminders: Set reminders for important health events such as a visit to doctor, refilling medicines, vaccination appointment, etc.
8. Become a part of ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission): Join ABDM, India’s digital healthcare ecosystem, by creating your ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) under ABDM, and link all your medical records to your ABHA (previously known as Health ID) to access healthcare benefits ranging from public health programmes to insurance schemes.
9. Manage document sharing consent over ABDM: Give consent to movement of health data linked with your ABHA (previously known as Health ID) amongst healthcare providers.
Driefcase is free to download and gives you unlimited storage on the cloud. There are no hidden charges. We only charge for our Premium Services.
For more information and terms of use, visit us at www.driefcase.com
Download the Driefcase app to organize your health records and take control of your health.

- Prepare the food for Hello Kitty in her incredible kitchen.

- Use the accessories of each dress.

- Have fun combining dresses and accessories from different countries and cultures.

- Learn with the file and characteristics of each country.

Link to Windows
You love your phone. So does your PC. Get instant access to everything you love on your phone, right from your PC. To get started, install the Link to Windows app on your Android phone and connect it with the Phone Link on your Windows PC.
Link your Android phone and PC to view and reply to text messages, make and receive calls*, view your notifications, and more.
Make emailing yourself photos a thing of the past as you share your favorite images between your phone and PC. Copy, edit, and even drag and drop photos without ever touching your phone.
Phone Link features:
• Make and receive calls from your PC*
• Manage your Android phone's notifications on your PC
• Access your favorite mobile apps** on your PC
• Read and reply to text messages from your PC
• Drag files between your PC and phone**
• Copy and paste content between your PC and phone**
• Instantly access the photos on your phone from your PC
• Use your PC's bigger screen, keyboard, mouse, and touch screen to interact with your phone from your PC.
Integrated with select** Microsoft Duo, Samsung, and HONOR phones for an even better experience:
The Link to Windows app comes integrated so no additional apps need to be downloaded from the Play Store.
Link to Windows is easy to find in the Quick Access tray (swipe down from the top of your screen to access it).
Exclusive features like cross-device copy and paste, Phone screen, file drag-and-drop, and Apps.
Let us know what features you'd like to see next by selecting “Send feedback” in the Phone Link settings.
*Calls requires a Windows 10 PC with Bluetooth capability.
**Drag and drop, Phone screen and Apps all require a compatible Microsoft Duo, Samsung or HONOR device (full list and breakdown of capabilities: aka.ms/phonelinkdevices). The multiple apps experience requires a Windows 10 PC running the May 2020 Update or later and has at least 8GB of RAM, and your Android device must be running Android 11.0.
The Link to Windows accessibility service is for those using a screen reading tool on the PC. When the service is enabled, it lets you control all your phone’s apps from your PC using Android keyboard navigation while receiving spoken feedback from your PC speakers. No personal or sensitive data is collected via Accessibility Service.

details_full_description:
Fasten Russia: Taxi
Fasten is a new ride-hailing service. It makes getting around the city easy and affordable.
• Service classes for any occasion
Fasten is for when you want to pay less and get picked up fast. For more comfortable trips, choose Comfort or Comfort+ for spacious cars with a smooth ride. When you're in the mood for something special, choose Business class. These cars don't have any branding, come with free bottled water and phone chargers, and drivers have a strict dress code and are more attentive to your preferences. For even more affordable rides with other users, choose the Share class. When you're riding with children, choose Kids for cars with child safety seats and booster seats. And when you need the fastest pickup, the Fastest service class is your perfect choice.
• Easy payment
You can pay in cash or by card and see the price before the ride starts.
• Stops along the way
Want to stop by the store or pick up a friend? No problem! Just enter the addresses in the app and Fasten will automatically map the optimal route and instantly calculate the total price. You can add up to three stops.
• Ride history
Check all the details from any of your past rides. Plus, if you forget your hat or headphones in a car, contact the driver directly in the app up to 24 hours after the ride.
• Favorites and suggestions
Take a lot of rides to the same places? Add them to your Favorites to easily select them in the future without having to enter them manually every time. Our system also automatically shows the best location on the map for quicker and more affordable pickups.
• Everything you need, nothing you don't
Fasten is just for rides. No extra buttons or app sections.
Fasten is available in 160+ cities across Russia, including Moscow, St. Petersburg, Novosibirsk, Yekaterinburg, Nizhny Novgorod, Kazan, Chelyabinsk, Omsk, Samara, Rostov-on-Don, Ufa, Krasnoyarsk, Perm, Voronezh, Volgograd, Krasnodar, and Sochi.

details_full_description:
Health Connect
Health Connect by Android gives you a simple way to share data between your health, fitness, and wellbeing apps without compromising on privacy.
Once you've downloaded Health Connect, you can access it through your settings by going to Settings > Apps > Health Connect, or from your Quick Settings menu.
Get more from your favorite apps. Whether you're focused on activity or sleep, nutrition or vitals, sharing data between your apps can help you better understand your health. Health Connect gives you simple controls, so you only share the data you want to.
Keep your health and fitness data in one place. Health Connect stores the health and fitness data from your apps in one place, offline and on your device, so you can easily manage the data from your different apps.
Update privacy settings in a few taps. Before a new app can access your data, you can review and choose what you want to share. If you change your mind, or want to see which apps recently accessed your data, find it all in Health Connect.

TTS Pintar - Teka Teki Silang
TTS Pintar - Teka Teki Silang 2026 Offline
Welcome to TTS Pintar, a fun and challenging crossword puzzle app! Ready to test your language skills and brain? Get ready to enter a colorful and fun world of puzzles, even without an internet connection!
Great Features You'll Enjoy:
✅ Offline, like playing TTS in an Old-School Magazine
You can enjoy Teka Teki Silang without an internet connection. Because TTS Pintar is Offline, you can still play anytime and anywhere, even when you're in a place with no signal or internet connection. No more boredom while waiting or traveling. Enjoy nostalgic moments like when you used to fill out TTS magazines in the 2000s!
✅ TTS 3 Languages
Challenge yourself by playing Teka Teki Silang in three different languages: Indonesian, English, and Sundanese. Not only is it fun, but it can also be a great opportunity to improve your English skills. So, while you play, you can learn too! (Oh yeah, we also make a Javanese crossword puzzle app!)
✅ Various Types of Crossword Puzzle Games
We understand that everyone has different tastes and interests. That's why we offer a variety of crossword puzzle types. For example, there's General Crossword Puzzle, which tests your general knowledge, World Crossword Puzzle, which takes you on an adventure across countries and cultures, Mini Crossword Puzzle for a quick and fun challenge, and more.
✅ Simple and Cool Design, Choose Your Favorite Color!
Smart Crossword Puzzle has a simple and attractive appearance that will make you feel at home. There's a theme color change feature. You can choose any color you like, from red, blue, purple, pink, orange, black, and many more! Choose a theme color that suits your taste and mood to make your playing experience even more enjoyable!
✅ Crossword Grid Style Options
You can customize the style of your crossword puzzle grid to suit your taste and mood. Do you prefer a classic look with standard square grids, or would you like to try a modern look with unique rounded grids? The choice is yours!
✅ QWERTY and CLASSIC Keyboards
The keyboard options are also tailored to your desired difficulty level. For beginners, we recommend using the simpler CLASSIC or 10-LETTERS HELP keyboard to make completing crosswords easier. But once you're a pro, test your skills with the more challenging QWERTY keyboard!
✅ Help Available for Every Challenge
Don't worry if a question stumps you, because TTS Pintar provides a help feature. Simply click the light bulb icon to reveal the correct letter, making it easier for you to complete the answer. Still having trouble? Ask your friends via WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, or other apps. Help is always at your fingertips!
✅ Original, Unique, and Hand-Crafted Crosswords
What makes TTS Pintar special is that the crossword puzzles are hand-crafted by us, not copied and pasted. We don't copy the puzzles from magazines or other crossword puzzles. So, every time you play, you're guaranteed to enjoy a fresh and challenging puzzle!
✅ Continuously Updated Questions
We know you love challenges, which is why these crossword puzzles are updated regularly. So, after solving all the puzzles, you'll always have a new challenge waiting for you in TTS Pintar!
✅ Exciting Word Guessing Game
In addition to crosswords, we also offer an equally exciting Word Guessing game. Keep sharpening your brain by guessing the names of capitals, animals, plants, and more!
✅ Smart Quiz Game
The newest game from TTS Pintar! Besides playing crosswords and word guessing, you can now also play quizzes. The questions are multiple-choice. Even more fun, right?
What are you waiting for? Come on, download TTS Pintar now and face the endless challenges of exciting puzzles!

English Course

Advanced English Course
In this course, you will continue to improve your English until you master it like a native. An advanced English course with detailed explanations written in English that will leave you speechless. Ideal for challenge lovers.

Choose your grade/skill level, warm up your brain, and dash through beautifully crafted worlds packed with coins, hazards, and secrets.

A true endless runner + math hybrid. Classic runner controls with responsive jumps, slides, and dashes—now supercharged by correct answers that trigger shields, magnets, score multipliers, and more. It’s the rare endless runner that actually teaches.
Many, many characters to unlock. Collect coins, complete quests, and build your roster. Swap between MANY CHARACTERS with unique looks and celebrate your style as you master harder paths.
Covers core skills. Mental math, number bonds, comparison, addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, even quick drill sessions for times tables (2–12).
Adaptive and replayable. Start easy, scale up to lightning-fast runs with trickier expressions. Great for short sessions or long mastery streaks.
Made for families and classrooms. Perfect for daily practice, brain breaks, and homework warm-ups. Parents get a satisfying math games option kids actually ask to play.
Run through dynamic lanes, avoid obstacles, and grab boosters. A quick prompt appears—answer, pop! Your power-up fires. The better your accuracy and pace, the longer you can sustain multipliers, the farther you’ll go. This loop makes math games genuinely addictive and keeps the endless runner feel intact. No dead ends for mistakes—just encouragement to try again and keep running.
Addition & subtraction: single- and multi-digit sums and differences.
Multiplication facts and strategies: skip-counting, arrays, and rapid recall.
Times tables mastery (2–12): race-speed drills turn rote practice into flow.
Division as inverse multiplication, fact families, and balanced equations.
Number sense, estimation, order of operations (at higher levels), and mental arithmetic speed.
Toon Math uses positive reinforcement and constant motion to reduce anxiety around problem-solving. Correct answers feel powerful. Unlockable cosmetics, missions, and streak goals keep you coming back. With so many routes to explore and MANY CHARACTERS to collect, there’s always a new goal on your next run.
Kids learning times tables and multiplication facts who also love arcade action.
Parents and teachers looking for math games that are engaging, not boring worksheets.
Runners fans who want something fresh: a fast, polished endless runner with a smart twist.
Fast, responsive endless runner controls
Instant, rewarding power-ups for correct answers
Adjustable difficulty and curriculum-friendly content (including times tables and multiplication)
Collectibles, upgrades, and MANY CHARACTERS to unlock
Playable in short bursts or long sessions—perfect for sustained practice
Designed to make math games exciting, skill-building, and fun
Join millions who believe practicing multiplication and times tables doesn’t have to be dull. Download now and experience the thrill of a high-score chase where learning gives you the edge. If you love action, you’ll love this endless runner; if you love learning, you’ll love how seamlessly it becomes one of your favorite math games.

details_full_description:
Samsung Print Service Plugin
Easily print photos, web pages and documents without downloading any additional apps or printing tools.
Allows you to share your life’s printable moments and stay productive at home, at work or while on the go.
The Samsung Print Service is a system tool that enables wireless printing to Samsung printers and many other printer brands by integrating Mopria technology. Nearly all new printers sold today by Brother, Canon, Dell, Epson, Fuji Xerox, HP, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, Lexmark, Pantum, Ricoh, Samsung, Sharp, Toshiba and Xerox are Mopria-certified to make it easy to print your photos, web pages, documents, coupons, recipes and files from your favorite apps. You can even control print settings including color, number of copies, paper orientation and double-sided printing.
If you own a Samsung Galaxy phone, this system tool is already pre-installed. For any Android phone or tablet running KitKat (4.4) or higher, installing this plug-in will enable easy mobile printing from your device.
PHONE AND TABLET COMPATIBILITY
Samsung Galaxy Phones/Tablets – The Samsung Print Service plug-in is pre-installed on S4, S5, S6, S7 and many other Samsung phones & tablets. This plug-in cannot be uninstalled or moved to a SD card. When plug-in updates are available your device will notify you. Please adjust your settings to automatically update this plug‐in, or accept updates manually. For any other Galaxy phone or tablet where this Plug-in is not pre-installed, it can be downloaded and installed as long as the Samsung device is running Android KitKat (4.4) or later.
Other Android Phones/Tablets – The Samsung Print Service will work with any device with Android KitKat (4.4) or later. KitKat was the first version of Android that included the “Android Print Framework” which allows an Android App to access a built-in printing system. When updates are available for the Samsung Print Service, your device will notify you.
APPS SUPPORTING PRINT
Check to see if your Android App supports printing by looking for a print icon, checking the App’s menu option (three dots, three lines or “More” menu) or using the “Share” function.
Some everyday apps that support printing include Gallery, Photos, Chrome, Gmail, Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, Adobe Reader, Microsoft Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
Many more apps have enabled print or allow you to share to the Samsung Print Service.
TURNING ON THE SAMSUNG PRINT SERVICE
If you are unable to locate any printers, you may need to enable the Samsung Print Service.
Go to your device “Settings” and search for “Printing” to locate the Samsung Print Service. Then toggle the switch from “Off” to “On”.
SUPPORTED PRINTERS
Brother, Canon, Dell, Epson, Fuji Xerox, HP, Konica Minolta, Kyocera, Lexmark, Pantum, Ricoh, Sharp, Toshiba and Xerox branded printers are supported. However not all models are Mopria-certified.
See http://mopria.org/certified-products to check whether your printer model is supported.

Prepare to be dazzled and delighted as you dive into the whirlwind of joy that is Aplasta Palabras: Word Games! Tailored for everyone, from seasoned vocabulary champions to those eager to enhance their word prowess, this word search word block game promises endless entertainment of word zen and word crush. Slide, swipe, and solve your way across a vibrant word search word cross puzzle universe filled with colorful letters just waiting to be uncovered.
🌟 Gameplay of Aplasta Palabras 📚
At the core of Aplasta Palabras lies beautifully simple yet irresistibly engaging gameplay of word find games and word games. Kick off your vibrant word zen word crush adventure by sliding letters to craft words in this fantastic word search experience. Each successful word you create in the word search disappears in an exhilarating puff, making room for letters to cascade like a mesmerizing waterfall of alphabets. 🍵
As you advance, keep your eyes peeled on the letter blocks in the word search word crush game, not just for their beauty but as strategic tools to smash through blocks and soar to new levels faster than ever. Stumbling upon words not directly linked to the theme in some word zen word block word find games? Fantastic! These serendipitous finds in the word block word search don’t just feel great; these word block word search games rack up bonus points and unlock exciting surprises, making every swipe as electrifying as the first. Step up to the challenge of word find games and watch your skills transform from beginner to word block word zen ninja, one thrilling swipe after another!
🌟 Game Features of Aplasta Palabras 📚
Immerse yourself in an array of captivating features designed to keep you engrossed for hours with word search word block word games:
Easy Gameplay: Swiping has never felt so gratifying! With effortless mechanics, you can concentrate entirely on conquering word search word games without the distraction of complicated rules. 📱
Play Anywhere: Whether you’re queued up, on a lengthy commute, or simply relaxing at home, Aplasta Palabras doesn’t need WiFi, allowing you to play word crush word find games everywhere – under a leafy tree, amidst bustling meetings, or snuggled in your bed. 🌳🚌🛌
Edutainment at Its Best: Boasting tens of thousands of word block puzzles and an extensive vocabulary list, this word crush word zen word search game entertains, educates, and challenges your mind simultaneously. 🎓
Massive Levels: With over 10,000 levels of word zen word search that increase in difficulty and thrill, just as you master one level, another emerges to test your skills anew. Are you up for the challenge of word search and word cross puzzle? 🎮
Aplasta Palabras: Word Games is more than a word block word search game; it’s an exhilarating expedition through the world of word search and word cross puzzle, a rendezvous of mental agility, and a showdown of intellectual might. Ideal for all ages and perfect for both quick, playful breaks or deep, engaging sessions, this word zen word crush game is sure to captivate, thrill, and enlighten. Dive in now and begin your swipe-filled journey to word crush mastery! Remember, every swipe in these word block word games brings you closer to becoming a word zen wizard! 🎩✨
Embark on this linguistic odyssey and let your word search and word find games skills shine through. Happy word hunting in these thrilling word zen word games, gamers! 🚀📚

details_full_description:
MyRadar Weather Radar
MyRadar is a fast, easy-to-use, yet powerful weather app that displays animated weather radar around your current location, allowing you to quickly see what weather is coming your way. Just start the app, and your location pops up with animated live radar, with radar loop lengths of up to two hours. This basic functionality provides the quickest way to get a fast snapshot of the weather on-the-go, and it's what has made MyRadar so successful over the years. Check your phone and get an instant assessment of the weather that will impact your day.
In addition to the live radar, MyRadar has an ever-increasing list of weather and environmentally-related data layers that you can overlay on top of the map; our animated winds layer shows a breathtaking visual representation of both surface winds and winds at the jetstream level; the frontal boundaries layer shows high and low pressure systems as well as frontal boundaries themselves; the earthquakes layer is a great way to stay on top of the latest reports on seismic activity, completely customizable as to severity and time; our hurricane layer allows users to stay on top of the latest tropical storm and hurricane activity throughout the world; the aviation layer overlays AIRMETs, SIGMETs and other aviation-related data, including the ability to track flights and display their IFR flight plans and paths, and the "wildfires" layer allows users to stay abreast of the latest fire activity around the United States.
In addition to the data layers, MyRadar has the ability to send weather and environmental alerts, including alerts from the National Weather Center, such as Tornado and Severe Weather alerts. MyRadar includes the ability to receive alerts based off of Tropical Storm and Hurricane activity; you can configure the app to send you an alert any time a tropical storm or hurricane forms, or is upgraded or downgraded.
One of the most useful features in MyRadar is the ability to provide advanced rain alerts; our patent-pending process for predicting hyper-local rainfall is the most accurate in the industry. Instead of having to constantly check the app, MyRadar will send you an alert up to an hour in advance as to when the rain will arrive at your current location, down to the minute, including details on intensity and duration. These alerts can be a life saver when you're on-the-go and don't always have time to check the weather - our systems will proactively do the work for you and let you know in advance before the rain hits.
All of the weather and environmental data represented on MyRadar is displayed on our custom mapping system, developed in-house. This mapping system uses your devices GPU, which makes it incredibly fast and speedy. The map has the standard pinch/zoom capability which allows you to smoothly zoom and pan around the United States and the rest of the world to see what the weather is like anywhere on the planet.

details_full_description:
Real Estate sale & rent Trovit
Trovit Homes finds houses and apartments for rent and for sale on thousands of different websites and shows them to you in one place. That way, you can be sure that you will find your dream home, no matter how hidden it is. Easy, convenient and fast. That’s our promise.
♣ FILTERS TO FIND THE PERFECT HOME
Trovit Homes allows you to filter your search results to find properties that are relevant to you. You can select the city, neighbourhood, square footage, price, size, number of rooms and bathrooms and a long (seriously, long) list of other criteria.
♥ DRAW IN THE MAP THE ZONE THAT YOU ARE INTERESTED IN
Are you looking for a house or flat for rent or for sale in a very specific part of town? At Trovit Homes you can highlight the exact area that you're interested in on the map and our search engine will look for properties there. You can also save that search, so you can check it again whenever you want to see if there’s a new listing there.
♦ PERSONALIZED ALERTS, TAILORED SPECIFICALLY FOR YOU
When you close the app, Trovit Homes keeps working for you. Just create an alert (or several) and we will send you a notification when there’s a new ad that matches your search criteria. We follow thousands of housing websites minute by minute so that you don’t have to. You can create as many alerts as you want to, with your ideal price, your favourite neighbourhood or the perfect combination of lots of factors.
♠ HOW TO FIND YOUR DREAM HOME IN TROVIT HOMES
Whether you are looking to buy a home or to rent one, searching on Trovit couldn't be easier.
1. Type your search criteria and select the kind of property you are looking for.
2. If you want to, you can apply filters to that search. You will find the filters in the upper right hand-corner of the screen.
3. Take a good look at all the selected properties. And don’t forget to save the ones you like the most in Favourites!
4. Create personalized alerts for every search you're interested in. You'll be able to activate or deactivate the notifications for each search, both at the bottom of each search results page and in the settings section.
5. We will send you alerts when there’s a new ad that matches all the conditions that you selected.
You can check as many listings as you want, absolutely free.
Just type your search: house, property, condo, flat, rental, foreclosure, sold by owner, realty, mansion, room, studio... even offices or warehouses! You can look for as many listings as you want, and create as many alerts as you want, completely free and with absolutely no limits.
►WHY TROVIT?
You have two options when looking for real estate and rentals:you can either try visiting all the websites and services on a daily basis, typing the same search queries over and over, hoping to find the best home before anyone else. Or, you can set up search filters in Trovit Homes, create an alert, and sit back to watch the magic happen. Trovit Homes will be your starting point for an intelligent and extensive search.
Look for properties listed in 19 different languages and in 46 different countries. Trovit Homes includes hundreds of United States based real estate services. Find your dream home in New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, Philadelphia, Phoenix, San Antonio, San Diego, Dallas, San Jose, Austin, Jacksonville, San Francisco, Indianapolis, Columbus, Detroit, Washington DC, and a long list of other towns and cities.
OTHER TROVIT SERVICES
Besides Trovit Homes, you can also use Trovit Cars and Trovit Jobs. At Trovit Cars you will find all the listings for second hand cars in one single search engine. Trovit Jobs will help you find your perfect job, searching in several job websites and services in a single search.
If you have any doubts, problems or suggestions, please send us an email at android@trovit.com. If you enjoy Trovit Homes, please review us on Google Play: it helps us grow and maintain a high quality, free service!

Kids learning games is all we do!

Your child will slide and snap the colorful puzzle pieces into place to reveal the delightful image.
Once kids complete the puzzle, the pleasant voice of a lady announcer congratulates the child on an excellent job and tells the child what the image depicts.
Children enjoy success time after time and receive positive reinforcement from the likable teacher. So they want to keep learning.

Like all Intellijoy games, the game focuses on a specific educational lesson, so children and their parents find the game really inviting and distraction-free. Samsung Smart Switch Mobile
▣ Smart Switch gives you the freedom to move your contacts, music, photos, calendar, text messages, device settings and more to your new Galaxy device. Plus, Smart Switch™ helps you find your favorite apps or suggest similar ones on Google Play™.
▣ Who can transfer?
• Android™ owners
- Android 6.0 or higher
• iOS™ owners - use the option that’s best for you:
- Wired transfer from your iOS device to your Galaxy: iOS 12.0 or above, iOS device cable (lightning or 30 pin), and a USB connector
- Import from iCloud™: iOS 4.2.1 or higher and Apple ID
- PC/Mac transfer using iTunes™: Smart Switch PC/Mac software – Get started http://www.samsung.com/smartswitch
▣ What can be transferred?
- Contacts, calendar(Device content only), messages, photos, music (DRM free content only, Not supported for iCloud), videos (DRM free content only), call logs, memos, alarms, Wi-Fi, wallpapers, documents, app data (Galaxy devices only), home layouts (Galaxy devices only)
- You can send app data and home layouts by upgrading your Galaxy device to M OS (Galaxy S6 or higher).
▣ Which devices are supported?
• Galaxy: Recent Galaxy mobile devices and tablets (From Galaxy S2)
• Other Android devices:
- HTC, LG, Sony, Huawei, Lenovo, Motorola, PANTECH, Panasonic, Kyocera, NEC, SHARP, Fujitsu, Xiaomi, Vivo, OPPO, Coolpad, RIM, YotaPhone, ZTE, Gionee, LAVA, MyPhone, Cherry Mobile, Google
* For reasons such as compatibility between devices, it may not be possible to install and use Smart Switch on certain devices.
1. To transfer data, both devices must have a minimum of 500 MB free space in their internal memory.
2. If you have a non-Samsung device that constantly disconnects from the wireless network, go to Advanced Wi-Fi on your device, turn off the “Wi-Fi initialize” and “Disconnect low Wi-Fi signal” options, and try again.
(The options described above may not be available, depending on your device manufacturer and OS version.)
The following permissions are required for the app service. For optional permissions, the default functionality of the service is turned on, but not allowed.
[ Required permissions ]
. Phone: Used to confirm your phone number (Android 12 or lower)
. Call logs: Used to transfer call log data (Android 9 or higher)
. Contacts: Used to transfer contacts data
. Calendar: Used to transfer calendar data
. Camera: Used to scan QR codes to connect to Galaxy phones and tablets
. SMS: Used to transfer SMS data
. Storage: Used to save the files necessary for data transfer (Android 11 or lower)
. Files and media: Used to save the files necessary for data transfer(Android 12)
. Photos and Videos: Used to save the files necessary for data transfer (Android 13 or higher)
. Nearby devices: Used to search for nearby devices using Wi-Fi or Bluetooth (Android 12 or higher)
. Location: Used to connect to devices using Wi-Fi Direct, which makes your location available to nearby devices (Android 12 or lower)
. Notifications: Used to provide information about the progress of data transfers (Android 13 or higher)
If your system software version is lower than Android 6.0, please update the software to configure App permissions.
Previously allowed permissions can be reset on Apps menu in device settings after software update.

details_full_description:
UMANG
UMANG (Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance) is envisaged to make e-governance 'mobile first'. It is developed by Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) and National e-Governance Division (NeGD).
It is an evolving platform designed for citizens of India to offer them access to the pan-India e-Gov services from the Central, State, Local Bodies, and Agencies of government on app, web, SMS, and IVR channels.
Key Features:
- Unified Platform: It brings together all government departments and their services on a single platform to provide better and easier services to citizens.
- Mobile First Strategy: It aligns all government services with the mobile first strategy to leverage mobile adoption trends.
- Integration with Digital India Services: It provides seamless integration with other Digital India Services like Aadhaar, DigiLocker, and PayGov. Any new such service will automatically be integrated with the platform.
- Uniform Experience: It is designed to enable citizens to discover, download, access, and use all government services easily.
- Secure and Scalable: It supports Aadhaar-based and other authentication mechanisms for service access. The sensitive profile data is saved in an encrypted format and no one can view this information.
Key Services:
UMANG provides easy access to a plethora of Indian government services ranging from – Healthcare, Finance, Education, Housing, Energy, Agriculture, Transport to even Utility and Employment and Skills.
Key Benefits for Citizens:
- Single-Point Ubiquitous Access: All government services are available for citizens on a unified platform for easy access through multiple online and offline channels (SMS, email, app, and web).
- More for Less: Only a single mobile app needs to be installed instead of each app of each department.
- Convenience: Citizens do not even need to install or update the app again to avail government services if more services are added to the platform.
- Saving of Time and Money: Citizens can anytime and anywhere avail these services through their mobile phones, desktops, and laptops without any need for visiting the department office and standing in queues.
- Uniform Experience: All the government services including payment-based transactions provide secure and uniform experience.

details_full_description:
Pet Rescue Saga
Puppies and kittens are stuck between the puzzle blocks in this Pet Rescue Saga adventure and need your help! Hurry and save them from the evil Pet Snatchers!
Match 2 or more blocks of the same color to clear the levels and save the pets. Matching moves are limited so plan carefully to blast as many blocks as possible, solve the puzzles, and save the pets. Your puzzle skills will be tested with hours of block busting fun!
Join the rescue mission and solve increasingly challenging match 3 puzzles! Match and blast blocks in a variety of events and puzzles to discover a whole new variety of pets waiting to be rescued! Not only do you save the puppies and kittens but you also build an animal shelter for them. Blast your way through the puzzle levels!
Lots of fun events
Blast blocks and solve new matching puzzles to win boosters and bonus rewards! Discover fun time-limited games and play increasingly challenging levels, so blast the right blocks!
Petopia: a whole city, but for pets!
Don’t leave your animals out in the cold, send them off to Petopia City! Clear puzzles to build a city for your rescued pets and visit them in their new home.
Grow your pet
Every 2 weeks, collect red blocks within the game levels to grow your pet by earning treats; the more red blocks, the more treats!
Weekly match 3 quests
Complete match 3 quests every week and gain rewards by solving new puzzles. Hop on to the next quest and start matching blocks!
With 5,600+ pet puzzles and more levels added every 2 weeks to the game, Pet Rescue Saga is a real match 3 blast! Are you ready for some pet-tastic fun?
Pet Rescue Saga from the makers of Candy Crush Saga, Farm Heroes Saga, and Bubble Witch 3 Saga is free to play but some in-game items such as extra moves or lives will require payment. You can turn off the payment feature by disabling in-app purchases in your device’s settings.
By downloading Pet Rescue Saga you agree to our terms of service which can be found at https://king.com/termsAndConditions
Do not sell my data: King shares your personal information with advertising partners to personalize ads. Learn more at https://king.com/privacyPolicy. If you wish to exercise your Do Not Sell My Data rights, you can do so by contacting us via the in-game help center or by going to https://soporto.king.com/contact

details_full_description:
Decor Life - Home Design Game
Do you love the idea of 🏡 renovation? Do you dream of a fresh canvas on which to create your ideal home design again and again 😀? Are you looking for a casual mobile game that lets you live out your interior design fantasies in a fun, relaxing environment 🧸 where you can try out different furniture and décor concepts in any way you want? Then Decor Life is the game for you.
Combining a series of simple and easily mastered mechanics with a huge range of unique spaces, furniture items and design objects, Decor Life brings you all the fun parts of moving and decorating with none of the real-life hassle and hard work.
SPACE FOR YOUR DESIGNS 💡
📦 Homes, sweet homes: A huge and ever-expanding variety of rooms to work on, each with the unique atmosphere and attributes of its owner. Try and try again to find the right renovation solutions to suit each space. Choose furniture and décor options, then move them around the room until you find just the right spot.
📦 Outside the box: Decor Life is a game that follows the renovation process from start to finish. Begin by sorting the furniture and contents of the old, unrenovated room into the right boxes, before moving on to selecting home design options, unboxing and placing furniture, then finally unpack and arrange new decorative items and possessions in the redecorated room.
📦 No judgment: Unsure of your taste in home design? There are no right answers in Decor Life, and nobody to correct your choices at the end of each level. You get to select the designs and furnishings you want and judge their success on your own terms, so there’s nothing to stop you relaxing and getting the maximum pleasure out of letting your design fantasy run free.
📦 A place for absolutely everything: When it comes to unboxing, you never know what you’re going to find. Can you work out where best to place a drum kit, a safe, a beautiful still life, or any number of other unique and individual items that are looking for the right home in your new room?
📦 Anywhere on the map: the home design map opens up for you. No need to play levels in order, you can get decorating anywhere you want to in the game by exploring all the different rooms on the map.
RENOVATION TIME 🎩
Let your creativity run wild in this imaginative and original decorating game where you’re free to make your own interior choices and admire the results of your design labors in a relaxing and open gaming environment.
Got an insatiable taste for home improvement? Then download Decor Life now and get renovating.

details_full_description:
Flags of All World Countries
How many flags can you guess? Do you know what the Mexican flag looks like? Do you remember the order of colors on the Irish flag? This education app will refresh your memory of national flags, and you'll learn about the beautiful flags of such exotic countries as Maldives or Dominica.
Why do I prefer this geography quiz to other games about flags?
Because it has all flags of all 197 independent countries of the World and 48 dependent territories and constituent countries! It is extremely user-friendly. You will always get a hint about whether you're right or wrong. Thus, you'll never get stuck by a question for which you don't know the answer.
Now you can learn flags separately for each continent: from Europe and Asia to Africa and South America.
The flags are divided into three levels:
1) Well-known flags (Level 1) - Canada, France, Japan, and so on.
2) Flags that are harder to identify (Level 2) - Cambodia, Haiti, Georgia, and other world countries.
3) Dependent territories and constituent countries (Level 3) - Scotland, Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands, etc.
4) The fourth option is to play with “All 245 Flags”.
5) Capitals quiz: for the given flag, guess the capital of the corresponding country: for example, if the flag of Egypt is shown, the correct answer is Cairo. Capitals are divided by continent.
6) Maps and Flags: pick the correct flag for the country highlighted on the world map.
Start with two learning options:
* Flashcards - browse all flags in the app without guessing; you can check what flags you don’t know well and want to repeat in the future.
* Table of all countries, capitals, and flags.
Then you can test your knowledge by choosing the game mode you like. Our app features several game options to keep things interesting:
* Spelling quizzes (the easy one with hints after each selected letter, and the hard one where you have to spell the whole word correctly).
* Multiple-choice questions (with 4 or 6 answer options) - can you find the state flag of your country? But it’s important to remember that you have only 3 lives.
* Drag and Drop: match 4 flags and 4 country names.
* Time game (give as many correct answers as you can in 1 minute).
You should answer all questions in each level and give 25 correct answers in Time Game to get all stars and complete the game.
We understand that geography is a global subject, and our app reflects that. It's available in 32 languages, including English, German, and Spanish, so you can learn the names of countries and capital cities in any foreign language.
Advertisements can be removed by an in-app purchase.
This is an excellent game for all students of world geography. Or are you a sports fan who needs help recognizing the flags of national teams? Find the national flag of your state and learn other flags by heart! So why wait? Challenge yourself, learn something new, and have fun with our educational app.

Raise Companions Together

Your AI Friends, Your Way

Social AI companions designed to support you, connect you, and make everyday life more fun.

Eka Care is a Personal Health Record (PHR) app designed to help you store and manage your medical reports and body vitals. It allows you to share medical records with doctors, book hospital appointments, and securely store your health records in a government-approved PHR app. Additionally, Eka Care offers the convenience of monitoring your heart rate without the need for a smartwatch, checking your health through AI-powered self-assessments, and effortlessly tracking essential body vitals, including blood pressure (BP) and blood sugar levels.
1. Personal Health Record (PHR) and Medical Records
Eka Care excels in providing a comprehensive Personal Health Records (PHR) app that helps you maintain detailed medical and health records. This includes storing prescriptions, health and medical reports, vaccine certificates, and more. The app allows you to create individual health profiles for each family member, facilitating seamless management of all members' medical and health records within a single application. These meticulously maintained records are instrumental in monitoring your health history, facilitating early diagnosis of health issues, and can be effortlessly shared with healthcare professionals to ensure efficient and accurate healthcare management.
2. Heart Rate Monitor
Eka Care's heart rate monitor allows for precise measurement of your heartbeat using just your smartphone camera. You no longer need a smartwatch or a separate handheld device to assess your heart health. The monitor automatically saves your daily measurements and generates a detailed heart history for your reference. You can also set up reminders to measure your heart rate based on your preferences.
3. Vitals Monitor & Trackers
You can monitor your vitals on Eka Care by uploading medical and health records. Vital information such as blood pressure, sugar levels, cholesterol, and more will be automatically tracked over time. You can also manually add data and sync with devices like Health Connect and Google Fit. Additionally, we offer specialized trackers for glucose, blood pressure, and menstrual cycles to help you manage your health effectively..
Awards and Recognition:
Shortlisted by Google Play as an 'Essential App' for Wellness.
Disclaimer: This app is not a medical device and should not be used to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition. It is designed solely for personal health tracking and record management. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for advice regarding any medical concerns or conditions.

CLZ Comics comic book database
Easily catalog your comic collection. To add comics to your app, just scan the cover with your device camera. The app will recognize the comic and will automatically provide issue details, cover art, creator lists and more.
CLZ Comics is a paid subscription app, costing US $1.99 per month or US $19.99 per year.
Use the free 7-day trial to try all of the app's features and online services!
OPTIONAL ADD-ON: Get comic values from CovrPrice at US $89.95 extra per year.
== Four ways to catalog your comics books ==
1. Just take pictures of the covers and let the app recognize them. Super easy.
2. Scan comic barcodes. Fast and accurate for modern comics.
3. Find a series by title, then checkbox the issues you own.
4. Search a specific issue by title and issue number.
== Automatic issue details from CLZ Core ==
Our CLZ Core comic database automatically provides cover art and full comic details, like Series, Issue Nr, Publisher, plot, creator lists, character lists, backdrop art, etc... including key comic information, like first appearances.
== Edit all fields ==
You can edit all automatically provided details from CLZ Core, like the series, issue number, variant description, release/cover dates, plot descriptions, creator and character listings etc.. you can even upload your own cover art (front and back!). You can also add personal details like storage box, grade, slab label types, purchase date / price / store, notes, etc..
== Create multiple collections ==
Collections will appear as Excel-like tabs at the bottom of your screen. E.g. for different people, to separate physical from digital comics, to keep track of comics you sold or have for sale, etc...
== Optional: get comic values from CovrPrice ==
Optional in-app purchase, at US $89.95 per year.
Get accurate and up-to-date comic values from CovrPrice, for both raw and slabbed comics.
== CLZ Cloud storage ==
* Always have an online backup of your comic tracker database.
* Sync your comic library between multiple devices
* View and share your comic collection online
= 24/7 customer support ==
We are always ready to help or to answer your questions, 7 days a week.
Just use "Contact Support" or "CLZ Club forum" from the menu.
== Other CLZ apps ==
* CLZ Movies, for cataloging your DVDs, Blu-rays and 4K UHDs
* CLZ Books, for organizing your book collection by ISBN
* CLZ Music, for creating a database of your CDs and vinyl records
* CLZ Games, for making a database of your video game collection
== About CLZ ==
CLZ has been developing collection database software since 1996. Located in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, the CLZ team now consists of 12 guys and one gal. GoPro Quik: Video Editor
With Quik, editing just got easier. Get the most out of your favorite shots with Automatic Highlight videos and a suite of premium tools for custom edits [1]. Everything is backed up to the GoPro cloud so you can access and edit your footage on-the-go [1].
--- Key Features ---
Automatic Edits
The Quik app finds your best shots, syncs them to music, adds transitions and automatically creates a shareable video. [1]
Unlimited Cloud Storage at 100% Quality
Get UNLIMITED cloud storage of ALL your GoPro footage and up to 500GB from other cameras with a Premium or Premium+ subscription. All at 100% quality. [2]
Auto Upload + Cross Device Sync
Once imported into the Quik app, photos, videos, and edits automatically upload to the cloud for backup and sync across your devices for seamless cross-platform editing and content management. [1]
Premium Editing Tools
Play with color and light, trim video length, add stickers and more to take your footage to the next level.
Beat Sync
Syncs clips, transitions, and effects to the beat of the music. [1]
Frame Grab
Get high resolution photos by capturing a frame from any video.
Themes
Find a theme that tells your story with cinematic transitions, filters, and effects. [1]
Filters
Exclusive filters optimized for environments like snow and water.
Frame Adjust
Adjust the aspect ratio for photos and videos. You can also level the horizon, rotate and flip media.
Text Overlays
Add text and emojis for another dimension to your story. [1]
Transform 360 into Traditional Video with Reframe
Use Reframe to experiment with countless views, choose the best shots and instantly create cinematic transitions with the click of a keyframe. Then, export a traditional video or photo you can edit and share.
--- GoPro Camera Owner Features ---
Auto GoPro Detection + Transfer
Automatically detects connected GoPro cameras and transfers footage across a wired USB connection for fast and easy transfers.
Preview Shots + Delete
Check out GoPro camera photos and videos on your computer before you transfer them or delete unwanted shots from your camera's SD card.
Content Management
View and manage both local and cloud media in a single view, while camera media is organized in another view. Easily view and find media in a large, easy-to-read grid with search filters and icon overlays.
--- Footnotes ---
[1] Premium or Premium+ Subscription required. Available in select countries. Cancel anytime. See terms + conditions at our official website.

- Keep your kitten happy, protected, and ready for action

المصلي في رمضان 🌙: صلاتي والمؤذن مع منبه الاذان واوقات الصلاة، اذكار الصباح والمساء وجميع الاذكار (فاذكروني اذكركم)، تمتع بـ اذان الصلاه في وقتها بدون نت، و صلاتك لن تفوتك مع مؤذن السعودية والحرم.
كل ما تحتاجه في رمضان مع ختمه القران الكريم، والمصحف لتقرأ في كل مكان، والأدعية والرقية الشرعية، مع ورد المحاسبة وطاعاتك، أكثِر من العبادة لتتمتع بجوائز المصلي الذهبي مع صلاتي اوقات الصلاه.
مفاجآت المصلي لرمضان 🌙:
🛑 المصحف الورقي الجديد كليًا: مصحف المدينة بالرسم العثماني، مطابق للمصحف الورقي مع تفسير القران الكريم والمعاني والتكبير والقراءة الليلية، اقرأ قران بدون انترنت في أي وقت ومكان
🛑 كنوز الذكر: بركة الدنيا وكنوز الاخرة مع خدمة كنوز، أجور بدقائق سهلة مع ذكر الله والسبحة الإلكترونية.
🛑 حصن المسلم: شيد حصنك المنيع، وكن في حفظ الله ورعايته مع دعاء رمضان والرقية الشرعية وجميع اذكار المسلم، كتاب حصن المسلم كاملًا على هاتفك.
أهم الخدمات للشهر الكريم 🕌🌙:
◼ مواقيت الصلاة مع الاذان في رمضان: توقيت دقيق مع المؤذن، تذكير الصلاة يعينك ويذكرك، مع تنبيه بأوقات النهي والكراهة.
◼ اذان الصلاه بدون نت: صلاتك حياتك، بلال كان راحة النبي، منبه الاذان واوقات الصلاة في رمضان اجعله راحتك مع مؤذن السعوديه وأكثر من 30 من أجمل الأصوات.
◼ الاذكار: اجعل يومك مع الله، فاذكروني مع اذكار الصباح والمساء والنوم مع التنبيهات اليومية.
◼ ختمه رمضان : مع المصحف الورقي الجديد، اختم كتاب الله، واتل من مصحف المدينة بالرسم العثماني، ابدأ ختمه فردية أو مع من تحب من العائلة أو الأصدقاء، مع منبه يومي بموعد القراءة.
◼ امساكية رمضان : مواقيت الصلاة في رمضان ومواقيت الافطار والافطار والامساك.
◼ اتجاه القبله : 5 طرق دقيقة لاكتشاف قبلة الصلاه، تعمل بدون انترنت
◼ السبحة الإلكترونية : تسبيح وأجر وبركة، اذكر ربك يذكرك في كل وقت ومكان، واستغل أوقاتك الضائعة في الطريق والانتظار.
◼ الفوائد : تعلم دينك في دقائق يومية، أهم الأحكام الفقهية، والمعلومات الدينية، مقالات قصيرة، تجعلك كل يوم أقرب لربك وأعلم بدينك.
◼ ورد المحاسبة : تابع عبادتك اليومية في الشهر العظيم، حاسب نفسك وواظب على الطاعة، أحب الأعمال إلى الله ادومها.
◼ طاعاتك : الخدمة الأكبر للمداومة على العبادة الآن جوائزها مضاعفة، زد في طاعاتك ونافس وتقرب إلى الله في أعظم أيامه، وتمتع بجوائز المصلي الذهبي المضاعفة.
◼ التقويم الهجري : تابع أهم التواريخ والأيام المباركة مع التقويم، وخدمة حدث في مثل هذا اليوم
◼ الدعاء المستجاب : من القرآن والسنة، في شهر الخير والدعاء في صلاتك وكل وقت، حصن المسلم مع تنبيهات أوقات الاستجابة في رمضان.
◼ الرقية الشرعية : حصن نفسك وأهل بيتك مع الرقية الشرعية من الكتاب والسنة، مع حصن المسلم وبرنامج الاذان

Citymapper
Instantly compare your travel options in real-time across all transport modes!
Easily navigate your city with turn-by-turn directions for all your public transportation, walking, cycling and scooter trips.
Find the best route
► Simple city navigation and trip planning combining bus 🚎 subway 🚇 train 🚄 ferry ⛴ cabs 🚕 ride share 🚖 car share 🚗 bike share 🚲 e-scooters 🛴 and walking 🚶‍♂️Discover routes you never knew existed 🕵️‍♀️!

We take care of the logistical thinking with our smart route planner so you are free to enjoy the ride 🙌

details_full_description:
Splits Training in 30 Days
Splits Training is designed for all levels to get full splits step by step, even if you are a beginner. The mixing of static and dynamic splits helps you improve flexibility effectively and achieve results faster than you think. With about 10 min a day, you’ll get closer and closer to the floor!
Productive stretches for splits in 30 days are suitable for men and women, adults and kids. You can customize your splits training based on your own preferences, no equipment needed.
Whether you want to do a full split for dance, ballet, gymnastics or martial arts, this training will help you get there.
Why splits?
Splits have been proven to prevent injuries, increase muscle strength, relieve muscle stiffness and give you better circulation.
Improve your flexibility & balance
Flexibility and balance are key to reducing the risk of injury during exercise. Splits stretch all your lower body muscles to increase your range of motion.
Loosen your hip flexors
Due to sitting at a desk all day, most people have extremely tight hip flexors, which can cause pain, especially in your lower back. Splits open up these areas to relieve your muscle tension.
Deeply stretch your legs
When doing splits, your legs will be stretching the whole time. Doctors will recommend splits as part of your exercise routine, especially if you’re doing activities such as running or biking.
Boost your circulation
Splits lengthen your muscles and improve your circulation by increasing blood flow to your muscles.
Please get your muscles warmed up before doing the splits. Splits need time; your muscles need time to stretch, recover and adapt to the new demands. Be patient, and stick to it; you’ll soon see progress.
Features
- Splits for all levels, splits for beginners, splits for men, splits for women, splits for kids
- Step-by-step directions on how to do the splits for all levels
- Effective formula to help achieve results fast
- Splits in 30 days
- Customize your own training plan
- Easy-to-follow instruction, animation and video guide
- Record your progress automatically
- Stretches for splits target all muscles you need to become super flexible
Exercise at home with home workout splits training
No need to go to the gym, this app provides home workout splits training that allows you to exercise at home, improve flexibility, and get full splits. This app is just like your personal trainer to teach you to exercise at home with effective home workout splits training. A few minutes a day, and you'll see great changes in weeks!
Do the splits at home
Do the splits at home with our well-designed splits training. New to splits? Don't worry, we'll provide you with detailed instructions and guide you throughout the splits training.

Shred words away in your living room, on your commute, waiting rooms or even during dull meetings, without worrying about connectivity issues.
Education can also be fun with Guess the Words. Containing tens of thousands of word blocks, it promises to be a fantastic dictionary for language learners. Make your way through more than 10,000 levels, each trumping the previous in terms of difficulty. Walk the tightropes, juggle the challenges and experience mind-bending puzzles as every advance demands a higher degree of linguistic mastery from you. 🌟📚💪
GET DOWN TO BRASS TACKS📲🏋️♀️🏆
Fun, engaging, challenging and exciting – these are just a few words to describe the fantastic world of Guess the Words. As you swipe and create, master and conquer, remember that each level is a new opportunity to learn, to grow and to achieve. Leave no word unturned, no block uncrushed, no opportunity untaken. With Guess the Words, reaching new linguistic heights is not just an aspiration; it is an everyday reality. Experience the electrifying mix of knowledge, fun, challenge, and victory – all in the palm of your hands. Few games can bring together the thrilling sensation of victory and the joy of learning quite like Guess the Words.
Are you ready for a word-breaking revolution? The compelling world of Guess the Words is waiting for you to dive in. Clean up your screens, stretch your fingers and prepare to swipe, discover, learn, and conquer! Let’s see if you can guess all the words. 🏁🕹️🏅
So, are you up for the challenge? Start guessing, start winning. Dive into the enthralling universe of Guess the Words today!
Please note, not all heroes use swords, some just guess the right words! 🎩🗡️📚
P.S. - The only thing that stands between you and your extensive vocabulary is a download button.
