Yandex Food is an app where you can find your favorite dishes from Burger King, ROSTIC'S, KFC, and Vkusno, as well as products from Yandex Lavka, Lenta, VkusVill, Azbuka Vkusa, Pyaterochka, Perekrestok, Magnit, and more.
Your first delivery is free.
Over 60,000 restaurants and stores in one app
Order groceries from hypermarkets for the whole week, or meat or fish from local markets if you want to cook something special for dinner. Or simply order your favorite restaurant dishes: pizza, burgers, wraps, and khinkali.
Yandex Food offers household goods, medicine, cosmetics, pet supplies, and flowers—all delivered right to your door.
Daily specials
Free deliveries, 20% off restaurant orders, "1 = 2" promotion, and a free meal. We've curated the best deals for you every day in the "Promotions" section.
We also offer a discount for first-time orderers. Save up to 400 rubles on your first order of 800 rubles or more from Rostiks, KFC, Burger King, Vkusno i Tochka, Pyaterochka, Perekrestok, and other restaurants and stores.
Order delivery right to your door.
See where you can order from. Simply enter your address in the app, and a list of available restaurants and stores will appear. Delivery starts in 30 minutes.
All your order information at your fingertips
In the app, you can check your order status and see the courier's location.
Order your favorite dishes or try new ones.
Use filters to find your favorite cuisine or dish in one tap. For example, if you select the "Pizza" filter, the app will show you restaurants that serve it.
Where to Go
In the "Where to Go" section, you can easily find a restaurant for any occasion: a date, a birthday party, a family dinner, or brunch with friends. To make your choice easier, there are multiple filters (by cuisine, type of establishment, special features, and more) and themed selections (with new places, restaurants with dance floors, and more). You can also book tables online in the "Where to Go" section.
Get bonuses for friends
Send a promo code from your Yandex Food profile to a friend. When they place their first order with it for 1,000 rubles or more, you both receive a 500 ruble discount.
Order from select restaurants
Ultima is a section in the Yandex Food app where we've curated a selection of fine dining restaurants from renowned chefs. Your order is delivered in special packaging, and each courier undergoes additional training and testing.
Save time with Yandex Lavka
Lavka is your go-to when you need groceries, food, or household essentials ASAP. Order ready-made breakfasts, lunches, and dinners with delivery in as little as 10 minutes. You can also find vegetables, dairy products, meat, cakes, and even useful little things like light bulbs and toothpaste. Lavka has so much to offer.
Earn and spend Yandex Plus points
Choose restaurants with a special icon. You can earn and redeem Yandex Plus points when ordering from them. One point is equal to 1 ₽.
Yandex Food is an information service. Delivery is provided by the service's partners. Delivery zones, times, and offers are limited; for more information, visit eda.yandex.ru. Fast delivery: the average delivery time for orders on the service is 35 minutes (based on data from October 1, 2023 to October 31, 2023).

Welcome to one of the best weather apps on the Play Store, recognized as one of the best for its accuracy, widget flexibility, and ease-of-use.
Our intuitively designed interface provides you with informative, useful, and precise weather updates for your local area and around the globe, all accompanied by stunningly detailed animations.
Main App Features:
• Accurate and comprehensive weather forecasts for the next 10 days
• Hour-by-hour weather updates to help you plan your activities with precision
• Fast, beautiful, and simple-to-use interface
• Detailed forecasts for rain, snow, wind, storms and many other useful information - stay prepared for all weather conditions
• Daily updates on humidity, dew, UV index, and air pressure
• Data on highest and lowest historical weather values
• Dynamic animations of satellite and weather radar maps
• Weather also available in the notification area with the temperature display in your status bar
• Optimized for both phones and tablets, and fully compatible with your favorite Wear OS smartwatch
Customizable Home Screen Widgets:
• Highly configurable widgets with extensive customization options available to adjust the look, ensuring seamless integration with your home screen
• Choose the size, layout, and appearance of your widget, select what weather information to display, and even adjust text size and colors
• Get quick weather snapshots without even opening the app, right from your home screen
• Convenience at its best, with visually pleasing designs to suit your style and preference
Live Wallpaper Feature:
• Experience our Live Wallpaper feature, displaying mesmerizing weather animations right on your device screen (subject to device compatibility)
• Enjoy real-time weather updates in the most visually engaging way
Severe Weather Alerts:
• Stay safe and informed with critical information about severe weather warnings
• Alerts issued by official national weather services from around the globe, ensuring comprehensive coverage
Alerts availability: https://exovoid.ch/alerts
Air Quality and Pollen Information:
• Detailed air quality information sourced from official stations to keep you healthy
• Track key pollutants including ground-level ozone, particle pollution (PM2.5 and PM10), carbon monoxide, sulfur dioxide, and nitrogen dioxide
Air quality Information availability: https://exovoid.ch/aqi
Smartwatch App Features List:
• Included: "Tile" and "Complications"
• Check the weather for your current location or any city in the world (requires main app to sync cities)
• Hourly and daily weather forecasts
• Info available hour by hour: Temperature, Probability of rain, Wind speed, Cloud cover, Humidity, Pressure, UV index
• Touch the screen to view the information available hour by hour
• Weather Alerts
• Settings screen for customization
Try the best weather app now – experience simplicity, usefulness, and informative power like never before, all for free!
--
Location data during the use of App
Unlike many other apps on the market, we never send information like your location to a server, everything is processed on your device.
We've designed our weather apps so that the user's precise location remains on the phone and is converted into the nearest weather station ID.
What's more, weather requests linked to a station are not stored, so it's impossible to link a user to a weather request.
This method ensures anonymity and security for the user.

details_full_description:
Chess - Clash of Kings
Chess is a smart entertainment for children and adults. Play chess online with people from around the world and develop logical thinking.
The main features of our Chess application:
- The Chess application is free
- Clans & playing with a friend online
- The Book of Chess with chess strategies
- Playing chess online with Blitz mode and competing in tournaments
- 10 different levels of difficulty
- Challenges with hundreds of chess puzzles
- Hints are available to show the most advantageous moves
- Undo, you can use this option in the case of a mistake
- Chess Rating presents your personal score
- Game Analysis helps you to progress.
Chess online & Chess with friends - multiplayer mode!
Play multiplayer Chess & defeat your opponents!
Crave for playing chess online? This is a great option for 2 players! Play with friends online or face people from all over the world in an online chess duel. Decide which online option suits you best.
Do you miss your friends?
Renew your friendships!
Add friends in the app and invite a friend to the game.
Remember to share your thoughts in the in-app chat!
The Book of Chess & Chess Openings
Earn Experience Points (XP) after each online game to unlock new pages of the Book. The Book of Chess is filled with secret chess content - from classic strategies and top players to fun facts and tips. It also includes a guide to chess openings. Follow the moves on the board and learn chess strategies step by step. Apply your new skills in matches or tournaments!
Clans… Clans? Clans!
Create your clan or join a CLAN! Lead up to great triumph through unity and cooperation among clan members. Focus on goals to achieve success.
Tournaments
Try your hand at Blitz ARENA tournaments!
Sign up for tournaments in advance by clicking the *Join* button, and when the tournament starts, tap *Start playing* and compete!
Chess Rating and Game Analysis
Check your progress with the ELO Rating. This is the rating system that assesses your skill level in playing chess and presents scores and the history of your results.
Improve your tactics! Game Analysis allows you to look over your gameplay. This feature points out the moves you should avoid in the future and the ones you should stick to.
Mini-game and Chess Puzzles
When you don't want to play a full game or multiplayer chess mode, solve chess puzzles. Move to a distant land, earn gold with Knight moves, and explore hundreds of puzzles. Each square on the board contains a chess puzzle you must solve to move on. Chess puzzles are quick tasks where you checkmate your opponent in a limited number of moves.
10 levels of chess difficulty
Chess for beginners, children, or perhaps for a master? Everyone will find a level suitable for their chess skills. Choose from 10 different difficulty levels, train, and check your chess tactics in the multiplayer chess duel.
Our Chess application gives sheer pleasure as standard gameplay with a friend or playing online.
Playing our Chess app also entertains, educates children, and develops their intellectual skills.
Undoing movements
Have you made a mistake or want to try another tactic? No problem. Use the Undo button and win!
Hints
If you need a hint on your next move, use the HintMove the piece to the highlighted field to defeat the opponent. The Hints will help you learn the most successful game strategies. They are great for beginners and more experienced chess players.
Learn new moves and impress your friends while playing chess online.
Chess is famous worldwide - the Portuguese and Brazilians play xadrez, the French play échecs, and the Spanish choose ajedrez.
Ready for a chess clash? Play chess online with friends!

details_full_description:
Muslim: Prayer Times, Qibla
Discover All Features of Muslim:
MuslimApp, formerly Muslim Assistant, is your one-stop companion for daily Islamic needs. Our comprehensive Muslim app contains features like Prayer Times, Qibla Finder, Al Quran with Tafsirs, Daily Hadith, Azkar, Tasbih Counter, and more.
MuslimApp offers personalized reminders for muslim prayers, a detailed Islamic calendar, fasting times during Ramadan, and educational content about Islamic history and teachings.
Whether you want to enhance your daily ibadah or deepen your knowledge of Islam, Muslim App is designed to support and enrich your spiritual journey.
• Muslim Prayer Times & Azan اوقات الصلاة، اذان: Stay on top of your muslim prayers with accurate prayer times and Athan-Azan alarm & notifications
- Maqam-based default adhan + country-specific adhan sounds
- Madhhab & latitude adjustments
• Qibla Finder اتجاه القبله الدقيق: Always turn on the right direction for prayer and know the direction of the qibla instantly. The Qibla Finder is designed to help you accurately find the qibla direction.
• AI Imam: An Islamic companion for learning and checking information with respect, care, and verified sources.
• Salah Times Widgets: Easily track upcoming prayer times directly from your home and lock screens with beautifully designed widgets.
• Al Quran القران الكريم: Deepen your understanding of the Holy Quran with beautiful recitations, translations, tafsir (interpretation), and juz tracker. Easily access Surah Yaseen for blessings, specifically designed for Muslim users.
• Hijri Calendar: Stay informed about important Islamic dates and holidays with the integrated Hijri calendar, helping Muslims keep track of significant events throughout the year.
• Daily Hadith: Gain daily inspiration from the Prophet (SAW)'s teachings, providing valuable guidance for Muslim believers.
• Azkar & Tasbih Counter: Track your dhikr and dua
• 99 Names of Allah (Asma-ul Husna): Learn and reflect on the beautiful names of Allah (SWT)
• Friday Messages: Share various Jummah Mubarak messages with friends and family, and connect with fellow Muslim.
• Nearby Mosques: Find mosques near you easily and get accurate prayer times.
• Kaaba Live Broadcast: Experience the serenity of the Kaaba with a live broadcast directly from Makkah
Important Notes
We recommend you use your phone horizontally on a flat surface and keep it away from electromagnetic fields and metal objects so the app can be located accurately.
Confirm your direction according to the blue line we show from the location of the building or place you are in. You can change your location by holding down the sign to ensure the qibla direction is accurate.
Make sure that your settings are up-to-date and open, as our application shows the azan times according to your device's GPS.
Android Permissions
In-app purchase/Payment: If you decide to upgrade Muslim to the Pro version, you can pay securely using your Google Play Store account.
Location (GPS and network-based): Your location is required for muslim prayer times, azan alarm, to determine directions, and to find mosques near you.
Storage/Photo/Media/Files: It is necessary to save downloaded content such as Prayer Times, audio recitations, and translations of the Quran.

details_full_description:
Cittamobi: Ônibus e Trilhos
Cittamobi is your favorite bus app. With it, you can check bus, train, and ferry schedules in real time. We also show vehicles moving on the map, routes, and the best routes to get around the city.
In addition, depending on your location, you can top up your card, request digital assistance from your city's public transportation company, and even pay for your tickets using your cell phone.
We've already had over 25 million downloads in over 300 cities across Brazil, including Salvador, São Paulo, Recife, Maceió, Porto Alegre, Guarulhos, Juiz de Fora, Ribeirão Preto, Osasco, Campinas, and many more.
See how you can simplify your routine with Cittamobi, your complete mobile IMS:
🚍 Check arrivals in real time
Instead of asking "where's my bus," see the schedules and positions of upcoming buses, trains, subway, and ferries on the map in real time.
⭐ Favorite lines and stops
You have a line or stop you use most often, right? Favorite bus lines and stops and access them with just one tap.
📍 Discover the best routes
By bus, train, subway, or on foot, save time and money with our route suggestions based on your location. We have the best itineraries, routes, lines, and departure and arrival times for each station.
📣 Receive alerts
Stay up-to-date with alerts about bus, train, and subway schedule and route changes from your city's bus companies.
💰 Top up your transit card through the app
Check your balance and buy credit for your card wherever you are.
📱 Unlock the turnstile with your cell phone
In Sorocaba, SP, unlock your access to public transportation with your cell phone. Simply register with the Digital Wallet, add funds, and pay your fare. All in just a few taps and 100% digital.
👩‍💻 Request online support
In São Paulo, Santo André, Diadema, and Ribeirão Preto, you can resolve any issues with your transit card with the company responsible for its operation.
See how we make your public transportation routine easier? Download the app and join the Cittamobers community 💜
📱 Follow @cittamobi on Instagram, Facebook, and Twitter. 📧 Questions, suggestions, or criticism? Contact us via the in-app chat.

details_full_description:
Word Garden : Crosswords
Garden of Words is an addictive word puzzle game that challenges your vocabulary and tests your brain. With over a hundred crosswords to play and new levels added regularly, this game will keep you entertained for hours on end.
The objective of this word game is simple – find words hidden in a grid of letters. The words can be arranged in any direction – vertically, horizontally and can even overlap with each other.
Garden of Words isn't just any ordinary word search game. It also features crossword puzzles, where you have to connect letters to form words, and other challenging puzzles that require you to use your logic and strategy skills. You can also compete with other players around the world and climb the leaderboard to become the top word solver.
Here are the advantages of Garden of Words:
► A free game without wifi, you can play it all the time, without limit!
► Multiple difficulty levels for all players, over 8000 levels in 7 languages!
► Finally a word game you can play with friends: challenge your friends and compare your vocabulary!
► You can also learn new words every day with the “Daily Puzzle"". The Daily Puzzle challenges you every day to find all the words in the correct order. A great way to work on your spelling and your memory!
► Explore the crossword puzzles through neat graphics, with many varied and colorful settings, to relax and unwind!
► Unlock lots of bonuses to reward your progress!
► Find the hidden words: each crossword puzzle is full of words to find that are not in the grid! Work on your memory and your vocabulary to discover them!
► Hints: to help you, many hints are at your disposal to reveal a letter, or a word!
The game is designed to be easy to pick up, but difficult to master. As you progress through the levels, the puzzles become more challenging, and you'll need to find longer and more complex words.
Overall, Garden of Words is an engaging word game that is perfect for anyone who loves puzzles and wants to improve their vocabulary. With its wide variety of puzzles and themes, it offers something for everyone, from casual players to hardcore word game enthusiasts. So if you're looking for a fun and challenging word puzzle game, look no further than Garden of Words.

details_full_description:
Yahoo!天気 - 雨雲や台風の接近がわかる天気予報アプリ
Seven Reasons to Choose Yahoo! Weather
1. Simple Design for Easy Understanding
2. High-Performance Rain Cloud Radar
3. Notifications for Approaching Rain Clouds
4. Notifications for Approaching Typhoons
5. Diverse Widgets
6. Comprehensive Disaster Information, Including Earthquakes and Tsunamis
7. Real-Time Weather Reports Based on User Submissions
Main Features
Weather Forecast
You can find weather forecasts up to 17 days in advance for each city and town, detailed hourly weather forecasts, and real-time temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure.
- Get weather forecasts for your current location anytime.
- Easily search for weather information for specific areas or locations.
- Register up to 5 favorite locations or locations.
- Get detailed hourly weather forecasts for up to 72 hours.
- Know sunrise and sunset times.
- Get real-time temperature, humidity, and atmospheric pressure (outdoor measurements).
Rain Cloud Radar
Continuously displays weather radar observations and high-resolution precipitation nowcasts on a map. See rain cloud patterns and precipitation amounts up to 15 hours in advance.
Other Radar Functions
- Wind Radar
Intuitively understand wind strength and flow on a map.
See changes in wind speed and direction at specific locations.
- Lightning Radar
See past lightning strikes and the likelihood of future lightning strikes.
- Typhoon Radar (Only when typhoon occurs)
View typhoon tracks for up to 5 days on a high-performance map.
- Rain/Snow Radar (Winter Only)
Understand the boundary between rain and snow, and know when snow will start falling.
- Snow Depth (Winter Only)
See current snow depth and future forecasts.
Push Notifications (9 types)
Receive timely notifications of weather information useful for daily life and disaster prevention information to protect yourself from disasters.
- Weather Forecast
You can receive notifications for today's and tomorrow's weather forecast.
- Approaching Rain Clouds
Predicts the approach of rain clouds to your current location or registered locations and notifies you before it rains.
- Temperature Difference
Notifies you when the temperature difference with the next day exceeds the set condition.
- Weather Warnings
Notifies you of the issuance and cancellation of weather warnings for your set area.
- Typhoons
You can select notifications for the formation, approach, and dissipation of typhoons.
- Video News
Notifies you of new weather news explained by weather forecasters.
- Heatstroke
Notifies you of today's heatstroke risk level, selected from your chosen level. You will also be notified when a heatstroke warning alert is issued.
- Pollen
You can receive notifications for today's and tomorrow's pollen information by selecting the amount of pollen dispersed.
- Notifications
This will notify you of announcements from Yahoo! Weather.
User Posts
"User Posts" is created by collecting real-time weather information from users. This information can be used in combination with weather forecasts and rain radar to make more accurate situational judgments and predictions.
Four Widget Types
Responsive design is supported, and the design changes according to the installation size.
There are two background patterns, white and black, and the transparency can be freely set.
- Weather Forecast
Simple display of daily weather forecasts.
The number of days displayed changes depending on the installation size.
- Temperature Graph
Shows the temperature trend for the next 24 hours and the previous day.
- Rain Cloud Radar
Shows the current state of rain clouds on a map.
Messages and precipitation graphs show the start of rain and its future progression.
- Current Weather
You can select and display the information you want from current temperature, humidity, etc., in a larger size.
The number of information items displayed changes depending on the installation size.
Weather and Disaster Prevention Information
- Pollen Information (Seasonal)
Shows weekly pollen dispersion in a 4-level index.
The radar map shows the hourly pollen dispersion trend.
- Heatstroke Information (Seasonal)
Shows 6 levels of heatstroke risk.
Dangerous time periods are shown in a graph.
- PM2.5 Information
You can see today's and tomorrow's PM2.5 concentration on a 5-level scale.
You can view a distribution forecast map every 3 hours up to 2 days in advance.
- Yellow Dust Information
You can see today's and tomorrow's yellow dust impact on a 7-level scale.
You can view a distribution forecast map every 3 hours up to 2 days in advance.
- River Water Levels
We provide the risk level and water levels of rivers nationwide on maps and graphs.
- Earthquake Information
You can see the seismic intensity, epicenter, and maximum seismic intensity for various locations on a map.
You can also check the estimated seismic intensity distribution and past earthquake history.
- Tsunami Information
You can see the latest tsunami information on a map.
You can also check the predicted tsunami arrival and inundation areas.
- Other Information
Weather maps, AMeDAS observation information, etc.

- SSL support (HTTPS protocol).
- 17 different layouts with unlimited number of cameras.

details_full_description:
تدارس القرآن
بفكرة إبداعية غير مسبوقة ، وبجهد ضخم بلغ عشرات الآلاف من ساعات العمل المتواصلة، اسفرت عن جمع اكثر من 100 الف وقفة
يسرنا ان نقدم لكم تطبيق ( تدارس القرآن ) :
وهو مصحف جديد تتلوا من خلاله القرآن الكريم ، و تجد في كل آية منه وقفات متنوعه وتفاعلية ، تبحر بها إلى كنوز القران وتنهل من لآلئ خيراته ، وذلك من خلال أقسام متعدده :
١- تدبرات وتأملات قرآنية منوعه ما بين نصية وجرافيك ومقاطع يوتيوب مع امكانية المستخدم كتابة تدبراته الخاصة والتفاعل مع الوقفات الاخرى.
٢- تفسير للقرآن الكريم بمقاطع مرئية ومسموعة لكبار المشايخ المعاصرين مثل ابن باز وابن عثيمين والشنقيطي والشعراوي ، وغيرهم الكثير الكثير .
٣- الأسرار البلاغية في الآية : الآلاف من الاسرار البلاغية التي استنبطها العلماء وقدمناها بعدة اشكال مرئية ومسموعة ومكتوبة .
٤- تذكر وإعتبار : الإعجاز العلمي في القران ، وقصص الناس مع الآية، وكلمات العلماء عنها ، وغيره من علوم الآية وكنوزها .
٥- الأحكام الفقهية والأداب التي تحدثت عنها الآية : شرح وافي للاحكام الفقهية في الايات يقدمها علماء اجلاء مثل الشبخ محمد ابن عثيمين و الشيخ عبدالعزيز الطريفي والشيخ سعد الشثري وغيرهم .
٦- إقتراحات العمل بالآية : وليجمع القارئ بين العلم والعمل بالآية جمعنا بعض الاعمال التطبيقية للايات .
٧- الدعاء والمناجاة : جمعنا أدعية من مفهوم الآية تدعو بها عند تلاوتك لها .
٨- التساؤلات :اجابات عن بعض الاسئلة التي تتبادر إلى الذهن عند تلاوة الآيات أجاب عنها هيئة كبار العلماء والشيخ عبدالعزيز بن باز والشيخ محمد بن عثيمين ومن مجلة البحوث العلمية وغيرهم .
٩- قسم المتشابه : بعض القواعد والأفكار والطرق لضبط الحفظ وإتقانه .
و الميزة الرئيسية في التطبيق أنه مصحف تفاعلي يستطيع مستخدمه إدراج تدبراته وتساؤلاته و وقفاته المتنوعه ، ويعلق على الوقفات الموجودة ويضع لها إعجاب وعدم إعجاب ، في جو تفاعلي نشط .
وكذلك من مميزات التطبيق الرائعة :
* بطريقة برمجية إبداعية : يمكنك من خلال التطبيق إرسال أي تدبر : على شكل لوحة جرافيك رائعة ، تختار خلفيتها من صور جميله ادرجناها في التطبيق ، والأجمل أنك تستطيع ان تختار الخلفية من ألبوم الصور في جوالك أو تلتقطها بكاميرا الجوال مباشرة .
* وكذلك جمعنا أكثر من 2500 لوحة جرافيك تدبريه جميله تجدها مدرجه في كل آية تخصها .
* حرصا منا على نشر العلم : تستطيع تصدير وقفات آية أو سورة على شكل ملف pdf أو ملف word او تستعرضها بشكل مرتب في المتصفح . ( حد أقصى ١٠ آيات لملفات pdf ، وعدد لا محدود للبقية )
* بإمكانك -تصفح وقفات أي عالم او شيخ او متدبر ، وذلك بالضغط مطولا على إسم صاحب الوقفة ، كما يمكنك متابعة جديده ، عندما تقوم بتفضيله في قائمة المصادر المفضلة .
* ميزة البحث في الوقفات .
* ميزة تفضيل وقفة معينة لكي ترجع لها لاحقا.
* ٢٧ كتاب لتفسير القرآن الكريم ، بالإضافة لروابط مباشرة لتفسير الدرر السنية الرائع .
* مميزات أخرى : مثل الورد اليومي - الوضع الليلي - تغيير ألوان الخط والخلفية - إضافة ملاحظة للآية - وضع علامة للرجوع للصفحة - تكبير خط الوقفات وتصغيره ، وغيرها من المميزات الرائعة .
ولدعم التطبيق أنشأنا قناة في اليوتيوب قمنا فيها بمونتاج أكثر من ١٦٠٠ مقطع في التفسير والتدبر .
سألين الله ان يجعل هذا التطبيق معين للناس على تدارس القران وتدبره وأن يشملنا جميعا قول الرسول صلى الله عليه وسلم ( مَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلَّا نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ وَغَشِيَتْهُمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَحَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلَائِكَةُ وَذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عِنْدَهُ ) .

details_full_description:
Voice Access
Voice Access helps anyone who has difficulty manipulating a touch screen (e.g. due to paralysis, tremor, or temporary injury) use their Android device by voice.
Voice Access provides many voice commands for:
- Basic navigation (e.g. "go back", "go home", "open Gmail")
- Controlling the current screen (e.g. "tap next", "scroll down")
- Text editing and dictation (e.g. "type hello", "replace coffee with tea")
You can also say "Help" any time to see a short list of commands.
Voice Access includes a tutorial which introduces the most common voice commands (starting Voice Access, tapping, scrolling, basic text editing, and getting help).
You can use the Google Assistant to start Voice Access by saying "Hey Google, Voice Access". To do this, you’ll need to enable "Hey Google" detection. You can also tap either the Voice Access notification or a blue Voice Access button and start talking.
To pause Voice Access temporarily, just say "stop listening". To disable Voice Access completely, go to Settings > Accessibility > Voice Access and turn off the switch.
For additional support, see Voice Access help.
This app uses the AccessibilityService API to help users with motor impairments. It uses the API to collect information about the controls on the screen and activate them based on the user’s spoken instructions.

details_full_description:
Papers Grade Please!
How smart do you think you are? Hopefully you have enough brain power to grade the answers from your students! Kids say the funniest things and it is up to you to catch what is right and what is wrong. Give students A’s or F’s based on their answers. Careful, not all of them are geniuses so it is up to you to catch the wrong answers!

details_full_description:
Chess Online & Offline
Checkmate is a modern chess mobile app with friendly design, classical music in the background and the excitement of discovering the nuances of this wonderful board game. We created a new version of this royal game, innovative and full of surprises. The app offers the possibility to play online with players from all over the world (for rating points) and offline practice play with a computer (without rating points). This app was born from a fascination with chess - the game that has been moving minds and hearts of millions of players around the world for centuries!
Some say that chess was born in India, others that in Persia. In many languages it is called differently: Chess, Scacchi, शतरंज, Échecs, Xadrez, Szachy, Schach, Ajedrez, Шахматы, Satranç, チェス, 棋, الشطرنج. We have been playing this game for over 1500 years, and today it is played in almost 200 countries around the world - with new secrets still being discovered. People all over the world play millions of wars on a 64-field boards every day - you could say these are the real games of thrones. Chess conquered the world long ago and its popularity is growing constantly. We want to play our part in it!
Key Features
• Playing chess online with players from all over the world
• Playing chess offline against the computer - you can choose the difficulty level from beginner to expert
• Playing chess with your friends - you can invite your friends to play and accept invitations from others
• Sound effects during the game to enhance the experience
• Advanced haptics - various vibrations effects make the game even more engaging
• Choice of 21 chessboard styles and 16 sets of chess pieces
• Helpful markers showing: legal moves, last move, possible captures, king in check and more
• Ability to use the pending move (also called premove) to avoid wasting time in games - when the opponent's move comes, your move will be made automatically
• Ability to browse game history during the game
• Over 3000 game openings with variations - the app recognizes them and displays information, e.g. Sicilian Defense, Queen's Gambit, Caro-Kann Defense, Italian Game and French Defense
• Most beautiful pieces of classical music while using the app
• Puzzles - solving chess puzzles helps develop your skills. It takes little time and you get points for guessing the best moves! 500,000+ tactics puzzles to solve - mate in 1, mate in 2, mate in 3, perpetual check, endgames, pin, fork, skewer, sacrifice, etc. - if you solve them quickly you will get a speed bonus!
• Rankings - our global ranking and country rankings of all registered players! The order in the player rankings is determined by ELO rating, number of online games won, and points earned while solving puzzles. At any time you can check your exact position in the ranking in your country and worldwide!
More Details
• Time-limited online games in the following modes: Classic (10, 20 and 30 minutes), Blitz (3, 5 and 3 minutes + 2s/move), Bullet (1 minute, 1 minute + 1s/move and 2 minutes + 1s/move)
• In the online game you will meet players of all levels, from beginner to grandmaster
• Strong computer for offline play with 16 strength levels (from 600 to 2100 ELO rating)
• Rankings, players and computer strength in game are calculated using the Arpad Elo formula - well known as the ELO chess rating
• Access to game statistics, editing user data including profile picture
• Ultra-fast, efficient and reliable Firebase Firestore database which is part of the Google infrastructure - all to ensure the convenience and comfort of games for thousands of players simultaneously
• Light and dark theme support
• Material Design 3 interface
• Checkmate Chess is free to download and use
• Respecting your privacy and the security of your data
About Us
• Visit SplendApps.com: https://splendapps.com/
• Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/SplendApps/
• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/splendapps/
• Twitter: https://twitter.com/SplendApps

Tata CLiQ Fashion Shopping
WELCOME TO TATA CLIQ FASHION
A place where style meets substance, and every click is a step towards defining your narrative. TATA CLiQ Fashion is more than just a fashion shopping app - we are enablers of style for consumers who crave authenticity, expression, individuality, and impact.
From curated collections from over 4000+ brands and the hottest trends to cutting-edge features, everything is designed to celebrate YOU.
Download TATA CLiQ Fashion App to:
Discover Your Style
Explore curated edits for women, men, and kids, with collections that are on-trend for every occasion. From new season launches to exclusive collaborations, find pieces that are as unique as you are. Choose from smart casual wear by brands like U.S. Polo Assn., Jack & Jones, and ONLY, or browse occasion-ready ethnic wear from Fabindia, Biba, and Westside. Complete the look with stylish and trendy footwear from top brands like PUMA and ADIDAS that blend comfort with contemporary flair.
Shop Smart
Navigate our expert curation of brands chosen for their commitment to quality, authenticity, and innovation. Whether it’s casual wear for men and women or standout pieces for special occasions, we’ve got styles that speak to you. Use intuitive filtering options to discover looks that reflect your vibe. With our app, you can also find beautiful home decor online that adds warmth and character to your space.
Buy Effortlessly, Every Time
We guarantee 100% original products, hassle-free returns, secure payments, and EMI options. Browse across categories, from fashion and beauty to footwear, and earn NeuCoins as you shop!
Dress With Purpose
We believe in the power of individuality, the beauty of diversity, the foundation of tradition, and the necessity of sustainability. Our vision is an inclusive future where fashion is not just worn but lived, and enable that with expert-approved curations tailored for every occasion and season. Through expert curation and deep industry insight, TATA CLiQ Fashion brings this vision to life - championing makers, materials, and stories that truly matter.
Experience Innovation
Tailored to your taste, our personalised updates make shopping effortless and interactive, offering a customer journey that’s seamless and suited for you.
Stay Ahead of Trends
Receive updates on the latest arrivals, exclusive drops, and must-have pieces in real-time. From trend playbooks to access to style insiders, our app keeps you connected to the latest in fashion. Stay clued in on everything from streetwear and timeless men’s shirts by Arrow, Van Heusen, and Allen Solly to women’s must-haves like chic dresses and effortless tops from global brands like Calvin Klein Jeans and Guess. Browse this season’s most-wanted handbags online, that are both functional and on-trend.
Get Inspired
Join a community of fashion fans. Whether you’re building a look for today or finding inspiration for tomorrow, the TATA CLiQ Fashion app brings you closer to your style goals.
Step Into The Future
Backed by a legacy of excellence, we come from the TATA Group, renowned for its dedication to quality, integrity, and innovation. Our foundation is strong, our ambitions boundless. With decades of expertise, culture-defining successes, and a forward-thinking approach, we blend tradition with the cutting-edge to offer you the best of both worlds. And with TATA CLiQ Fashion as the official online shopping destination for Westside, your favourite pieces from the trusted high-street favourite are now just a click away.
Your Wardrobe, Redefined
Download the TATA CLiQ Fashion app and redefine what style means to you. From everyday staples to statement pieces, this shopping app makes style simple. Each click is more than a choice - it’s a step toward expressing who you are.

Looking to watch live TV channels, sports highlights, entertainment shows, podcasts, and short-form videos online on the go? Tamasha has all of that and much more. Explore a growing library of original digital shows, documentaries, interviews, and on-demand videos. Discover stories across culture, lifestyle, education, and entertainment created for modern viewers who want flexible, anytime access.

Enjoy bite-sized videos featuring highlights, trending moments, sports clips, entertainment content, and user-generated content (UGC), designed for quick and engaging viewing on the go.
★ Awareness & Informative Content:
Access educational, awareness-driven, and informative content that highlights digital initiatives, social topics, and meaningful stories aimed at informing and inspiring audiences.

• Hassle-free and quick sign-in process to access content

• Smooth streaming experience over Wi-Fi and mobile data
Look no further for your entertainment needs — whether you want live TV, sports highlights, podcasts, or short videos, Tamasha is your all-in-one streaming platform built for global audiences.
Download Tamasha today and start streaming anytime, anywhere.

details_full_description:
BBC Weather
Wherever you are, and whatever your plans, you're always prepared with the latest weather forecast from BBC Weather. Easy to understand, with hourly forecasts for tens of thousands of locations around the globe.
Main features:
Get the information you need – fast. Including:
● At-a-glance forecasts, so you can make decisions quickly
● Hourly data up to 14 days ahead (in UK locations and major international cities)
● 'Chance of precipitation', giving you a heads-up about rain, hail or snow
● 'Feels like' temperature, which takes into account wind speed and humidity
● Met Office weather warnings, personalised to locations that matter to you
● Social-friendly forecasts, sharable on Facebook, Twitter and email
● Text-to-speech accessibility
● Easy-to-read, intuitive layout
BBC Weather app and your privacy:
The BBC Weather app allows you to see weather information based on your current location. When you first install the app, we’ll ask you whether you wish to enable this option. You can turn this feature on/off at any time via Settings > Apps > BBC Weather > Permissions > Locations.
If you choose to enable this feature, the app uses your device's location to find the closest location where weather information is available. The BBC does not store nor share your device's precise location in accordance with the BBC’s Privacy Policy: https://www.bbc.co.uk/weather/about/57854010.
If you choose to enable this feature for the BBC Weather widget, we request permission to access your device’s location while the app is closed or not in use. This ensures that the widget can continuously display the most up-to-date forecast for your current location.
If you install this app, you accept the BBC Terms of Use: https://www.bbc.co.uk/terms.
For attribution and analysis purposes, our data processor AppsFlyer collects the below information about you:
- Your device information, such as device type
- Your IP address to determine your location
- Activity data, such as the time you downloaded the app
- Which sites (if any) referred you to download and use the app
You can opt out from AppsFlyer tracking by filling out their ‘Forget My Device’ form: https://www.appsflyer.com/optout.
About BBC Weather:
BBC Weather is responsible for preparing and broadcasting weather forecasts across the BBC, in association with the MeteoGroup. It broadcast its first weather forecast in 1922 and by 1936 was pioneering the use of weather maps during TV forecasts. The BBC Weather app was launched in 2013 and is now one of the most popular weather apps in the UK.

WAMR: Reveal deleted messages!
See Deleted Messages with WAMR!
Ever wish you could see a deleted message? Searching for "wamr"? You've found the solution!
WAMR helps you recover deleted text messages and media attachments (photos, videos, voice notes, audio, GIFs, and stickers) from your chat apps. Stop wondering what was said and regain control of your conversations!
How WAMR works (for those searching "wamr")
WAMR leverages your notification history to create a backup of incoming messages. When a message is deleted, WAMR instantly notifies you and retrieves the content from its backup. It's a clever workaround for those frustrating disappearing messages!
NO MORE BLUE CHECKS
Since you now have a live backup of your notifications, this means that you can read entire chats, conversations without sending "read receipts" (blue check marks).
Welcome back privacy!
Recover Media Too!
WAMR also works for media! If someone deletes a photo, video, or any other media attachment before you see it, WAMR will notify you and attempt to recover it.
Important Considerations for WAMR Users
WAMR relies on notifications. For optimal performance:
* Enable Notifications: Ensure notifications are enabled for your messaging apps. Silent chats won't be recoverable.
* Battery Optimization: Prevent Android from closing WAMR in the background by excluding it from battery optimization settings.
* Download success: WAMR can only save media files that have been fully downloaded. A stable internet connection is recommended.
Things to Keep in Mind
WAMR offers a workaround for retrieving deleted messages, but it has limitations based on the messaging app, Android OS, and other factors. It's important to understand that retrieving messages deleted before WAMR was installed is not possible.
Privacy Focused
Your privacy is paramount. WAMR saves everything locally on your device. This means that no one else has access to your chats, notifications, messages,
STATUS DOWNLOAD
Status download is not supported anymore, apologies for the inconvenience.
Download WAMR now and never miss a deleted message again!

MapFactor Navigator
Proven reliability with over 35 million downloads worldwide. Private. Offline. Professional.
MapFactor Navigator is a professional GPS navigation app for those who value autonomy and privacy. With high-quality offline maps from OpenStreetMaps (updated monthly for FREE), you can navigate over 200 countries without an internet connection, without third-party tracking, and without external ads. Enjoy precise voice guidance, speed limit alerts, and seamless Android Auto integration.
PRIVACY AND AD-FREE EXPERIENCE
While others profit from your data, MapFactor keeps you safe:
• No Third-Party Ads: A clean, distraction-free interface. We don't sell your screen space.
• Total Privacy: We do not track your movements or sell your location history.
• 100% Offline Capability: Maps are stored locally. Navigate anywhere without data roaming.
• No Account Required: Start navigating immediately without forced registrations.
KEY FEATURES
• Intuitive Voice Navigation with a clear maneuver overview and distance to the next turn shown on screen.
• Door-to-door route planning with 2D/3D visual modes.
• Detailed Offline Maps with postcodes (full GB) installed on your device or SD card.
• Specialized Routing: Modes for car, truck, bus, motorhome (camper), bicycle, or motorcycle.
• Favorite Routes and Places for quick access.
• Safety First: Speed limit warnings, camera alerts, and lane assistant.
• Android Auto Connectivity for a seamless dashboard experience.
• Route Avoidance: Easily block specific roads or areas from your journey.
NAVIGATOR TRUCK: FOR LARGE VEHICLES
Professional navigation for trucks, buses, and motorhomes (available with TomTom Truck maps):
• Specialized Routing: Avoids restrictions like low bridges, weight limits, and narrow lanes.
• Precision Truck Routing (v8.1+): Enhanced professional-grade accuracy for fleet and heavy vehicle safety.
NEW AND UNIQUE FEATURES
• MapStick Support: Import professional TomTom maps via USB flash disk without any data connection.
• Nearby POIs Along Route: Real-time display of selected points (gas, parking, EV chargers) directly on the navigation screen.
GLOBAL COVERAGE (200+ Countries)

details_full_description:
Google Fit: Activity Tracking
Get to a healthier and more active life with the new Google Fit!
It's hard to know how much or what kind of activity you need to stay healthy. That's why Google Fit collaborated with the World Health Organization (WHO) and the American Heart Association (AHA) to bring you Heart Points, an activity goal that can help improve your health.
Activities that get your heart pumping harder have tremendous health benefits for your heart and mind. You'll earn one Heart Point for each minute of moderate activity like picking up the pace when walking your dog, and double points for more intense activities like running. It takes just 30-minutes of brisk walking five days a week to reach the AHA and WHO's recommended amount of physical activity shown to reduce the risk of heart disease, improve sleep, and increase overall mental wellbeing.
Google Fit will also help you:
TRACK YOUR WORKOUTS FROM YOUR PHONE OR WATCH
Get instant insights when you exercise and see real-time stats for your runs, walks, and bike rides. Fit will use your Android phone's sensors or Wear OS by Google smartwatch's heart rate sensors to record your speed, pace, route, and more.
MONITOR YOUR GOALS
See your daily progress on your Heart Points and Steps goal. Meeting your goals all the time? Easily adjust your goals to keep challenging yourself to achieve a healthy heart and mind.
MAKE ALL YOUR MOVEMENT COUNT
If you walk, run, or bike throughout the day, your Android phone or Wear OS by Google smartwatch will automatically detect and add your activities to your Google Fit journal to ensure you get credit for every move. Want extra credit? Turn up the tempo on your walks by starting a paced walking workout and stepping to the beat. Enjoy a different type of workout? Select it from a list of activities like pilates, rowing, or spinning, and Google Fit will track all the Heart Points you earn.
CONNECT WITH YOUR FAVORITE APPS AND DEVICES
Fit can show you info from many of your favorite apps and devices to give you a holistic view of your health, so you'll never lose track of your progress. These include Lifesum, Wear OS by Google, Nike+, Runkeeper, Strava, MyFitnessPal, Basis, Sleep as Android, Withings, Xiaomi Mi bands, and more.
CHECK IN AT ANYTIME, FROM ANYWHERE
See a snapshot of your activity history across Fit and your integrated apps in the redesigned journal. Or, get the full picture in browse, where you can find all of your health and wellness data.
KEEP A FINGER ON THE PULSE OF YOUR HEALTH
Breathing is one of the simplest ways to reduce tension and relieve stress. With Fit, checking in with your breath is easy—all you need is your phone camera. As well as your respiratory rate, you can measure your heart rate to get a better understanding of your body’s wellbeing.
VIEW YOUR DAY'S STATS AT A GLANCE
Add a widget to the home screen of your Android phone or set up a tile and complication on your Wear OS by Google smartwatch.
Learn more about Google Fit and see a list of supported apps at: www.google.com/fit

details_full_description:
Live Weather: Weather Forecast
Esta é unha aplicación profesional de predición do tempo que é gratuíta.
A aplicación mostra con precisión as condicións meteorolóxicas actuais na súa localización exacta, en calquera lugar do mundo. Ofrece detalles actualizados sobre a temperatura, a choiva, a probabilidade de precipitación, a neve, o vento, as horas de sol, as horas de saída e posta do sol.
A PREVISIÓN TEMPORAL E O TEMPO EN VIVO ofrece a previsión meteorolóxica máis precisa e fiable. Tamén ofrece os indicadores meteorolóxicos máis precisos, como as horas de saída e posta do sol, humidade, índice UV, velocidade do vento, calidade do aire e precipitacións.
🌞Tempo en tempo real
- Mostra a temperatura actual, a temperatura real, a icona do tempo, a velocidade e dirección do vento, a temperatura máxima e mínima
🌞Alerta meteorolóxica en directo e desastres naturais
- Mostra a área afectada, a hora de inicio, a hora de finalización, o resumo de avisos, o texto de aviso e a fonte de datos. As diferentes cores de advertencia representan diferentes niveis.
- Proporciona avisos de vento forte, choiva intensa, tormenta de neve e treboadas
🌞 Detalles do tempo de hoxe
- Proporciona temperatura corporal, horas de saída e posta do sol, humidade, raios ultravioleta, visibilidade, choiva e orballo, altitude, cobertura de nubes.
🌞Previsión do tempo para as próximas 24/72 horas
- Ofrece unha previsión meteorolóxica detallada de 24 horas, incluídas as previsións meteorolóxicas por hora
🌞Previsión do tempo para os próximos 10/25 días
- Proporciona temperatura diaria, resumo do tempo, humidade, índice UV, probabilidade de chuvia/nevada/xeo, probabilidade de raios, dirección do vento/velocidade/nivel do vento e hora do amencer/solpor.
🌞Minuto de choiva durante 2 horas
- Usa Rain Tracker para mostrar as precipitacións e nevadas minuto a minuto, así como a precipitación e o espesor da neve durante as dúas próximas horas
🌞Índice de calidade do aire
- Ofrece niveis de calidade do aire e recomendacións de viaxe. Os índices específicos inclúen PM10, PM2,5, monóxido de carbono, dióxido de carbono, dióxido de xofre, ozono e niveles de calidade. Tamén ofrece explicacións e recomendacións para os distintos niveis do Índice de Calidade do Aire. Ademais, mostra o índice UV e a información do índice de pole.
🌞Unidade de información meteorolóxica e configuración de formato
- Permite aos usuarios configurar a súa temperatura preferida, precipitación, visibilidade, velocidade do vento, presión, sistema horario e formato de data
🌞Mapa de radar meteorolóxico en tempo real
- Mostra un mapa de radar mellorado que inclúe cuberta de nubes, sol, choiva, neve, saraiba, treboadas e áreas de raios. Esta función permítelle ver ao instante as condicións meteorolóxicas de varios lugares. Ademais, permítelle seguir o movemento das nubes, as frontes meteorolóxicas e as tormentas activas para ver se afectarán ou evitarán a súa localización.
🌞Xestión de localizacións
- Permite aos usuarios engadir e eliminar manualmente cidades, axustar a orde das cidades, configurar notificacións e widgets para cidades e predicións meteorolóxicas. Tamén permite aos usuarios gardar calquera localización e ver as condicións actuais de calquera número de localizacións globais á vez.
🌞Widget e reloxo do tempo
- Ofrece un widget meteorolóxico que mostra a temperatura, a hora e a data actuais na súa localización actual. Tamén mostra información meteorolóxica sinxela, predicións diarias e horarias e actualiza as condicións meteorolóxicas.
🌞Notificación de predición do tempo
- Envía a información meteorolóxica máis importante todos os días, para que poidas estar informado sobre as condicións meteorolóxicas detalladas durante todo o día.
🌞Modo de visualización
- Permite aos usuarios cambiar libremente entre o modo claro e escuro.
🌞Soporte para varios idiomas
- A aplicación ofrece soporte na aplicación para máis de 100 idiomas.

details_full_description:
ISS Live Now: Live Earth View
Watch the Earth live from space, in real time, from the International Space Station (ISS). ISS Live Now turns your phone into a window on space: live ISS cameras, a real-time satellite tracker, astronomy and stargazing tools, and a community of enthusiasts, so you can follow human spaceflight up close and NASA's Artemis missions to the Moon.
Highlights
- Live Earth in HD, 24/7, straight from space aboard the ISS.
- Real-time ISS tracking on an interactive orbit map.
- Artemis context: follow NASA's Artemis missions and the Orion spacecraft to the Moon.
- Alerts for visible passes, rocket launches and space events.
- Space news and launches from NASA, SpaceX, ESA, Roscosmos, JAXA, Blue Origin and more.
Live and recorded channels
Multiple cameras and channels, straight from the ISS and the space agencies:
- HD Camera - the Earth in real time, in rich detail.
- SD Camera - astronaut activities and operations on board.
- 4K Camera - Sen.com - high-resolution views of the planet.
- NASA TV and NASA TV Media - official NASA coverage.
- ESA TV - broadcasts from the European Space Agency.
- Spacewalk (Recorded) - astronaut spacewalks in HD.
- Night (Time-lapse) - city lights, auroras and storms seen from above.
- Inside the ISS (Recorded) - a tour of the station modules, guided by astronauts.
- Launch Pad Cameras and Temporary Channel - launches and special broadcasts from NASA, SpaceX, ESA and Roscosmos.
Tools to explore space
- Sky Explorer - locate the ISS in the sky in 3D, along with the Sun and the Moon.
- ISS Detector - see when and where the station crosses your sky.
- Events - the schedule of upcoming rocket launches and space events.
- Who is on the ISS? - meet the crew currently on board.
- NASA On Demand and News - watch official NASA+ videos, series and the latest news.
- Solar System Explorer and Telescopes - explore planets, moons and the deep sky.
- SpaceX Docking Simulator - play and practice a docking with the station.
- Virtual Tour - visit the interior of the ISS in 360 degrees, with imagery from Google Street View captured by astronaut Thomas Pesquet.
Community chat
Chat live with space lovers from all over the world, share photos and climb the Chat Champions leaderboard. Messages come with automatic translation.
About the broadcast
When the ISS is on the night side of the Earth the image goes black, which is normal. A blue or gray screen means a camera switch or a short pause in the NASA signal, and the stream returns within a few minutes.
Follow ISS Live Now
Instagram: @isslivenow
Facebook: @isslivenow
X: @isslivenow
Download ISS Live Now and start exploring space today.

MediBuddy-Doctor Medicine ABHA
MediBuddy: The best healthcare app for all your health needs
MediBuddy is India's largest digital healthcare platform, designed to enhance your healthcare experience. We've got you covered whether you're seeking doctor consultations, medicine delivery, lab tests, or surgery care & are a one-stop solution for all your healthcare needs!
Services offered:
1. Online & In-clinic Doctor Consultations:
MediBuddy is a doctor app that allows you to access world-class doctors from your home or at clinics/hospitals. Whether it's an urgent medical issue or regular check-ups, you can easily book doctor appointments, consult via teleconsultation, or visit clinics nearby.
- Gynecology: Irregular periods, pregnancy-related issues, menstrual cramps, and breastfeeding concerns.
- Mental Health: Anxiety, depression, psychiatric support, & counseling.
- Dermatology: Skin problems like acne, rashes, & dry skin.
- Cardiology: Heart health check-ups & advice.
- Sexology: Private consultations for sexual health issues.
- Hair and Scalp Care: Treatment for hair loss, dandruff, & receding hairlines.
- General Physician: Cold, fever, headaches, & general health concerns.
- Pediatrics: Child health, including fever, nutrition, & bed-wetting.
- Gastroenterology: Digestive issues, stomach problems, & disorders.
- Diabetes: Help with managing and controlling diabetes.
- Other Specialities: Orthopedics, neurology, weight management, cancer advice, & more.
2. Online Medicine Delivery:
Get your medicines delivered to your doorstep with MediBuddy's online medicine delivery service. Get discounts on orders and free delivery across 96% of Indian PIN codes. You can order medications from the MediBuddy online pharmacy.
3. Book Lab Tests & Health Checks:
Take control of your health with easy access to certified labs. MediBuddy makes it simple to book lab tests such as:
- Full Body Checkups
- Diabetes Test
- Kidney Test
- Thyroid Tests
- CBC Test
- Ultrasound Test
- Cardiac Markers, and much more.
Get accurate results & avoid the hassle of waiting in line at traditional diagnostic centers. Collect samples at home or visit a diagnostic center for scans, X-rays, or MRIs.
4. Surgery Care:
Get end-to-end surgery care support with MediBuddy, ensuring that you are well cared for, from pre-surgery consultations to post-operative recovery.
5. Dental Services:
Take care of your dental health with MediBuddy’s easy dental appointments. Book consultations with nearby dentists & get treatments tailored to your needs.
6. Insurance and TPA Services:
MediBuddy offers insurance-related services such as:
- Access & view your Medi Assist eCard.
- Book cashless healthcare services.
- Locate network hospitals for better coverage.
- Track claims in real-time for quick updates.
7. Ayushman Card Integration:
Gain access to a wide range of benefits, from government health programs like Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY to insurance schemes integrated into a single, convenient platform. MediBuddy seamlessly integrates with the Ayushman Bharat program, offering ease of access to health coverage through the Ayushman Card, ensuring better healthcare services.
8. ABHA-Approved Personal Health Records App:
The ABHA integrated app is a centralized digital health platform that allows you to store & manage all your medical information. With ABHA, you can quickly view or share your medical history with doctors, making consultations faster and more efficient.
Why choose MediBuddy?
- Comprehensive healthcare: From doctor consultations, lab tests, to medicine delivery & insurance services.
- Convenience: Access healthcare services anytime, anywhere with a smartphone.
- Trusted: Work with only genuine, certified pharmacies & accredited doctors.
- Wide reach: Serving 96% of Indian pin codes.
- Privacy and Confidentiality: Confidential consultations, especially for sensitive issues like sexual or mental health.
Download the MediBuddy app for a seamless healthcare experience at your fingertips.

Turn your Android device into a professional POS terminal.

- Expand your reach: Every staff member’s device becomes a payment point. Perfect for peak hours and mobile sales.

details_full_description:
Snapseed
Snapseed is a complete and professional photo editor developed by Google. Pro-level tools, authentic film simulations, smart masking and more — all with no strings attached.
== KEY FEATURES ==
• No Strings Attached: Get 30+ pro tools and filters - no subscriptions, purchases, ads, or watermarks
• Vintage Styles: realistic film filters, plus Halation, Bloom, and Grain tools
• Smart Masking: Instantly and intelligently isolate subjects or backgrounds with a single tap for fast, targeted edits
• Batch Editing: Quickly apply your favorite looks and edits to multiple photos
• Snapseed Camera: Capture using custom styles or film looks. Save time with real-time effects that can be edited or reset later
• Non-destructive Editing: Easily undo changes or revert to your original photo at any time
• RAW Support: Open and edit JPG and RAW files with precise control
== PRO TOOLS & FILTERS ==
• Snapseed Camera – shoot directly in your favorite film simulations or custom looks to capture your unique style in real-time and skip the editing step
• Adjust – adjust exposure and color automatically or manually with fine, precise control
• One-Touch Masking – instantly select subjects or backgrounds with smart precision for seamless targeted edits
• Selective – precisely adjust brightness, contrast, or saturation in specific areas without affecting the rest of your photo
• Healing – remove the uninvited neighbor from a group picture
• Film – get beautiful looks with our completely updated, realistic film simulations of historic film stocks
• Batch Edit – apply your custom looks and edits to an entire batch of photos instantly
• Halation – add an authentic highlight glow to replicate classic analog lens effects
• Bloom – create a soft, dreamy optical diffusion to light sources for a cinematic finish
• RAW Develop – open and tweak some RAW file types
• Double Exposure - combine two photos using blend modes inspired by film and digital processing
• Portrait – modern tools to quickly enhance lighting, adjust poses, and refine facial features
• Details – magically brings out surface structures in images
• Crop and rotate – crop to standard sizes, rotate by 90°, or straighten a skewed horizon
• Perspective – fix skewed lines and perfect the geometry of horizons or buildings
• White Balance – adjust the colors so that the image looks more natural
• Brush – selectively retouch exposure, saturation, brightness or warmth
• Vignette – darken image corners for a classic photographic effect
• Curves - have precise control over the brightness levels in your photos
• Color HSL – precisely adjust hue, saturation, and luminance of any color
• Dehaze – instantly clear haze, fog, or glare for better contrast and detail
• Expand - increase the size of your canvas
• Lens Blur – add a beautiful Bokeh to images (background softening)
• Glamour Glow – add a fine glow to images, great for fashion or portraits
• Tonal Contrast – boost details selectively in the shadows, midtones and highlights
• Black & White – classic Black and White look straight out of the darkroom
• and more!

Book directly with Marriott Bonvoy to enjoy exclusive offers, take the stress out of travel planning, and find the best hotel deals.
Search hotels, resorts, and luxury destinations across 9,000+ hotels, 130+ countries, and over 35 brands. Whether you are on a business trip or family vacation, join for free and earn rewards when booking with Marriott Bonvoy.
(1) BOOK YOUR HOTEL
SEARCH HOTELS, BOOK STAYS, AND EARN REWARDS:
• Earn points for your stays booked directly with Marriott.
• Not sure where to go? Let our ‘Explore’ and ‘Road Trip’ feature inspire your journey.
• Choose from our 35+ brands to fit your personal style of travel.
BEST RATE GUARANTEE:

FLEXIBLE CANCELLATIONS:

EASY ACCESS VIA MOBILE HOTEL KEY:
• Never worry about losing your key card again. Use your mobile device to open your hotel room and easily access hotel amenities like the parking garage, fitness center, lounge, and pool.

(3) DURING YOUR STAY
ORDER FOOD AND DRINKS AHEAD OF TIME:
• Out exploring? Browse and order food and drinks from your hotel’s menu, and it will be ready when you return. Available at participating properties.
CONVENIENTLY CHAT WITH YOUR PROPERTY:
• Mobile Chat lets you talk directly to your hotel before, during, and after your stay.
• For the best travel experience, ask the front desk for local recommendations, request amenities, and more - all while on-the-go.
• Need something? Mobile Request allows you to customize your stay and even ask for something you forgot -like a comb or toothpaste.
• Free Wi-Fi offered at most hotels for Marriott Bonvoy members
(4) AFTER YOUR STAY
ENJOY EXCLUSIVE MARRIOTT BONVOY HOTEL OFFERS:
• Check your point balance and view your stay history and hotel bill.
• Unlock travel rewards and redeem your points on hotels, experiences, restaurants, rideshares, and more. Take advantage of our numerous partnerships!

details_full_description:
Great Clips Online Check-in
WHAT IS ONLINE CHECK-IN?
Online Check-In saves you time by seeing estimated wait times for hair salons near you. From there, just pick your favorite salon, and get on the waitlist from wherever you are.
FEATURES:
-Check estimated wait times based on current conditions in the salon and updates in real time.
-Online Check-In: You save time by checking in to the salon ahead of time - saving your place in line.
-ReadyNext®: Get text alerts to notify you when your estimated wait time reaches 15 minutes as your cue to head to the salon.
-Save your favorite hair salon so it’s even quicker next time you check in!
HOW TO USE:
-Tap the Search icon
-Pick a hair salon near you
-Tap the Check In button
-Enter your name and phone number
-Tap Check In again to be added to the wait list – no login, email, or profile required.
-Let the salon know when you arrive.
After you check in, you can watch your estimated wait time countdown and arrive at the salon when it's nearly your turn to get your service.
ESTIMATED WAIT TIME
Estimated wait times assume you are getting the next available stylist. You can request a stylist upon arrival at the salon but your wait may be longer. For safety and privacy reasons, we do not publish stylist schedules.
WHEN IS ONLINE CHECK-IN AVAILABLE?
Customers can check in online during the hours the salon is open. Online Check-In will not be available during the first five minutes a salon is scheduled to be open. This gives customers who are physically in the salon when it opens a chance to be checked in and have their names added to the waitlist. We accept online check-in up until 30 minutes before closing time. You can still get a haircut at closing time, you just can't check in on the app.
CAN I USE ONLINE CHECK-IN FOR MORE THAN A HAIRCUT?
Yes, you can use Online Check-In for all services except perms and formal updos. Please note that not all salons offer perms. And, most salons require an appointment for these services, so please call the salon to inquire.
WHAT DO I DO IF I DON’T HAVE A MOBILE DEVICE?
You can check in from any device that has internet (a smartphone, tablet, computer, etc.). Go to greatclips.com, click on Find a Salon or Check In. Enter your postal code or address and you'll be using Online Check-In in no time! If you don't have an Internet connection, you can always walk right in to any salon and add your name to the list.
WHEN SHOULD I ARRIVE AT THE SALON?
After you've checked in online, you will see what place you are in on the waitlist. You'll want to arrive to the salon before you are next in line. If you'd like to receive a text message when your estimated wait time reaches 15 minutes, you can sign up for ReadyNext® text alerts. Once you arrive at the salon, let the stylists know you're there, and they will confirm your information and finish your check in.
WHAT HAPPENS IF I ARRIVE LATE?
We understand: Things happen! Don't worry if you lose your keys, spill something, or get stuck in traffic. We'll keep your name on the list for a short period of time.
HOW DO I CANCEL MY CHECK IN?
Once you are checked in, the salon will appear on the home screen. Cancel at any time by tapping Cancel check-in.

Calm is the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation. Find anxiety relief, stress relief, and better sleep through breathing exercises, sleep sounds, deep sleep music, and mindfulness programs for insomnia, beginner meditation, and beyond. Downloaded by 180 million people worldwide.
Fall asleep faster with Sleep Stories, bedtime stories for adults narrated by Matthew McConaughey, Stephen Fry, P!nk, Bob Ross, and more. Only on Calm.
Manage stress, relieve anxiety, improve your sleep cycle, and refocus your attention. Whether you have 3 minutes or 3 hours, Calm meets you where you are.
Apple App of the Year. Apple Editors' Choice. Happiest App in the World (Center for Humane Technology). 3M+ five-star reviews. Recommended by top psychologists, therapists, and mental health experts.
SLEEP STORIES — ONLY ON CALM
*Drift off to Matthew McConaughey's Wonder — a dreamy journey through the mysteries of the universe
*Travel through the village of Provence with master storyteller Stephen Fry in Blue Gold
*Fall asleep to the soothing brush strokes of beloved painter Bob Ross in Happy Little Zzzs
*Tackle insomnia with 100+ exclusive Sleep Stories, new content added every month
MEDITATION & MINDFULNESS
*Beginner meditation to advanced practice — guided sessions for every experience level
*Daily Calm with Tamara Levitt, Daily Jay with Jay Shetty, Daily Trip with Jeff Warren
*Mindfulness topics: deep sleep, anxiety relief, stress relief, focus, breaking habits, self-care, personal growth, and more
*7- and 21-day mindfulness programs to build a lasting practice
ANXIETY RELIEF & RELAXATION
*Breathing exercises and breathwork to ease anxiety, stress, and insomnia
*Bilateral stimulation music and bilateral music for nervous system regulation and somatic relaxation
*Guided breathwork for stress relief, anxiety relief, and deep calm
*Stress management and self-healing through Dailies: programs for social anxiety, personal growth, and mood balance
*Mindful movement and stretching with Daily Move
SLEEP SOUNDS, MUSIC & SOUNDSCAPES
*Calming music, nature sounds, and sleep sounds: ocean waves, heavy rain, campfire, and more
*Exclusive focus and sleep music from top artists, updated weekly
*Full soundscapes and sleep sounds to help you relax, meditate, and sleep soundly

🍦MixerBox BFF is a free location-sharing app that lets you easily share your current location with friends, family, and loved ones! Download now! 🌎📍

You can instantly share your location with friends, family, and loved ones, making it easy to see each other's location right away and view information such as speed, battery level, and duration of stay. MixerBox BFF has minimal battery consumption and highly stable servers🔋
◆ Find Friends and Phones!
You can add unlimited friends through email, QR code, or shaking your phone👋 Lost your phone? Let your friends help you locate and find it on the map. This app is invitation-only, so you can only share your location with friends and family you approve, ensuring security🔒
◆ "TimeLine" Keeps You Updated
Opening MixerBox BFF not only shows you where your friends are right now but also where they've been recently. The system automatically records every footprint, each filled with memories of life.
◆ Private Messaging & Emojis
You can send messages and emojis to your friends. With a variety of cute stickers, you can send continuous sticker messages based on your mood💕💩🤩
◆ The World Is Your Oyster!
Through "Your World" and "Footprints," MixerBox BFF automatically records the places and routes you've been to. It helps reminisce about travel memories and daily activities and check favorite travel destinations, frequently visited shops, and facilities. You can also use it as a regular map app🗺️ Footprint recovery without getting Zenly's data is also available now!
◆ Temporarily Hide Your Location
With "Ghost Mode," you can blur your location or temporarily stop sharing it with specific friends. You have complete control over your location info.
◆ Phone Widget
📲 Add the MixerBox BFF widget to your phone's home screen! Without entering the MixerBox BFF app, you can instantly see the current location of the friends you care about through the widget.
◆ Set Your Own Locations
You can set your favorite locations, such as Home, School, and Workplace! When visiting exciting places, you can check in, tag friends, and add those locations to your personal world map📍
◆ Arrival/Departure and Travel Notifications
You will receive notifications when your friends arrive/depart from specific locations or go on long-distance travel, saving time from asking, "Where are you?" 💪⌚
◆ Customize to your preferences
✅ Map styles: Standard maps, Satellite maps, etc.
✅ Theme options: Choose from dark styles, cute styles, and more to freely change the style you like!
✅ Personal status: Change your status anytime, such as "at home," "at work," "having a meal," "traveling," and other fun options.
Other highlights✨
MixerBox BFF also offers fun features like one-handed map zooming, navigation, viewing "Who viewed my profile," and potential connections with familiar users. 👀
When can you use MixerBox BFF?
✔️ Emergency safety confirmation.
✔️ When you lose or misplace your phone or when you want to locate the Android or iPhone of your family or friends.
✔️ Keeping an eye on family members living far away.
✔️ Meet up with friends.
✔️ Prevent getting lost from your travel companions during domestic and international travels.
MixerBox BFF is perfect for various situations✨
MixerBox BFF is a map SNS & GPS tracking app that anyone can use! Try it now! If you have any questions or comments, feel free to get in touch with us: bff.support@mixerbox.com
No need to be sad about Zenly's shutdown anymore. MixerBox BFF is always by your side! 💕

🌟 Lead, Multiply, and Conquer! Mob Control delivers thrilling tower defense action where you grow your mob, deploy powerful champions, and crush enemy bases. 🏆 Defend, Conquer, and Rise to Victory in this Epic Tower Defense Showdown!
Are you ready to become the ultimate champion in the world of tower defense battles? Mob Control brings you an unparalleled strategy and action-packed experience that will test your skills, wit, and tactical prowess. With oddly satisfying gameplay and a wide array of features, Mob Control is your gateway to tower defense supremacy.
Oddly Satisfying Gameplay: Create, Grow, and Lead!
Experience the strangely satisfying thrill of watching your mob multiply as you aim and shoot at the gates. Witness your army grow to massive proportions!
Strategically deploy your mighty Champions to break through enemy mobs and reach their bases. Choose the best combo for victory!
Explore intriguing level elements like speed boosts, multipliers, moving gates, and more, adding depth and challenge to your gameplay.
Become an Immortal Player: Rise Through the Ranks!
Earn Championship Stars by emerging victorious in battles, fortifying your bases, and dominating tournaments. Show the world your tower defense prowess!
Climb the prestigious Champions League using your hard-earned Championship Stars and become an immortal player, joining the elite few who have conquered this tower defense realm.
Fortify Your Base: Shield Your Dominion!
Secure your base from enemy raids by winning battles and earning valuable shields. Protect your hard-earned resources and maintain your tower defense dominance.
Unlock and Upgrade Cards: Collect, Evolve, and Dominate!
Win battles to unlock booster packs of varying rarities and enhance your card collection. Collectible cards hold the power to elevate your tower defense strategy to new heights.
Unlock all the Cannons, Mobs and Champions in the armory and discover their amazing evolutions as you level them up.
Diverse Game Modes: Challenge and Conquer!
Engage in thrilling game modes that keep the action fresh:
Base Invasion: Raid enemy strongholds, pilfer coins, and claim bricks from rival players. Plunder and dominate!
Revenge and Counter-Attack: Turn the tables on attackers and seek retribution against those who challenge your tower defense might.
Boss Levels: Test your tower defense mettle in unique level layouts, earning extra bonuses as you conquer the most challenging adversaries.
Season Pass: A Constant Stream of Fresh Content!
Dive into ever-evolving content with our monthly Season Pass.
Complete quests, advance tiers, and unlock new heroes, cannons and skins
Always Improving: Join the Evolution!
Our dedicated team is committed to delivering fresh mechanics and content every month. Stay connected and share your ideas via Settings > Discord, actively contributing to the evolution of Mob Control.
A Premium Experience: Your Choice to Play Ad-Free!

details_full_description:
Reverso Translate and Learn
Reverso is the all-in-one tool that provides you high-quality translations and helps you improve your language skills seamlessly. It's magic, and it's free.
Teachers or translators, students or business professionals, beginners or advanced learners use Reverso to enrich their vocabulary and read, write, and speak with more accuracy and confidence.
Reverso Context relies on data collected from millions of real-life multilingual texts computed with powerful "big data" algorithms and machine learning techniques. This way, we make sure you enjoy the most accurate and relevant results as well as a learning experience customized to your needs.
Download the Reverso app, and you'll have millions of words and expressions at your fingertips, with their translations in multiple languages. Just type or speak a word or an expression and find accurate translations, illustrated by examples of real usage. Then, you can easily memorize the ones that are relevant to you with our learning activities.
How context helps you better translate?
The search results (translations) for a specific word or expression are weaved within real-life sentences extracted from official documents, movie subtitles, product descriptions. The examples help you understand how translations can vary upon context and select the most suitable one to avoid embarrassing mistakes.
Learn from your translations with fun activities
Reverso goes far beyond a simple translation app, breaking new ground also in the language learning field.
Our app includes flashcards, quizzes, and games generated based on your searches to help you focus on the words and expressions that matter to you. They use SRS (Spaced Repetition System) learning, enabling you to memorize new terms smoothly, without the constraints of the old-school learning methods. Forget about the tedious task of studying a standard selection of words to reach language proficiency. With the Reverso app, language learning becomes fun: you play with flashcards to regularly practice the words and expressions you've recently discovered, and memorize them along the way. At your own learning pace, in the limit of your available time.
Although language learning is fun and flexible, the whole process gains structures through learning strategy and statistics. You can fine-tune the category of new terms you want to include in your learning activities, according to your linguistic interests and needs. In the learning statistics, you will be able to follow-up on your progress.
The bits and bytes:
* Translation in 14 languages: Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, German, Polish, Dutch, Arabic, Russian, Romanian, Japanese, Turkish, Hebrew, Chinese and we are working on more.
* Search by speaking and hear back the pronunciation of the translations
* Favorites list and search history, available even offline
* Pronunciation of complete example sentences, with a native accent
* One-click to get translations, frequency details, and conjugation when applicable.
* Suggestions: words and expressions will be suggested to you as you type.
* Share your findings via email or social media.
* Verbs conjugation in 10 languages including French, Spanish, Italian but also Arabic, Japanese, Hebrew or Russian
* Synonyms to help you understand words' meanings and expand your vocabulary
* Flashcards, quizzes, games to help you learn new vocabulary

Train your mind with Lumosity’s fun brain games.
