details_full_description:
Яндекс Афиша — билеты
Afisha is a convenient service that helps you plan your leisure time and buy tickets for a wide variety of events. The Yandex Afisha app brings together the best events in your city and across the country.
Want to go to the cinema, catch a concert of your favorite artist, sign up for a tour, see a play, or visit the Hermitage? Now you can do it all in one app.
With Afisha (or, as many call it, Afisha or Yandex Tickets), you can easily buy electronic tickets online and store them in your personal account. For your convenience, we offer visual theater maps with filters and panoramic views from your seat. This allows you to immediately understand what your view of the stage or screen will be like from your chosen seat. If you prefer specific theaters, the app supports purchasing tickets to Soft Cinema, Karo, Cinema Park, Formula Kino, Premier Zal, Kinomir, and other venues.
You can securely pay for your order in a variety of ways, including in installments using Split. And if you have a Yandex Plus subscription, you'll receive up to 30% cashback in points that can be spent on new experiences or other Yandex services. Our app also supports the benefits of the Pushkin Card, so students and schoolchildren can use it to buy tickets to cultural events.
We have all the popular ticket partners here: Kassir.ru (kassir), Gorbilet, Ticketland, and others. This means you always have a choice—from major chains to local venues. The app helps you find the best deals and never miss an important event.
Yandex Events features include:
✅ Event listings in your city. For example, events in Moscow or another region;
✅ Personalized selections and top events: from new films to rare art shows;
✅ The ability to follow promotions and exclusive events;
✅ Reminders of upcoming events so you don't miss a thing;
✅ Store all your tickets in one place, eliminating paperwork;
✅ Convenient online payment and instant receipt of your e-ticket.
Our app is often searched for Yandex Cinema and Yandex Films, because with Afisha you can compare schedules, choose the nearest cinema, and buy a ticket in just a few clicks. Thanks to integration with major cinema chains—Karo, Cinema Park, Formula Kino, Premier Zal, and Kinomir—finding the right showtime is as simple as possible.
But Afisha isn't just about cinema. Here you'll find performances, concerts, festivals, sporting events (sports), master classes, lectures, quests, exhibitions, and stand-up comedy. You can even buy tickets to events from the Culture of the Russian Federation project, as well as to museums and theaters across the country.
The app makes it easy to search for events by genre and date, and use filters to select only what interests you. And the recommendation system will suggest events you might enjoy.
Afisha.ru has long been a symbol of cultural life in Russia. Now it's all available on your smartphone in the Yandex Afisha app. Install it and discover new experiences every day.
Afisha brings together everything you need to plan your leisure time: from watching movies at the Soft Cinema to visiting exhibitions at galleries and museums like the Hermitage. Want to compare events with other services like Kudago? Afisha brings everything together in one place—conveniently, securely, and with support for multiple payment methods.
Download Yandex Afisha now. Check schedules, choose the best seats, pay in seconds, and keep your tickets always at hand. Afisha will make your leisure time more exciting.

Find my Phone - Family Locator
Find my Phone - Family Locator helps you stay connected and ensure the safety of your family members. Using advanced GPS technology, our app provides real-time location updates, allowing you to easily locate family members and find them in the crowds with your phone.
Key features for family safety & connection:
✔️ Real-time location tracking: view your family members' live location on a private map.
✔️ Arrival & departure alerts: get notified when family members arrive at or leave predefined places (e.g., home, school).
✔️ SOS button: share your emergency location instantly with your trusted circle.
✔️ Flights tracking: easily know where your circle members fly and get notifications.
✔️ Private in-app chat: stay in touch with your family through secure messaging.
✔️ Quick check-in: let family members know you're safe with a tap.
✔️ Location history: review past locations of family members.
📲 How Find my Phone - Family Locator works:
1. Install the app and grant necessary permissions for the app to function (e.g., location access).
2. Create or join a private family circle. This ensures that only the people you invite and who accept your invitation will be part of your circle.
3. Invite family or trusted members using their phone number, a direct link, or a QR code.
4. Explicit consent is key: Each invited member must explicitly accept the invitation only with consent and grant all necessary permissions (including location access) on their own device before location sharing becomes active for them.
5. Transparent notifications: All members are clearly notified about the purpose of the app, who invited them, and how their location data will be used within the private circle.
6. User control: Find my Phone - Family Locator can only function if each user actively agrees to share their location.
🔒 Privacy, Transparency & User Consent:
Family Locator supports only mutual, informed, and transparent usage of location sharing between consenting parties - such as family members and close contacts. Our app is built on the principles of privacy, safety, and trust.
We encourage users to use Find my Phone - Family Locator only for family safety and caregiving use cases. Misuse of the app for unapproved tracking and/or without informed consent is strictly against our policies and local privacy laws.
Optional permissions:
- Find my Phone - Family Locator may request the following permissions (with user approval at each step):
- Location services: for real-time location sharing, geofencing, and SOS alerts.
- Notifications: to inform you of family location changes and safety alerts.
- Contacts: to help you invite trusted family members to your circles.
- Photos and Camera: to personalize your profile picture.
Permissions are requested transparently and explained in context. Users remain in control at all times and can adjust access in device settings.
Family Locator is committed to privacy, transparency, and responsible use. We do not support any use of the app without the knowledge and consent of all participants.
Find my Phone - Family Locator is not intended for secret tracking or unauthorized surveillance. It is designed and marketed solely for family safety use cases, such as parents tracking children or caregivers assisting dependents. It does not support covert tracking, stealth installs, or remote activation.
We value your feedback! Contact us at: support@family-locator.com.

Blockudoku® is an original combination of sudoku and block puzzle games. It is a simple yet challenging and addictive free block puzzle you won’t be able to put down.
Match blocks to remove them by completing lines and cubes. Keep the board clean and beat your high score in this block puzzle! Watch blocks blast away as you play! Challenge your IQ and win the block puzzle game!

✔ Complete Daily Challenges to get unique trophies while playing block puzzles.
✔ Join Seasonal Events and uncover unique animated postcards.

✔ Streak. Score more points by eliminating blocks with several successful moves in a row. Go full blast and destroy as many blocks as you can!
✔ Unique addicting mechanics. Blockudoku® has been created as a highly playable mixture of sudoku and a block puzzle game.
✔ Addictive gameplay. Play block games when you are bored or eager to train your brain whenever and wherever you want!

There is no time limit in this block game, so no rush. Think one step ahead when you face a difficult move. It might become your last one!

Find your zen in this addicting game by balancing between blasting blocks as quickly as possible and getting as many combos and streaks as you can to score higher.

Blockudoku® block puzzle has been designed for people who want to unwind and train their brain at the same time. This block puzzle game includes combinations of various scales and complexity together with simple addictive gameplay which is similar to block puzzle and sudoku games. Whether you are tired or in low spirits, a few rounds of playing Blockudoku® block puzzle will cheer you up and let your mind relax.

Take a break from the daily grind and get rid of negative thoughts by immersing yourself in this brain teaser. Enjoy the satisfying feeling of making streaks and combos, and watch every block blast away while exploring the captivating world of Blockudoku® addicting games! You definitely won't be bored playing block puzzle games! Relieve stress or train your brain with a relaxing yet challenging block puzzle game of Blockudoku® with block blast excitement anywhere, anytime!

details_full_description:
Super Mario Run
A new kind of Mario game that you can play with one hand.
You control Mario by tapping as he constantly runs forward. You time your taps to pull off stylish jumps, midair spins, and wall jumps to gather coins and reach the goal!
Super Mario Run can be downloaded for free and after you purchase the game, you will be able to play all the modes with no additional payment required. You can try out all four modes before purchase: World Tour, Toad Rally, Remix 10, and Kingdom Builder.
■World Tour
Run and jump with style to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser’s clutches!
Travel through plains, caverns, ghost houses, airships, castles, and more.
Clear the 24 exciting courses to rescue Princess Peach from Bowser, waiting in his castle at the end. There are many ways to enjoy the courses, such as collecting the 3 different types of colored coins or by competing for the highest score against your friends. You can try courses 1-1 to 1-4 for free.
After rescuing Princess Peach, a nine-course special world, World Star, will appear.
■Remix 10
Some of the shortest Super Mario Run courses you'll ever play!
This mode is Super Mario Run in bite-sized bursts! You'll play through 10 short courses one after the other, with the courses changing each time you play. Daisy is lost somewhere in Remix 10, so try to clear as many courses as you can to find her!
■Toad Rally
Show off Mario’s stylish moves, compete against your friends, and challenge people from all over the world.
In this challenge mode, the competition differs each time you play.
Compete against the stylish moves of other players for the highest score as you gather coins and get cheered on by a crowd of Toads. Fill the gauge with stylish moves to enter Coin Rush Mode to get more coins. If you win the rally, the cheering Toads will come live in your kingdom, and your kingdom will grow.
■Kingdom Builder
Gather coins and Toads to build your very own kingdom.
Combine different buildings and decorations to create your own unique kingdom. There are over 100 kinds of items in Kingdom Builder mode. If you get more Toads in Toad Rally, the number of buildings and decorations available will increase. With the help of the friendly Toads you can gradually build up your kingdom.
■What You Can Do After Purchasing All Worlds

details_full_description:
Erudite: Trivia Games & Quiz
🎲 Games, Puzzles & Brainteasers You’ll Actually Want to Play
If you’re into games that spark your brain, puzzles that make you think, or brainteasers that feel more fun than frustrating — Erudite is your new favorite brain buddy. It’s not just another quiz app. It’s your daily dose of clever, calming question games, playful trivia spin rounds, and unexpected facts that somehow stick. Ideal for your morning coffee, late-night chill, or those five minutes between meetings.
Designed to be more than just time-killers, these puzzles and brainteasers are perfect for anyone who wants to keep their brain active without diving into textbook territory. Whether you’re winding down after a long day or trying to beat your best friend in a random quiz challenge, Erudite’s guessing games turn everyday downtime into light, brain-boosting fun.
🧠 Train Your Brain, No Pressure
Erudite’s brain teaser games and quizzes are built for cognitive training — but don’t worry, it never feels like studying. Think of it like mental yoga: the more you play, the sharper you feel. If you’ve ever zoned out with mindless scrolling, this is your chance to swap that habit for something that actually boosts your brainpower.
Tap through fun question games that wake up your logic, memory, and problem-solving skills — whether you're at the airport, on your lunch break, or just waiting for the coffee to brew.
☁️ A Chill Way to De-Stress with Question Games
These aren’t the kind of trivia games that leave you frustrated. With no timers or pressure, Erudite offers a mellow space to let go of the day’s chaos.
Picture this: you’ve had a long day, you’re curled up on the couch, and instead of binge-scrolling, you open the app for a few lighthearted guessing games that relax your mind but still keep it engaged. This is what self-care for your brain looks like — just you, your thoughts, and a few chill trivia games.
🎓 Learn Without Realizing You’re Learning
Erudite makes learning feel like a casual trivial pursuit — knowledge just slips in. Whether you're curious about how volcanoes work, want to level up your vocabulary, or finally figure out which U.S. state is actually the flattest, our trivia games make learning feel like play.
With each trivia spin and clever question games, you're soaking up real facts — no textbooks needed. Perfect for those moments when you want to feel smart, but also kinda lazy.
🎯 Your Daily Trivial Pursuit: New Questions Across Topics
Every day brings fresh quizzes — and you never know what you'll get:
🏛️ History (no more awkward “I should know this” moments)
➕ Math (surprise yourself with how fast you can calculate a tip)
🌍 Geography (so next time you travel, you’re not totally lost)
🔬 Science (because weird facts about space are always cool)
💬 Linguistics (fancy words = bonus points in Scrabble)
🎵 Music (spot melodies your friends completely miss)
🏆 No Pressure, Just Progress
Each question gives you three tries — so if you mess up, no sweat. Erudite rewards curiosity, not perfection. You’ll rack up points with fun guessing games and quizzes, while every small win keeps your brain feeling fresh. It’s like a low-stakes trivial pursuit, where you’re competing against yesterday’s version of you.
💬 Quizzes & Clever Facts That Stick With You
You know those random facts you drop into conversations that make everyone stop and go, “Wait, really?” Yeah, that’s Erudite working its trivial pursuit magic. One minute you’re diving into trivia games and guessing games while your pasta’s boiling, the next you’re impressing your friends with some offbeat facts from a quick trivia spin.
So if you're looking for guessing games or trivia games that relax your brain, question games that sharpen your wit, or quizzes that teach without preaching — it’s time to play smarter with Erudite. You might just become the walking trivial pursuit champion of your group.

Create and customize your very own Monkey City in this groundbreaking blend of city building and tower defense!

details_full_description:
Harmonium
Harmonium is a musical instrument which is a free-reed organ that generates sound as air flows past a vibrating piece of thin metal in a frame. It is an important instrument in many genres of Indian music especially classical. It is widely used in India in Indian music concerts. A lot of Singers use harmonium for practicing vocals to make their vocals and music knowledge more strong. Wannabe singers use it to learn music, understand Sur and improve their vocals.
Harmonium is one of the best musical instruments for practicing vocals, understanding music , understanding Sur (doing Sur Sadhna), understanding Raags (doing Raag Sadhana), doing Kharaj ka riyaz (for improving Bass notes in your voice – getting more deep & resonant voice), improving surilapan (improving sound quality of vocals – sweetening vocals) etc.
A normal harmonium costs something to you but GameG presents you the real Harmonium for free.
Whether you are a musician or a singer (who uses harmonium for practicing vocals), you can carry your harmonium in your device (android phone / android tablet). There are some places where you can’t take your real harmonium but you can carry this one everywhere.
Key Features:-
Smooth Playing - You don't have to lift you fingers if you wanna play next or previous key, you just have to slide your finger smoothly on it.
Coupler - Coupler provides the effect of richness in the sound of the harmonium by adding sounds of an octave higher notes to the notes which you play.
Zoom In / Zoom Out Keys - Use the Plus / Minus buttons for Zoom In / Zoom Out the keys of the harmonium and adjust them according to your needs.
Fullscreen Keys View - Now you can get a fullscreen keys view either by clicking the expand button or from the settings of the app, for getting more keys on the screen
42 keys / 3.5 saptak octaves harmonium extended to 88 keys / 7.3 saptak octaves

details_full_description:
Switch Access
Control your phone or tablet using switches or the front camera. You can use switches to select items, scroll, enter text, and more.
Switch Access helps you interact with your Android device using one or more switches instead of the touchscreen. Switch Access can be helpful if you can't interact directly with your device.
To get started:
1. Open your device's Settings app.
2. Tap Accessibility > Switch Access.
Set up a switch
Switch Access scans the items on your screen and highlights each item until you make a selection. You can choose from a few kinds of switches:
Physical switches
• USB or Bluetooth switches, like buttons or keyboards
• On-device switches, like volume buttons
Camera switches
• Open your mouth, smile, or raise your eyebrows
• Look left, right, or up
Scan your device
After setting up a switch, you can scan and interact with things on the screen.
• Linear scanning: Move between items one at a time.
• Row-column scanning: Scan one row at a time. After a row is selected, move through items in that list.
• Point scanning: Use moving lines to select a specific horizontal and vertical location, then press "Select".
• Group selection: Assign switches to different color groupings. All items on the screen will be assigned a color. Press the switch corresponding to the color around the item you want. Narrow down the size of the group until you reach your choice.
Use the menus
When an element is selected, you'll see a menu with available interactions, like select, scroll, copy, paste, and more.
There will also be a menu at the top of the screen to help you move around your device. For example, you can open notifications, go to the home screen, change the volume, and more.
Navigate with Camera Switches
You can use Camera Switches to navigate your phone with facial gestures. Browse or select apps on your phone with the use of your phone’s front camera.
You can also customize the sensitivity and duration of each gesture to better fit your needs.
Record shortcuts
You can record touch gestures that can be assigned to a switch or started from a menu. Touch gestures can include pinching, zooming, scrolling, swiping, double tapping, and more. You can then start frequent or complex actions with a single switch, for example, recording a gesture that swipes left twice to turn two pages of an ebook.
Permissions Notice
• Accessibility Service: Because this app is an accessibility service, it can observe your actions, retrieve window content, and observe text that you type.

OTR - Offroad Car Driving Game
Hello Offroaders! The new open world off-road driving simulator is here! It's time to get Off The Road!
Drive your rig on the hills of your own open world, get into a boat and explore islands, pick a helicopter and fly freely to the top of the mountains or just walk around if you need a peaceful hike it's up to you.
Beat challenges to earn money and upgrade your car. Make it stronger, faster, look more awesome!
Earn xp to level up and get cool rewards.
[DRIVE ANYWHERE]
Using your car's winch you can climb the highest mountains, nothing can stop you. Thanks to the accurate rope physics the cable rope behaves realistically. You can drive boats to travel the sea or fly a helicopter to get anywhere easily.
[SIMULATION]
Realistic damage model for vehicles. Falls, crashes deform your car's chassis. Tyre pressure is simulated, tires deform based on load. Simulated water ripples, buoyancy etc.
[MULTIPLAYER]
Compete against players around the world in multiplayer! Play sandbox or competitive in various game modes! Participate in Weekly Ranked Race events for amazing rewards!
[CHALLENGES]
Try to be fast to beat the Checkpoint Hunt challenges, use your off-roading skills to reach checkpoints in Pathfinder challenges. Find and transport the required materials for Transport challenges!
[TRANSPORTATION]
Use trailers to transport materials to their destinations, or use your winch to attach to objects in the world and drag them around freely.
[CONSTRUCTION]
Construct houses, bridges, roads, vehicles by transporting the required materials to the site!
[VEHICLES]
Drive off-road 4x4 cars, trucks, off-road behemoths, boats, helicopters!
[MUD PHYSICS]
Dynamic mud surface that deforms. You can find muddy fields to get your car dirty. Chassis can get muddy and dirty, you can wash it by driving into water or repairing.

Nitro Nation: Car Racing Game
Race, modify, and tune dozens of real licensed cars! Start a team, invite your friends, win tournaments. Trade parts with other racers in real time and build your dream car for both Drag and Drift races!
Meet the drift - The most advanced Drift mode comes to the drag racing world!
Cutting edge technology recreates the most precise and lifelike drift experience ever!
New suspension upgrades let you adjust your car specifically for drift.
Intuitive, customizable controls will fit any racer.
Unique tracks designed specifically for drift.
Lots of cars - Supercars and exotics? Check. Tuners and street racers? Check. Classic and modern muscle? You bet! The best part? There’s always more coming to the game!
We know you love drag racing cars — there are more than 150 cars to collect and race.
Fair play - No “fuel” timers. No waiting for deliveries of cars or upgrades. Every vehicle can be competitive and there are no “premium-only” upgrades. It’s all about driving skill and dedication.
Real racers & teams – We’re all about multiplayer racing: there’s always an online rival waiting for you on the street or the track. Race any distance from 1/8 to a full mile, join or create a team, win tournaments with your crew, climb the leaderboards, or test your nerves in wager races.
Jump into live multiplayer races in real time with friends and opponents worldwide! Compete in weekly regional tournaments, rise through divisions, and fight your way to the elite ranks.
Epic upgrades - Upgrade and improve 33 unique car components with 3 tiers of aftermarket blueprints. Satisfy your need for speed and build a one-of-a-kind drag racing machine. Ever dreamed of smoking an exotic sports car in your 800 HP hatchback? Happens every day.
Personal touch – Customize your drag car with cool decals and place them however you like. Choose your own paint colors and finishes. Add high-performance tires, custom rims, and aftermarket body parts like bumpers, skirts, and spoilers to create a unique look.
Car geeks welcome – Powered by an advanced physics engine, the game delivers realistic handling that behaves like real life. Tune your gears with detailed specs, use dyno graphs and gearing charts, and dive into advanced race stats to put your racing knowledge to work.

Walgreens
Get the best of Walgreens at your fingertips. Refill prescriptions, access health services for your family, create custom photo keepsakes, shop, save and more.
Prescriptions & Pharmacy
• Refill in a snap by scanning your prescription bottle
• Receive refill updates and alerts
• Track order status for the whole family
• Never miss a refill with auto refills
Health Services
• Book vaccinations for the whole family
• Schedule COVID-19 and flu tests and check eligibility for antiviral prescription treatment
• Get virtual online visits with a healthcare provider 24/7 for most non-emergency conditions
• Find support for diabetes, pain management, mental health and more
• Get FREE prescription and general health advice 24/7 from a pharmacy expert with Pharmacy Chat
Photo
• Upload photos from your device to create customized photo prints, posters, calendars, and cards available in as little as 1 hour at your local Walgreens
• Create fun photo gifts like magnets, mousepads, puzzles, cubes, collages and more
• Get Passport and Visa photos available during your visit
• Get Photo deals and promo codes updated regularly
• Get FREE same-day pickup
Shop & Savings
• Shop essentials with convenient delivery or pickup in as little as 30 minutes*
• Clip deals & coupons from anywhere
• Earn unlimited Walgreens Cash rewards & get personalized offers
• Get easy access to the Weekly Ad, plus the latest sales and promo
Android Permissions:
How the app uses device permissions
• Location: Find nearby stores and enable in-store savings
• Storage: Access photos stored on your device that you want to print or share
• Camera: Take photos and use features that require scanning
• Flashlight: Enhance the lighting in scanning features
• Control vibration: Indicate that a scan is complete
• Microphone: Speak to a healthcare provider over the phone or video, or to search for products and coupons using your voice
• Prevent phone from sleeping: Keep screen from dimming during a live consultation with a healthcare provider
• Change audio settings: Control the volume during a live consultation with a healthcare provider
The Walgreens App is free to download, but specified rates from your wireless provider and other fees as noted in your Walgreens account agreement(s) still apply.
*See Walgreens.com for details and restrictions.

details_full_description:
Sonic Boom Dash
The world’s fastest hedgehog returns in a high-octane sequel built for the next generation of mobile gaming. Sonic Boom Dash fuses the legendary speed of SEGA’s classic runners with the tactical depth of the hit Sonic Boom universe. This isn't just a race; it’s a fully immersive, multi-layered dash through 3D worlds that push your reflexes to the limit.
Explore Immersive 3D Worlds
Embark on a high-speed journey through breathtaking 3D landscapes and exhilarating new challenges. Whether you're navigating lush jungles or futuristic ruins, the gameplay is truly endless. Take control of your destiny by choosing the ultimate runner from the iconic Sonic the Hedgehog roster. Will you dash as the legendary Sonic, or master the track with Shadow, Tails, Amy, Knuckles, Vector, or the fearless newcomer, Sticks the Badger?
Epic Graphics, Elite Precision
Experience the "Boom" with stunning, console-quality graphics that bring every loop and jump to life. Race through meticulously designed courses filled with high-stakes hazards and intricate obstacles. It’s not just about running—it’s about precision. Dodge, jump, and weave your way through epic levels as you fight for the top of the leaderboard and claim your victory.
Endless Action for Every Generation
Built for fans of all ages, Sonic Boom offers a deep, rewarding gameplay experience that kids and adults alike can’t put down. The more you run, the more you achieve! Unlock an entire stable of classic characters and customize your experience by selecting the runner that fits your style. Sonic and his team are at the starting line—are you ready to join the race?
GAME FEATURES
➢ICONIC ROSTER: Play as Sonic, Shadow, Tails, Amy, Knuckles, Vector, or the wild and unpredictable Sticks the Badger.
➢STUNNING 3D ENVIRONMENTS: Race through lush jungles and futuristic landscapes in the beautiful Sonic Boom world, featuring graphics optimized for high-speed thrills.
➢EVOLVE YOUR GAMEPLAY: Collect and evolve magical Sprites. These tiny companions provide instant boosts, reviving you from crashes or extending your dash power.
➢LIVE EVENTS & CHALLENGES: Don't just run for a high score—run for glory. Compete in Daily SEGA Challenges and special events to unlock exclusive rewards and rare prizes.
Dash into the next generation of endless runners. The world of Sonic Boom is waiting—are you fast enough to handle it?
- - - - -
